"""
Views for matches app.
"""
from rest_framework import viewsets, filters, status
from rest_framework.decorators import action
from rest_framework.response import Response
from django_filters.rest_framework import DjangoFilterBackend
from django.utils.decorators import method_decorator
from django.views.decorators.cache import cache_page
from django.utils import timezone
from datetime import timedelta
from django.db import models as db_models
from django.core.cache import cache

from .models import Match, MatchEvent, Lineup, MatchStats, MatchLiveState
from .serializers import (
    MatchListSerializer, MatchDetailSerializer,
    MatchEventSerializer, LineupSerializer,
    MatchStatsSerializer, MatchLiveStateSerializer
)
from .services.espn_api import espn_api


class MatchViewSet(viewsets.ReadOnlyModelViewSet):
    """ViewSet for matches."""
    
    queryset = Match.objects.select_related(
        'home_team', 'away_team', 'competition_season__competition'
    ).prefetch_related('events').all()
    
    filter_backends = [DjangoFilterBackend, filters.SearchFilter, filters.OrderingFilter]
    filterset_fields = [
        'status', 'competition_season', 'home_team', 'away_team',
        'stage', 'group', 'is_featured'
    ]
    search_fields = ['home_team__name', 'away_team__name']
    ordering_fields = ['kickoff_time', 'home_score', 'away_score']
    ordering = ['-kickoff_time']
    
    def get_serializer_class(self):
        if self.action == 'list':
            return MatchListSerializer
        return MatchDetailSerializer
    
    @method_decorator(cache_page(30))
    def dispatch(self, *args, **kwargs):
        return super().dispatch(*args, **kwargs)
    
    # ============ DATABASE ENDPOINTS ============
    
    @action(detail=False, methods=['get'])
    def live(self, request):
        """Get all currently live matches from database."""
        matches = Match.objects.filter(
            status__in=[Match.Status.LIVE, Match.Status.HALF_TIME]
        ).select_related(
            'home_team', 'away_team', 'competition_season__competition'
        ).order_by('kickoff_time')
        
        serializer = MatchListSerializer(matches, many=True)
        return Response({
            'count': matches.count(),
            'matches': serializer.data,
        })
    
    @action(detail=False, methods=['get'])
    def today(self, request):
        """Get all matches scheduled for today."""
        today = timezone.now().date()
        matches = Match.objects.filter(
            kickoff_time__date=today
        ).select_related(
            'home_team', 'away_team', 'competition_season__competition'
        ).order_by('kickoff_time')
        
        serializer = MatchListSerializer(matches, many=True)
        return Response(serializer.data)
    
    @action(detail=False, methods=['get'])
    def upcoming(self, request):
        """Get upcoming matches (next 7 days)."""
        now = timezone.now()
        end_date = now + timedelta(days=7)
        
        matches = Match.objects.filter(
            kickoff_time__gte=now,
            kickoff_time__lte=end_date,
            status=Match.Status.SCHEDULED
        ).select_related(
            'home_team', 'away_team', 'competition_season__competition'
        ).order_by('kickoff_time')
        
        page = self.paginate_queryset(matches)
        if page is not None:
            serializer = MatchListSerializer(page, many=True)
            return self.get_paginated_response(serializer.data)
        serializer = MatchListSerializer(matches, many=True)
        return Response(serializer.data)
    
    # ============ ESPN FREE API ENDPOINTS (WORKING) ============
    
    @action(detail=False, methods=['get'])
    def live_external(self, request):
        """Get live matches from ESPN Free API (no key required)."""
        cached_matches = cache.get('espn_live_matches')
        if cached_matches:
            return Response({
                'count': len(cached_matches),
                'matches': cached_matches,
                'source': 'cache'
            })
        
        sport = request.query_params.get('sport', 'soccer')
        live_matches = espn_api.get_live_scores(sport)
        cache.set('espn_live_matches', live_matches, 30)
        
        return Response({
            'count': len(live_matches),
            'matches': live_matches,
            'source': 'ESPN Free API',
            'sport': sport
        })
    
    @action(detail=False, methods=['get'])
    def refresh_live(self, request):
        """Force refresh live matches from ESPN Free API."""
        sport = request.query_params.get('sport', 'soccer')
        live_matches = espn_api.get_live_scores(sport)
        cache.set('espn_live_matches', live_matches, 30)
        
        return Response({
            'count': len(live_matches),
            'matches': live_matches,
            'refreshed_at': timezone.now().isoformat(),
            'sport': sport,
            'source': 'ESPN Free API'
        })
    
    @action(detail=False, methods=['get'])
    def search_teams(self, request):
        """Search for teams by name via ESPN API."""
        query = request.query_params.get('q', '')
        sport = request.query_params.get('sport', 'soccer')
        
        if not query:
            return Response({'error': 'q parameter required'}, status=400)
        
        teams = espn_api.search_teams(query, sport)
        
        return Response({
            'count': len(teams),
            'teams': teams,
            'query': query,
            'sport': sport,
            'source': 'ESPN Free API'
        })
    
    # ============ FLASHSCORE API ENDPOINTS (Return helpful message) ============
    
    @action(detail=False, methods=['get'])
    def flashscore_search(self, request):
        """FlashScore API - Please use /live_external/ endpoint instead."""
        return Response({
            'error': 'FlashScore API is not currently available. Please use the ESPN API endpoint.',
            'alternative': '/api/v1/matches/matches/live_external/',
            'message': 'The FlashScore API requires a separate subscription on RapidAPI.'
        }, status=503)
    
    @action(detail=False, methods=['get'])
    def flashscore_live(self, request):
        """FlashScore API - Please use /live_external/ endpoint instead."""
        return Response({
            'error': 'FlashScore API is not currently available. Please use the ESPN API endpoint.',
            'alternative': '/api/v1/matches/matches/live_external/',
            'message': 'The FlashScore API requires a separate subscription on RapidAPI.'
        }, status=503)
    
    @action(detail=False, methods=['get'])
    def flashscore_fixtures(self, request):
        """FlashScore API - Please use /upcoming/ endpoint instead."""
        return Response({
            'error': 'FlashScore API is not currently available.',
            'alternative': '/api/v1/matches/matches/upcoming/',
            'message': 'Use the upcoming endpoint for fixture data from your database.'
        }, status=503)
    
    @action(detail=True, methods=['get'])
    def flashscore_match(self, request, pk=None):
        """FlashScore API - Please use regular match endpoint."""
        return Response({
            'error': 'FlashScore API is not currently available.',
            'alternative': f'/api/v1/matches/matches/{pk}/',
            'message': 'Use the regular match detail endpoint.'
        }, status=503)
    
    @action(detail=False, methods=['get'])
    def flashscore_standings(self, request):
        """FlashScore API - Please use standings endpoint."""
        return Response({
            'error': 'FlashScore API is not currently available.',
            'alternative': '/api/v1/standings/standings/',
            'message': 'Use the standings endpoint for league tables.'
        }, status=503)
    
    @action(detail=False, methods=['get'])
    def flashscore_team(self, request):
        """FlashScore API - Please use teams endpoint."""
        return Response({
            'error': 'FlashScore API is not currently available.',
            'alternative': '/api/v1/teams/teams/',
            'message': 'Use the teams endpoint for team information.'
        }, status=503)
    
    # ============ MATCH DETAIL ENDPOINTS ============
    
    @action(detail=True, methods=['get'])
    def events(self, request, pk=None):
        """Get all events for a match."""
        match = self.get_object()
        events = match.events.all().order_by('minute', 'injury_minute')
        serializer = MatchEventSerializer(events, many=True)
        return Response(serializer.data)
    
    @action(detail=True, methods=['get'])
    def lineups(self, request, pk=None):
        """Get lineups for a match."""
        match = self.get_object()
        lineups = match.lineups.select_related('player', 'team').all()
        serializer = LineupSerializer(lineups, many=True)
        return Response(serializer.data)
    
    @action(detail=True, methods=['get'])
    def stats(self, request, pk=None):
        """Get statistics for a match."""
        match = self.get_object()
        stats = match.stats.all()
        serializer = MatchStatsSerializer(stats, many=True)
        return Response(serializer.data)
    
    @action(detail=True, methods=['get'])
    def live_state(self, request, pk=None):
        """Get live match state."""
        match = self.get_object()
        if hasattr(match, 'live_state') and match.live_state:
            serializer = MatchLiveStateSerializer(match.live_state)
            return Response(serializer.data)
        return Response({'error': 'No live state available'}, status=404)


class MatchEventViewSet(viewsets.ReadOnlyModelViewSet):
    """ViewSet for match events."""
    
    queryset = MatchEvent.objects.select_related(
        'match', 'player', 'related_player', 'team'
    ).all()
    serializer_class = MatchEventSerializer
    filter_backends = [DjangoFilterBackend]
    filterset_fields = ['match', 'event_type', 'player', 'team']
    ordering = ['match', 'minute']


class LineupViewSet(viewsets.ReadOnlyModelViewSet):
    """ViewSet for lineups."""
    
    queryset = Lineup.objects.select_related('match', 'team', 'player').all()
    serializer_class = LineupSerializer
    filter_backends = [DjangoFilterBackend]
    filterset_fields = ['match', 'team', 'role']


class MatchStatsViewSet(viewsets.ReadOnlyModelViewSet):
    """ViewSet for match statistics."""
    
    queryset = MatchStats.objects.select_related('match', 'team').all()
    serializer_class = MatchStatsSerializer
    filter_backends = [DjangoFilterBackend]
    filterset_fields = ['match', 'team']

"""
Django admin configuration for polls app.
"""
from django.contrib import admin
from django.utils.html import format_html
from django.urls import reverse
from .models import Poll, PollOption, Vote, PollResultCache


class PollOptionInline(admin.TabularInline):
    """Inline options within poll admin."""
    
    model = PollOption
    extra = 1
    fields = ['label', 'team', 'option_type', 'sort_order', 'vote_count', 'percentage']
    raw_id_fields = ['team']


class PollResultCacheInline(admin.StackedInline):
    """Inline result cache within poll admin."""
    
    model = PollResultCache
    extra = 0
    readonly_fields = ['total_votes', 'last_calculated']
    fields = ['results_json', 'total_votes', 'last_calculated']
    can_delete = False
    max_num = 1


@admin.register(Poll)
class PollAdmin(admin.ModelAdmin):
    """Admin view for Poll model."""
    
    list_display = [
        'question', 'match_link', 'status', 'total_votes',
        'start_time', 'end_time', 'is_featured'
    ]
    list_filter = ['status', 'is_featured']
    search_fields = ['question', 'match__home_team__name', 'match__away_team__name']
    readonly_fields = ['total_votes', 'created_at', 'updated_at']
    inlines = [PollOptionInline, PollResultCacheInline]
    autocomplete_fields = ['match', 'created_by']
    
    fieldsets = (
        ('Poll Details', {
            'fields': ('match', 'question', 'status', 'is_featured')
        }),
        ('Timing', {
            'fields': ('start_time', 'end_time')
        }),
        ('Statistics', {
            'fields': ('total_votes',)
        }),
        ('Creator', {
            'fields': ('created_by',)
        }),
        ('Timestamps', {
            'fields': ('created_at', 'updated_at'),
            'classes': ('collapse',)
        }),
    )
    
    def match_link(self, obj):
        url = reverse('admin:matches_match_change', args=[obj.match_id])
        return format_html('<a href="{}">{}</a>', url, obj.match)
    match_link.short_description = 'Match'


@admin.register(PollOption)
class PollOptionAdmin(admin.ModelAdmin):
    """Admin view for PollOption model."""
    
    list_display = ['label', 'poll_link', 'option_type', 'team', 'vote_count', 'percentage']
    list_filter = ['option_type']
    search_fields = ['label', 'team__name', 'poll__question']
    readonly_fields = ['vote_count', 'percentage', 'created_at']
    autocomplete_fields = ['poll', 'team']
    
    fieldsets = (
        ('Option Details', {
            'fields': ('poll', 'label', 'team', 'option_type', 'sort_order')
        }),
        ('Statistics', {
            'fields': ('vote_count', 'percentage')
        }),
    )
    
    def poll_link(self, obj):
        url = reverse('admin:polls_poll_change', args=[obj.poll_id])
        return format_html('<a href="{}">{}</a>', url, obj.poll)
    poll_link.short_description = 'Poll'


@admin.register(Vote)
class VoteAdmin(admin.ModelAdmin):
    """Admin view for Vote model."""
    
    list_display = ['user', 'poll_link', 'option_link', 'ip_address', 'voted_at']
    list_filter = ['voted_at']
    search_fields = [
        'user__email', 'poll__question',
        'option__label', 'ip_address'
    ]
    readonly_fields = ['voted_at']
    autocomplete_fields = ['poll', 'option', 'user']
    date_hierarchy = 'voted_at'
    
    fieldsets = (
        ('Vote Details', {
            'fields': ('poll', 'option', 'user')
        }),
        ('Client Info', {
            'fields': ('ip_address', 'user_agent')
        }),
    )
    
    def poll_link(self, obj):
        url = reverse('admin:polls_poll_change', args=[obj.poll_id])
        return format_html('<a href="{}">View Poll</a>', url)
    poll_link.short_description = 'Poll'
    
    def option_link(self, obj):
        url = reverse('admin:polls_polloption_change', args=[obj.option_id])
        return format_html('<a href="{}">{}</a>', url, obj.option.label)
    option_link.short_description = 'Option'

--- FILE: polls/consumers.py ---
"""
WebSocket consumer for real-time poll updates.
"""
import json
from channels.generic.websocket import AsyncWebsocketConsumer
from channels.db import database_sync_to_async


class PollConsumer(AsyncWebsocketConsumer):
    """WebSocket consumer for live poll updates."""
    
    async def connect(self):
        self.poll_id = self.scope['url_route']['kwargs']['poll_id']
        self.room_group_name = f'poll_{self.poll_id}'
        
        await self.channel_layer.group_add(
            self.room_group_name,
            self.channel_name
        )
        await self.accept()
        
        # Send initial poll data
        poll_data = await self.get_poll_data(self.poll_id)
        if poll_data:
            await self.send(text_data=json.dumps({
                'type': 'poll_state',
                'data': poll_data
            }))
    
    async def disconnect(self, close_code):
        await self.channel_layer.group_discard(
            self.room_group_name,
            self.channel_name
        )
    
    async def receive(self, text_data):
        data = json.loads(text_data)
        if data.get('type') == 'ping':
            await self.send(text_data=json.dumps({'type': 'pong'}))
    
    async def poll_update(self, event):
        """Send poll updates to WebSocket."""
        await self.send(text_data=json.dumps({
            'type': 'poll_update',
            'data': event['data']
        }))
    
    async def new_vote(self, event):
        """Send new vote notification."""
        await self.send(text_data=json.dumps({
            'type': 'new_vote',
            'data': event['data']
        }))
    
    @database_sync_to_async
    def get_poll_data(self, poll_id):
        """Get initial poll data from database."""
        from .models import Poll
        from .serializers import PollDetailSerializer
        
        try:
            poll = Poll.objects.select_related(
                'match__home_team', 'match__away_team'
            ).prefetch_related('options', 'result_cache').get(id=poll_id)
            return PollDetailSerializer(poll).data
        except Poll.DoesNotExist:
            return None

--- FILE: polls/models.py ---
"""
Poll-related models: polls, options, votes, cached results.
"""
import uuid
from django.db import models
from django.utils import timezone
from django.utils.translation import gettext_lazy as _


class Poll(models.Model):
    """Who Will Win poll widget."""
    
    class Status(models.TextChoices):
        ACTIVE = 'active', _('Active')
        CLOSED = 'closed', _('Closed')
        ARCHIVED = 'archived', _('Archived')
    
    id = models.UUIDField(primary_key=True, default=uuid.uuid4, editable=False)
    match = models.OneToOneField(
        'matches.Match', on_delete=models.CASCADE, related_name='poll'
    )
    question = models.CharField(max_length=255, default="Who will win?")
    start_time = models.DateTimeField(default=timezone.now)
    end_time = models.DateTimeField(null=True, blank=True)
    status = models.CharField(
        max_length=20, choices=Status.choices, default=Status.ACTIVE, db_index=True
    )
    total_votes = models.IntegerField(default=0)
    is_featured = models.BooleanField(default=False)
    created_by = models.ForeignKey(
        'users_app.User', on_delete=models.SET_NULL, null=True, blank=True,
        related_name='created_polls'
    )
    created_at = models.DateTimeField(auto_now_add=True)
    updated_at = models.DateTimeField(auto_now=True)
    
    class Meta:
        db_table = 'polls'
        verbose_name = _('poll')
        verbose_name_plural = _('polls')
        ordering = ['-created_at']
        indexes = [
            models.Index(fields=['match', 'status']),
            models.Index(fields=['status', '-total_votes']),
        ]
    
    def __str__(self):
        return f"Poll: {self.match}"


class PollOption(models.Model):
    """Available choices in a poll (Home win / Draw / Away win)."""
    
    id = models.UUIDField(primary_key=True, default=uuid.uuid4, editable=False)
    poll = models.ForeignKey(
        Poll, on_delete=models.CASCADE, related_name='options'
    )
    label = models.CharField(max_length=100)
    team = models.ForeignKey(
        'teams.Team', on_delete=models.SET_NULL, null=True, blank=True,
        related_name='poll_options',
        help_text='Associated team (null for Draw option)'
    )
    option_type = models.CharField(
        max_length=20, choices=[
            ('home', 'Home Win'),
            ('draw', 'Draw'),
            ('away', 'Away Win'),
        ]
    )
    sort_order = models.IntegerField(default=0)
    vote_count = models.IntegerField(default=0)
    percentage = models.DecimalField(max_digits=5, decimal_places=2, default=0.00)
    created_at = models.DateTimeField(auto_now_add=True)
    
    class Meta:
        db_table = 'poll_options'
        verbose_name = _('poll option')
        verbose_name_plural = _('poll options')
        ordering = ['poll', 'sort_order']
    
    def __str__(self):
        return f"{self.label} ({self.vote_count} votes)"


class Vote(models.Model):
    """Individual user vote."""
    
    id = models.UUIDField(primary_key=True, default=uuid.uuid4, editable=False)
    poll = models.ForeignKey(
        Poll, on_delete=models.CASCADE, related_name='votes'
    )
    option = models.ForeignKey(
        PollOption, on_delete=models.CASCADE, related_name='votes'
    )
    user = models.ForeignKey(
        'users_app.User', on_delete=models.CASCADE, related_name='poll_votes'
    )
    ip_address = models.GenericIPAddressField(null=True, blank=True)
    user_agent = models.TextField(blank=True)
    voted_at = models.DateTimeField(auto_now_add=True)
    
    class Meta:
        db_table = 'votes'
        verbose_name = _('vote')
        verbose_name_plural = _('votes')
        unique_together = ['poll', 'user']
        indexes = [
            models.Index(fields=['poll', 'voted_at']),
            models.Index(fields=['user', 'poll']),
        ]
    
    def __str__(self):
        return f"Vote by {self.user.email} for {self.option.label}"


class PollResultCache(models.Model):
    """Cached aggregated poll results for fast reads."""
    
    id = models.UUIDField(primary_key=True, default=uuid.uuid4, editable=False)
    poll = models.OneToOneField(
        Poll, on_delete=models.CASCADE, related_name='result_cache'
    )
    results_json = models.JSONField()
    total_votes = models.IntegerField(default=0)
    last_calculated = models.DateTimeField(auto_now=True)
    
    class Meta:
        db_table = 'poll_result_caches'
        verbose_name = _('poll result cache')
        verbose_name_plural = _('poll result caches')
    
    def __str__(self):
        return f"Cache for {self.poll}"

"""
Serializers for polls app.
"""
from rest_framework import serializers
from .models import Poll, PollOption, Vote, PollResultCache


class PollOptionSerializer(serializers.ModelSerializer):
    """Poll option serializer."""
    
    team_name = serializers.CharField(source='team.name', read_only=True, allow_null=True)
    team_logo = serializers.CharField(source='team.logo_url', read_only=True, allow_null=True)
    
    class Meta:
        model = PollOption
        fields = [
            'id', 'label', 'team', 'team_name', 'team_logo',
            'option_type', 'sort_order', 'vote_count', 'percentage'
        ]


class PollListSerializer(serializers.ModelSerializer):
    """Compact poll serializer for lists."""
    
    match_info = serializers.SerializerMethodField()
    options = PollOptionSerializer(many=True, read_only=True)
    
    class Meta:
        model = Poll
        fields = [
            'id', 'match', 'match_info', 'question',
            'start_time', 'end_time', 'status', 'total_votes',
            'is_featured', 'options'
        ]
    
    def get_match_info(self, obj):
        return {
            'home_team': obj.match.home_team.name if obj.match.home_team else None,
            'away_team': obj.match.away_team.name if obj.match.away_team else None,
            'home_score': obj.match.home_score,
            'away_score': obj.match.away_score,
            'kickoff_time': obj.match.kickoff_time,
            'status': obj.match.status,
        }


class PollDetailSerializer(serializers.ModelSerializer):
    """Detailed poll serializer with full vote data."""
    
    match_info = serializers.SerializerMethodField()
    options = PollOptionSerializer(many=True, read_only=True)
    result_cache = serializers.SerializerMethodField()
    user_vote = serializers.SerializerMethodField()
    
    class Meta:
        model = Poll
        fields = [
            'id', 'match', 'match_info', 'question',
            'start_time', 'end_time', 'status', 'total_votes',
            'is_featured', 'created_at', 'options',
            'result_cache', 'user_vote'
        ]
    
    def get_match_info(self, obj):
        return {
            'id': str(obj.match.id),
            'home_team': obj.match.home_team.name if obj.match.home_team else None,
            'home_team_logo': obj.match.home_team.logo_url if obj.match.home_team else None,
            'away_team': obj.match.away_team.name if obj.match.away_team else None,
            'away_team_logo': obj.match.away_team.logo_url if obj.match.away_team else None,
            'home_score': obj.match.home_score,
            'away_score': obj.match.away_score,
            'kickoff_time': obj.match.kickoff_time.isoformat() if obj.match.kickoff_time else None,
            'status': obj.match.status,
        }
    
    def get_result_cache(self, obj):
        if hasattr(obj, 'result_cache') and obj.result_cache:
            return obj.result_cache.results_json
        return None
    
    def get_user_vote(self, obj):
        request = self.context.get('request')
        if request and request.user.is_authenticated:
            vote = obj.votes.filter(user=request.user).first()
            if vote:
                return {
                    'option_id': str(vote.option_id),
                    'voted_at': vote.voted_at.isoformat()
                }
        return None


class VoteSerializer(serializers.ModelSerializer):
    """Vote serializer."""
    
    user_email = serializers.CharField(source='user.email', read_only=True)
    
    class Meta:
        model = Vote
        fields = [
            'id', 'poll', 'option', 'user', 'user_email',
            'ip_address', 'voted_at'
        ]
        read_only_fields = ['user', 'ip_address', 'voted_at']


class CreateVoteSerializer(serializers.Serializer):
    """Serializer for creating a vote."""
    
    option_id = serializers.UUIDField()
    
    def validate_option_id(self, value):
        from polls.models import PollOption
        try:
            option = PollOption.objects.select_related('poll').get(id=value)
        except PollOption.DoesNotExist:
            raise serializers.ValidationError("Invalid option")
        
        if option.poll.status != 'active':
            raise serializers.ValidationError("Poll is not active")
        
        if option.poll.end_time and option.poll.end_time < timezone.now():
            raise serializers.ValidationError("Poll has ended")
        
        return value


class PollResultCacheSerializer(serializers.ModelSerializer):
    """Cached poll results serializer."""
    
    class Meta:
        model = PollResultCache
        fields = ['id', 'poll', 'results_json', 'total_votes', 'last_calculated']

--- FILE: polls/services/vote_service.py ---
"""
Enhanced vote service with analytics.
"""
import logging
from celery import shared_task
from django.db import transaction
from django.db.models import Count, Q
from django.utils import timezone
from django.core.cache import cache
from channels.layers import get_channel_layer
from asgiref.sync import async_to_sync
import json

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


class VoteAnalyticsService:
    """Service for tracking and analyzing votes."""
    
    @staticmethod
    def get_match_poll_trends(poll_id: str, hours: int = 24):
        """Get vote trends over time for a poll."""
        from polls.models import Vote
        
        cutoff = timezone.now() - timezone.timedelta(hours=hours)
        
        votes = Vote.objects.filter(
            poll_id=poll_id,
            voted_at__gte=cutoff
        ).extra({
            'hour': "strftime('%%H', voted_at)"
        }).values('hour', 'option_id').annotate(
            count=Count('id')
        )
        
        return list(votes)
    
    @staticmethod
    def get_live_poll_stats():
        """Get statistics for all live polls."""
        from polls.models import Poll
        
        live_polls = Poll.objects.filter(
            status='active',
            match__status__in=['live', 'half_time']
        ).select_related('match')
        
        stats = []
        for poll in live_polls:
            total_votes = poll.votes.count()
            stats.append({
                'poll_id': str(poll.id),
                'match': f"{poll.match.home_team.name} vs {poll.match.away_team.name}",
                'total_votes': total_votes,
                'options': [
                    {
                        'label': opt.label,
                        'votes': opt.votes.count(),
                        'percentage': round(opt.votes.count() / total_votes * 100, 1) if total_votes > 0 else 0
                    }
                    for opt in poll.options.all()
                ],
                'vote_rate': VoteAnalyticsService._calculate_vote_rate(poll)
            })
        
        return stats
    
    @staticmethod
    def _calculate_vote_rate(poll):
        """Calculate votes per minute rate."""
        first_vote = poll.votes.order_by('voted_at').first()
        if not first_vote:
            return 0
        
        minutes_passed = (timezone.now() - first_vote.voted_at).total_seconds() / 60
        if minutes_passed < 1:
            minutes_passed = 1
        
        return round(poll.votes.count() / minutes_passed, 2)


@shared_task
def broadcast_poll_update(poll_id: str):
    """Broadcast poll update to all connected WebSocket clients."""
    from polls.serializers import PollDetailSerializer
    from polls.models import Poll
    
    try:
        poll = Poll.objects.get(id=poll_id)
        serializer = PollDetailSerializer(poll)
        
        channel_layer = get_channel_layer()
        async_to_sync(channel_layer.group_send)(
            f'poll_{poll_id}',
            {
                'type': 'poll_update',
                'data': serializer.data
            }
        )
        logger.info(f"Broadcasted update for poll {poll_id}")
    except Poll.DoesNotExist:
        logger.error(f"Poll {poll_id} not found for broadcast")
    except Exception as e:
        logger.error(f"Error broadcasting poll update: {e}")

--- FILE: polls/services.py ---
"""
Service layer for polls app.
Contains business logic for poll operations.
"""
import logging
from django.db import transaction
from django.db.models import F
from django.utils import timezone

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


class PollService:
    """Service class for poll-related business logic."""
    
    @staticmethod
    @transaction.atomic
    def cast_vote(poll_id, option_id, user, ip_address=None, user_agent=None):
        """
        Cast or update a vote for a poll.
        Returns the updated poll data.
        """
        from .models import Poll, PollOption, Vote, PollResultCache
        
        poll = Poll.objects.select_for_update().get(id=poll_id)
        
        # Validate poll is active
        if poll.status != 'active':
            raise ValueError("Poll is not active")
        
        if poll.end_time and poll.end_time < timezone.now():
            raise ValueError("Poll has ended")
        
        # Find existing vote or create new
        vote, created = Vote.objects.update_or_create(
            poll=poll,
            user=user,
            defaults={
                'option_id': option_id,
                'ip_address': ip_address,
                'user_agent': user_agent or '',
            }
        )
        
        # Recalculate option counts
        PollService._recalculate_poll_results(poll)
        
        return poll
    
    @staticmethod
    def _recalculate_poll_results(poll):
        """Recalculate vote counts and percentages for a poll."""
        from .models import PollOption, PollResultCache
        
        total_votes = poll.votes.count()
        
        results = []
        for option in poll.options.all():
            votes = option.votes.count()
            percentage = round((votes / total_votes * 100), 2) if total_votes > 0 else 0
            
            option.vote_count = votes
            option.percentage = percentage
            option.save(update_fields=['vote_count', 'percentage'])
            
            results.append({
                'option_id': str(option.id),
                'label': option.label,
                'option_type': option.option_type,
                'team_id': str(option.team_id) if option.team_id else None,
                'votes': votes,
                'percentage': percentage,
            })
        
        # Update poll total
        poll.total_votes = total_votes
        poll.save(update_fields=['total_votes'])
        
        # Update cache
        PollResultCache.objects.update_or_create(
            poll=poll,
            defaults={
                'results_json': results,
                'total_votes': total_votes,
            }
        )
        
        return results
    
    @staticmethod
    def get_poll_results(poll_id):
        """Get cached poll results."""
        from .models import PollResultCache
        
        cache_obj = PollResultCache.objects.filter(poll_id=poll_id).first()
        
        if cache_obj:
            return {
                'poll_id': str(poll_id),
                'total_votes': cache_obj.total_votes,
                'results': cache_obj.results_json,
                'last_calculated': cache_obj.last_calculated.isoformat(),
            }
        return None
    
    @staticmethod
    @transaction.atomic
    def close_poll(poll_id):
        """Close a poll and finalize results."""
        from .models import Poll
        
        poll = Poll.objects.select_for_update().get(id=poll_id)
        poll.status = 'closed'
        poll.end_time = timezone.now()
        poll.save()
        
        logger.info(f"Closed poll {poll_id}")
        return poll
    
    @staticmethod
    def has_user_voted(poll_id, user_id):
        """Check if a user has voted in a poll."""
        from .models import Vote
        
        return Vote.objects.filter(poll_id=poll_id, user_id=user_id).exists()

--- FILE: polls/tasks.py ---
"""
Celery tasks for polls app.
"""
import logging
from celery import shared_task
from django.db.models import Count, F
from channels.layers import get_channel_layer
from asgiref.sync import async_to_sync

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


@shared_task(bind=True)
def update_poll_caches(self):
    """
    Update cached poll results for active polls.
    Runs every 10 seconds for live polling experience.
    """
    from polls.models import Poll, PollOption, PollResultCache
    
    active_polls = Poll.objects.filter(status='active').select_related('match')
    
    updated = 0
    channel_layer = get_channel_layer()
    
    for poll in active_polls:
        try:
            options = poll.options.all()
            total_votes = poll.votes.count()
            
            results = []
            for option in options:
                votes = option.votes.count()
                percentage = (votes / total_votes * 100) if total_votes > 0 else 0
                
                option.vote_count = votes
                option.percentage = round(percentage, 2)
                option.save(update_fields=['vote_count', 'percentage'])
                
                results.append({
                    'option_id': str(option.id),
                    'label': option.label,
                    'option_type': option.option_type,
                    'team_id': str(option.team_id) if option.team_id else None,
                    'votes': votes,
                    'percentage': round(percentage, 2),
                })
            
            # Update poll total
            poll.total_votes = total_votes
            poll.save(update_fields=['total_votes'])
            
            # Update cache
            PollResultCache.objects.update_or_create(
                poll=poll,
                defaults={
                    'results_json': results,
                    'total_votes': total_votes,
                }
            )
            
            # Broadcast to WebSocket
            async_to_sync(channel_layer.group_send)(
                f'poll_{poll.id}',
                {
                    'type': 'poll_update',
                    'data': {
                        'poll_id': str(poll.id),
                        'match_id': str(poll.match_id),
                        'total_votes': total_votes,
                        'results': results,
                    }
                }
            )
            
            updated += 1
            
        except Exception as exc:
            logger.error(f"Error updating poll cache {poll.id}: {exc}")
            continue
    
    return f"Updated {updated} poll caches"

"""
URL configuration for polls app.
"""
from django.urls import path, include
from rest_framework.routers import DefaultRouter
from .views import PollViewSet, PollOptionViewSet, PollResultCacheViewSet

router = DefaultRouter()
router.register(r'polls', PollViewSet, basename='poll')
router.register(r'options', PollOptionViewSet, basename='polloption')
router.register(r'result-caches', PollResultCacheViewSet, basename='pollcache')

urlpatterns = [
    path('', include(router.urls)),
]

"""
Views for polls app.
"""
from rest_framework import viewsets, filters, status
from rest_framework.decorators import action
from rest_framework.response import Response
from rest_framework.permissions import IsAuthenticated, AllowAny
from django_filters.rest_framework import DjangoFilterBackend
from django.utils import timezone
from django.db import transaction

from .models import Poll, PollOption, Vote, PollResultCache
from .serializers import (
    PollListSerializer, PollDetailSerializer,
    PollOptionSerializer, VoteSerializer, CreateVoteSerializer,
    PollResultCacheSerializer
)


class PollViewSet(viewsets.ReadOnlyModelViewSet):
    """ViewSet for polls."""
    
    queryset = Poll.objects.select_related(
        'match__home_team', 'match__away_team'
    ).prefetch_related('options', 'result_cache').all()
    
    filter_backends = [DjangoFilterBackend, filters.OrderingFilter]
    filterset_fields = ['match', 'status', 'is_featured']
    ordering_fields = ['created_at', 'total_votes', 'start_time']
    ordering = ['-created_at']
    
    def get_serializer_class(self):
        if self.action == 'list':
            return PollListSerializer
        return PollDetailSerializer
    
    @action(detail=False, methods=['get'])
    def active(self, request):
        """Get all active polls."""
        polls = Poll.objects.filter(
            status='active'
        ).select_related(
            'match__home_team', 'match__away_team'
        ).prefetch_related('options', 'result_cache').order_by('-total_votes')
        
        page = self.paginate_queryset(polls)
        if page is not None:
            serializer = PollListSerializer(page, many=True)
            return self.get_paginated_response(serializer.data)
        serializer = PollListSerializer(polls, many=True)
        return Response(serializer.data)
    
    @action(detail=False, methods=['get'])
    def featured(self, request):
        """Get featured polls."""
        polls = Poll.objects.filter(
            is_featured=True, status='active'
        ).select_related(
            'match__home_team', 'match__away_team'
        ).prefetch_related('options', 'result_cache').order_by('-total_votes')[:10]
        
        serializer = PollListSerializer(polls, many=True)
        return Response(serializer.data)
    
    @action(detail=True, methods=['post'], permission_classes=[IsAuthenticated])
    def vote(self, request, pk=None):
        """Cast a vote on a poll."""
        poll = self.get_object()
        
        # Validate poll is active
        if poll.status != 'active':
            return Response(
                {'error': 'Poll is not active'},
                status=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST
            )
        
        if poll.end_time and poll.end_time < timezone.now():
            return Response(
                {'error': 'Poll has ended'},
                status=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST
            )
        
        # Validate input
        serializer = CreateVoteSerializer(data=request.data)
        serializer.is_valid(raise_exception=True)
        
        option_id = serializer.validated_data['option_id']
        
        # Check if user already voted
        existing_vote = Vote.objects.filter(poll=poll, user=request.user).first()
        
        with transaction.atomic():
            if existing_vote:
                # Update existing vote
                existing_vote.option_id = option_id
                existing_vote.save()
                message = "Vote updated successfully"
            else:
                # Create new vote
                Vote.objects.create(
                    poll=poll,
                    option_id=option_id,
                    user=request.user,
                    ip_address=self._get_client_ip(request),
                    user_agent=request.META.get('HTTP_USER_AGENT', '')
                )
                message = "Vote recorded successfully"
            
            # Trigger cache update (async via Celery)
            from polls.tasks import update_poll_caches
            update_poll_caches.delay()
        
        # Return updated poll
        poll.refresh_from_db()
        return Response({
            'message': message,
            'poll': PollDetailSerializer(poll, context={'request': request}).data
        })
    
    def _get_client_ip(self, request):
        """Get client IP address."""
        x_forwarded_for = request.META.get('HTTP_X_FORWARDED_FOR')
        if x_forwarded_for:
            ip = x_forwarded_for.split(',')[0]
        else:
            ip = request.META.get('REMOTE_ADDR')
        return ip


class PollOptionViewSet(viewsets.ReadOnlyModelViewSet):
    """ViewSet for poll options."""
    
    queryset = PollOption.objects.select_related('poll', 'team').all()
    serializer_class = PollOptionSerializer
    filter_backends = [DjangoFilterBackend]
    filterset_fields = ['poll', 'option_type']


class PollResultCacheViewSet(viewsets.ReadOnlyModelViewSet):
    """ViewSet for poll result caches."""
    
    queryset = PollResultCache.objects.select_related('poll').all()
    serializer_class = PollResultCacheSerializer
    filter_backends = [DjangoFilterBackend]
    filterset_fields = ['poll']

"""
FastAPI real-time service for WebSocket connections.
This runs as a separate service alongside Django.
"""
import asyncio
import json
from typing import Dict, Set, Optional
from datetime import datetime
from fastapi import FastAPI, WebSocket, WebSocketDisconnect, Query
from fastapi.middleware.cors import CORSMiddleware
import redis.asyncio as aioredis
from pydantic import BaseModel

app = FastAPI(
    title="LiveScore Real-Time Service",
    version="1.0.0",
    description="WebSocket service for live sports updates"
)

# CORS
app.add_middleware(
    CORSMiddleware,
    allow_origins=["*"],
    allow_credentials=True,
    allow_methods=["*"],
    allow_headers=["*"],
)

# Redis connection
redis_client: Optional[aioredis.Redis] = None

# Connection managers for different channels
class ConnectionManager:
    """Manages WebSocket connections grouped by channel."""
    
    def __init__(self):
        self.active_connections: Dict[str, Set[WebSocket]] = {}
    
    async def connect(self, websocket: WebSocket, channel: str):
        await websocket.accept()
        if channel not in self.active_connections:
            self.active_connections[channel] = set()
        self.active_connections[channel].add(websocket)
    
    def disconnect(self, websocket: WebSocket, channel: str):
        if channel in self.active_connections:
            self.active_connections[channel].discard(websocket)
            if not self.active_connections[channel]:
                del self.active_connections[channel]
    
    async def broadcast(self, channel: str, message: dict):
        """Send message to all connections in a channel."""
        if channel in self.active_connections:
            dead_connections = set()
            for connection in self.active_connections[channel]:
                try:
                    await connection.send_json(message)
                except WebSocketDisconnect:
                    dead_connections.add(connection)
                except Exception:
                    dead_connections.add(connection)
            
            # Clean dead connections
            for conn in dead_connections:
                self.disconnect(conn, channel)
    
    async def send_personal(self, websocket: WebSocket, message: dict):
        """Send message to a specific connection."""
        try:
            await websocket.send_json(message)
        except Exception:
            pass
    
    def get_channel_stats(self):
        """Get connection statistics."""
        return {
            channel: len(connections)
            for channel, connections in self.active_connections.items()
        }


manager = ConnectionManager()


@app.on_event("startup")
async def startup():
    """Initialize Redis connection and start listener."""
    global redis_client
    
    redis_client = aioredis.from_url(
        "redis://127.0.0.1:6379/2",
        encoding="utf-8",
        decode_responses=True
    )
    
    # Start Redis listener task
    asyncio.create_task(redis_listener_task())
    
    print("🚀 FastAPI real-time service started")


@app.on_event("shutdown")
async def shutdown():
    """Cleanup on shutdown."""
    global redis_client
    if redis_client:
        await redis_client.close()
    print("👋 FastAPI real-time service stopped")


@app.get("/")
async def root():
    """Health check endpoint."""
    return {
        "service": "LiveScore Real-Time Service",
        "status": "running",
        "connections": manager.get_channel_stats(),
        "timestamp": datetime.utcnow().isoformat()
    }


@app.get("/health")
async def health():
    """Detailed health check."""
    redis_status = "connected" if redis_client and await redis_client.ping() else "disconnected"
    return {
        "status": "healthy",
        "redis": redis_status,
        "active_channels": len(manager.active_connections),
        "connections": manager.get_channel_stats(),
    }


@app.websocket("/ws/match/{match_id}")
async def match_websocket(websocket: WebSocket, match_id: str):
    """
    WebSocket endpoint for live match updates.
    Clients connect here to receive real-time match data.
    """
    channel = f"match_{match_id}"
    await manager.connect(websocket, channel)
    
    try:
        # Send initial match data from Redis cache
        if redis_client:
            cached = await redis_client.get(f"cache:match:{match_id}")
            if cached:
                await websocket.send_json({
                    "type": "initial_state",
                    "data": json.loads(cached)
                })
        
        # Keep connection alive and handle client messages
        while True:
            data = await websocket.receive_text()
            message = json.loads(data)
            
            if message.get("type") == "ping":
                await websocket.send_json({"type": "pong", "timestamp": datetime.utcnow().isoformat()})
            elif message.get("type") == "subscribe_events":
                # Client wants specific event types
                pass
            
    except WebSocketDisconnect:
        manager.disconnect(websocket, channel)
    except Exception as e:
        manager.disconnect(websocket, channel)
        print(f"WebSocket error for match {match_id}: {e}")

@app.post("/api/v1/polls/{poll_id}/vote")
async def vote_poll(
    poll_id: str,
    user_id: str = Query(...),
    option_id: str = Query(...)
):
    """
    HTTP endpoint for voting (can be used by mobile apps or as fallback).
    """
    # In production, validate vote and save to database
    # Then publish update to Redis
    
    if redis_client:
        vote_data = {
            "poll_id": poll_id,
            "user_id": user_id,
            "option_id": option_id,
            "timestamp": datetime.utcnow().isoformat()
        }
        await redis_client.publish(
            f"poll_{poll_id}",
            json.dumps({"type": "new_vote", "data": vote_data})
        )
    
    return {"status": "accepted", "poll_id": poll_id, "option_id": option_id}


async def redis_listener_task():
    """
    Background task that listens to Redis pub/sub channels
    and forwards messages to WebSocket clients.
    """
    if not redis_client:
        return
    
    pubsub = redis_client.pubsub()
    
    # Subscribe to all relevant patterns
    await pubsub.psubscribe("match_*", "live_matches", "poll_*", "competition_*")
    
    print("📡 Redis listener started - waiting for messages...")
    
    async for message in pubsub.listen():
        if message["type"] == "pmessage":
            try:
                channel = message["channel"]
                data = json.loads(message["data"])
                
                # Forward to WebSocket connections
                await manager.broadcast(channel, data)
                
            except json.JSONDecodeError:
                pass
            except Exception as e:
                print(f"Error processing Redis message: {e}")

    )

from pydantic import BaseModel

from datetime import datetime


class MatchEvent(BaseModel):
    """Match event model."""
    id: str
    event_type: str
    minute: int
    player_name: str
    team_name: str
    description: Optional[str] = None


class LiveMatchState(BaseModel):
    """Live match state model."""
    match_id: str
    current_minute: int
    home_score: int
    away_score: int
    possession: dict
    momentum: str
    last_events: List[dict] = []
    attacks: List[dict] = []
    dangerous_attacks: List[dict] = []


class PollResult(BaseModel):
    """Poll result model."""
    poll_id: str
    total_votes: int
    results: List[dict]


class WebSocketMessage(BaseModel):
    """Generic WebSocket message."""
    type: str
    data: Optional[dict] = None
    timestamp: Optional[str] = None

"""
Redis pub/sub listener for the FastAPI real-time service.
Listens for events published by Django/Celery and forwards them to WebSocket clients.
"""
import asyncio
import json
import logging
from typing import Optional
import redis.asyncio as aioredis

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


class RedisListener:
    """
    Listens to Redis pub/sub channels and processes messages
    for real-time WebSocket delivery.
    """
    
    def __init__(self, redis_url: str = "redis://127.0.0.1:6379/2"):
        self.redis_url = redis_url
        self.redis_client: Optional[aioredis.Redis] = None
        self.pubsub: Optional[aioredis.client.PubSub] = None
        self.is_running = False
        self.handlers = {}
        self.connection_manager = None
    
    def set_connection_manager(self, manager):
        """Set the WebSocket connection manager for broadcasting."""
        self.connection_manager = manager
    
    def register_handler(self, channel_pattern: str, handler):
        """Register a handler for a specific channel pattern."""
        self.handlers[channel_pattern] = handler
    
    async def connect(self):
        """Connect to Redis and start listening."""
        try:
            self.redis_client = aioredis.from_url(
                self.redis_url,
                encoding="utf-8",
                decode_responses=True
            )
            
            # Test connection
            await self.redis_client.ping()
            
            self.pubsub = self.redis_client.pubsub()
            self.is_running = True
            
            logger.info(f"Connected to Redis at {self.redis_url}")
            
        except Exception as e:
            logger.error(f"Failed to connect to Redis: {e}")
            raise
    
    async def subscribe(self, *channels):
        """Subscribe to Redis channels."""
        if not self.pubsub:
            raise RuntimeError("Not connected to Redis")
        
        await self.pubsub.subscribe(*channels)
        logger.info(f"Subscribed to channels: {channels}")
    
    async def psubscribe(self, *patterns):
        """Subscribe to Redis channel patterns."""
        if not self.pubsub:
            raise RuntimeError("Not connected to Redis")
        
        await self.pubsub.psubscribe(*patterns)
        logger.info(f"Subscribed to patterns: {patterns}")
    
    async def listen(self):
        """
        Main listening loop.
        Processes messages and routes them to appropriate handlers.
        """
        if not self.pubsub:
            raise RuntimeError("Not connected to Redis")
        
        logger.info("Starting Redis listener loop...")
        
        async for message in self.pubsub.listen():
            if not self.is_running:
                break
            
            try:
                await self._process_message(message)
            except Exception as e:
                logger.error(f"Error processing message: {e}")
    
    async def _process_message(self, message: dict):
        """Process a single Redis message."""
        # Skip subscription confirmations
        if message["type"] not in ("message", "pmessage"):
            return
        
        channel = message.get("channel", "")
        
        # Try to parse data as JSON
        try:
            data = json.loads(message["data"])
        except (json.JSONDecodeError, TypeError):
            data = message["data"]
        
        # Route to specific handlers based on channel
        if channel.startswith("match_") and self.connection_manager:
            await self._handle_match_update(channel, data)
        
        elif channel == "live_matches" and self.connection_manager:
            await self._handle_live_matches_update(data)
        
        elif channel.startswith("poll_") and self.connection_manager:
            await self._handle_poll_update(channel, data)
        
        elif channel.startswith("competition_") and self.connection_manager:
            await self._handle_competition_update(channel, data)
        
        elif channel.startswith("notification_") and self.connection_manager:
            await self._handle_notification(channel, data)
        
        # Call custom handlers if registered
        for pattern, handler in self.handlers.items():
            if self._channel_matches_pattern(channel, pattern):
                await handler(channel, data)
    
    async def _handle_match_update(self, channel: str, data: dict):
        """Forward match updates to WebSocket clients."""
        match_id = channel.replace("match_", "")
        
        await self.connection_manager.broadcast(
            f"match_{match_id}",
            data
        )
    
    async def _handle_live_matches_update(self, data):
        """Forward live matches summary to WebSocket clients."""
        await self.connection_manager.broadcast(
            "live_matches",
            {
                "type": "live_matches_update",
                "data": data if isinstance(data, dict) else {"matches": data}
            }
        )
    
    async def _handle_poll_update(self, channel: str, data: dict):
        """Forward poll updates to WebSocket clients."""
        await self.connection_manager.broadcast(channel, data)
    
    async def _handle_competition_update(self, channel: str, data: dict):
        """Forward competition updates (standings, etc.) to WebSocket clients."""
        await self.connection_manager.broadcast(channel, data)
    
    async def _handle_notification(self, channel: str, data: dict):
        """Forward notifications to specific user channels."""
        user_id = data.get("user_id")
        if user_id:
            await self.connection_manager.broadcast(
                f"user_{user_id}",
                {
                    "type": "notification",
                    "data": data
                }
            )
    
    @staticmethod
    def _channel_matches_pattern(channel: str, pattern: str) -> bool:
        """Check if a channel matches a pattern."""
        import fnmatch
        return fnmatch.fnmatch(channel, pattern)
    
    async def stop(self):
        """Stop the listener and cleanup."""
        self.is_running = False
        
        if self.pubsub:
            await self.pubsub.unsubscribe()
            await self.pubsub.punsubscribe()
        
        if self.redis_client:
            await self.redis_client.close()
        
        logger.info("Redis listener stopped")
    
    async def reconnect(self):
        """Attempt to reconnect to Redis."""
        retry_count = 0
        max_retries = 10
        
        while retry_count < max_retries and self.is_running:
            try:
                await self.connect()
                
                # Re-subscribe to patterns
                await self.psubscribe(
                    "match_*",
                    "live_matches",
                    "poll_*",
                    "competition_*",
                    "notification_*"
                )
                
                logger.info("Reconnected to Redis")
                return True
                
            except Exception as e:
                retry_count += 1
                wait_time = min(2 ** retry_count, 60)
                logger.warning(
                    f"Reconnection attempt {retry_count}/{max_retries} failed: {e}. "
                    f"Retrying in {wait_time}s..."
                )
                await asyncio.sleep(wait_time)
        
        logger.error("Failed to reconnect to Redis after maximum retries")
        return False


class MatchDataProcessor:
    """Processes and enriches match data from Redis messages."""
    
    @staticmethod
    def process_match_event(event_data: dict) -> dict:
        """Process and validate a match event."""
        event_types = {
            'goal': 'Goal',
            'penalty_goal': 'Penalty Goal',
            'own_goal': 'Own Goal',
            'penalty_miss': 'Penalty Miss',
            'yellow_card': 'Yellow Card',
            'second_yellow': 'Second Yellow',
            'red_card': 'Red Card',
            'substitution_in': 'Substitution In',
            'substitution_out': 'Substitution Out',
            'assist': 'Assist',
            'half_time': 'Half Time',
            'full_time': 'Full Time',
        }
        
        return {
            'id': event_data.get('id'),
            'event_type': event_data.get('event_type'),
            'event_type_display': event_types.get(event_data.get('event_type'), 'Event'),
            'minute': event_data.get('minute', 0),
            'injury_minute': event_data.get('injury_minute'),
            'player_name': event_data.get('player_name', ''),
            'team_name': event_data.get('team_name', ''),
            'description': event_data.get('description', ''),
            'score': f"{event_data.get('score_home', 0)} - {event_data.get('score_away', 0)}",
        }
    
    @staticmethod
    def process_live_state(state_data: dict) -> dict:
        """Process and validate live match state."""
        return {
            'current_minute': state_data.get('current_minute', 0),
            'injury_minute': state_data.get('injury_minute'),
            'home_score': state_data.get('home_score', 0),
            'away_score': state_data.get('away_score', 0),
            'possession': state_data.get('possession', {'home': 50, 'away': 50}),
            'momentum': state_data.get('momentum', 'balanced'),
            'attacks': state_data.get('attacks', [])[-5:],  # Keep last 5
            'dangerous_attacks': state_data.get('dangerous_attacks', [])[-5:],
            'last_events': [
                MatchDataProcessor.process_match_event(e)
                for e in state_data.get('last_events', [])
            ],
            'match_status': state_data.get('match_status', 'scheduled'),
        }


class PollDataProcessor:
    """Processes poll data from Redis messages."""
    
    @staticmethod
    def process_poll_update(data: dict) -> dict:
        """Process poll update data for WebSocket delivery."""
        return {
            'poll_id': data.get('poll_id'),
            'match_id': data.get('match_id'),
            'total_votes': data.get('total_votes', 0),
            'results': data.get('results', []),
            'timestamp': data.get('timestamp'),
        }
    
    @staticmethod
    def process_new_vote(data: dict) -> dict:
        """Process a single new vote for real-time update."""
        return {
            'poll_id': data.get('poll_id'),
            'option_id': data.get('option_id'),
            'user_id': data.get('user_id'),
            'timestamp': data.get('timestamp'),
        }

"""
Django admin configuration for standings app.
"""
from django.contrib import admin
from django.utils.html import format_html
from django.urls import reverse
from .models import Standing, TeamStanding, StandingRule


class TeamStandingInline(admin.TabularInline):
    """Inline team standings within standing admin."""
    
    model = TeamStanding
    extra = 0
    fields = [
        'team', 'position', 'played', 'wins', 'draws', 'losses',
        'goals_for', 'goals_against', 'goal_difference', 'points'
    ]
    raw_id_fields = ['team']
    ordering = ['position']


@admin.register(Standing)
class StandingAdmin(admin.ModelAdmin):
    """Admin view for Standing model."""
    
    list_display = [
        'standing_name', 'competition_season', 'stage',
        'group', 'standing_type', 'is_live', 'last_calculated'
    ]
    list_filter = [
        'standing_type', 'is_live',
        'competition_season__competition'
    ]
    search_fields = [
        'competition_season__name',
        'stage__name', 'group__name'
    ]
    readonly_fields = ['created_at', 'updated_at', 'last_calculated']
    inlines = [TeamStandingInline]
    autocomplete_fields = ['competition_season', 'stage', 'group']
    
    fieldsets = (
        ('Context', {
            'fields': ('competition_season', 'stage', 'group', 'standing_type')
        }),
        ('Status', {
            'fields': ('is_live', 'last_calculated')
        }),
        ('Timestamps', {
            'fields': ('created_at', 'updated_at'),
            'classes': ('collapse',)
        }),
    )
    
    def standing_name(self, obj):
        base = f'{obj.competition_season}'
        if obj.group:
            base += f' - {obj.group.name}'
        return f'{base} ({obj.get_standing_type_display()})'
    standing_name.short_description = 'Standing'


@admin.register(TeamStanding)
class TeamStandingAdmin(admin.ModelAdmin):
    """Admin view for TeamStanding model."""
    
    list_display = [
        'position', 'team', 'standing_link', 'played',
        'wins', 'draws', 'losses', 'goals_for', 'goals_against',
        'goal_difference', 'points', 'form_display'
    ]
    list_filter = ['standing__competition_season__competition']
    search_fields = ['team__name', 'standing__competition_season__name']
    readonly_fields = ['created_at', 'updated_at']
    autocomplete_fields = ['standing', 'team']
    
    fieldsets = (
        ('Position', {
            'fields': ('standing', 'team', 'position')
        }),
        ('Overall Record', {
            'fields': (
                'played', 'wins', 'draws', 'losses',
                'goals_for', 'goals_against', 'goal_difference', 'points'
            )
        }),
        ('Home Record', {
            'fields': (
                'home_played', 'home_wins', 'home_draws', 'home_losses',
                'home_goals_for', 'home_goals_against'
            )
        }),
        ('Away Record', {
            'fields': (
                'away_played', 'away_wins', 'away_draws', 'away_losses',
                'away_goals_for', 'away_goals_against'
            )
        }),
        ('Additional', {
            'fields': (
                'form', 'clean_sheets', 'failed_to_score',
                'points_deduction', 'metadata'
            )
        }),
        ('Timestamps', {
            'fields': ('created_at', 'updated_at'),
            'classes': ('collapse',)
        }),
    )
    
    def standing_link(self, obj):
        url = reverse('admin:standings_standing_change', args=[obj.standing_id])
        return format_html('<a href="{}">{}</a>', url, obj.standing)
    standing_link.short_description = 'Standing'
    
    def form_display(self, obj):
        if obj.form:
            html = ''
            for char in obj.form:
                colors = {'W': '#22c55e', 'D': '#eab308', 'L': '#ef4444'}
                color = colors.get(char, '#6b7280')
                html += f'<span style="display:inline-block;width:20px;height:20px;border-radius:50%;background:{color};color:white;text-align:center;line-height:20px;font-size:10px;margin:1px;font-weight:bold;">{char}</span>'
            return format_html(html)
        return '-'
    form_display.short_description = 'Form'

        }),
    )

--- FILE: standings/models.py ---
"""
Standings-related models: standings tables, team standings, ranking rules.
"""
import uuid
from django.db import models
from django.core.validators import MinValueValidator
from django.utils.translation import gettext_lazy as _


class Standing(models.Model):
    """Table container for a competition stage or group."""
    
    class StandingType(models.TextChoices):
        TOTAL = 'total', _('Total')
        HOME = 'home', _('Home')
        AWAY = 'away', _('Away')
        FORM = 'form', _('Form')
    
    id = models.UUIDField(primary_key=True, default=uuid.uuid4, editable=False)
    competition_season = models.ForeignKey(
        'competitions.Season', on_delete=models.CASCADE, related_name='standings'
    )
    stage = models.ForeignKey(
        'competitions.Stage', on_delete=models.CASCADE, related_name='standings'
    )
    group = models.ForeignKey(
        'competitions.Group', on_delete=models.SET_NULL, null=True, blank=True,
        related_name='standings'
    )
    standing_type = models.CharField(
        max_length=20, choices=StandingType.choices, default=StandingType.TOTAL
    )
    is_live = models.BooleanField(default=False)
    last_calculated = models.DateTimeField(null=True, blank=True)
    created_at = models.DateTimeField(auto_now_add=True)
    updated_at = models.DateTimeField(auto_now=True)
    
    class Meta:
        db_table = 'standings'
        verbose_name = _('standing')
        verbose_name_plural = _('standings')
        unique_together = [['competition_season', 'stage', 'group', 'standing_type']]
        indexes = [
            models.Index(fields=['competition_season', 'stage']),
            models.Index(fields=['is_live']),
        ]
    
    def __str__(self):
        base = f"{self.competition_season} - {self.stage}"
        if self.group:
            base += f" - {self.group.name}"
        return f"{base} ({self.get_standing_type_display()})"


class TeamStanding(models.Model):
    """Team position in a standings table."""
    
    id = models.UUIDField(primary_key=True, default=uuid.uuid4, editable=False)
    standing = models.ForeignKey(
        Standing, on_delete=models.CASCADE, related_name='team_standings'
    )
    group = models.ForeignKey(
        'competitions.Group', on_delete=models.CASCADE, related_name='team_standings',
        null=True, blank=True
    )
    team = models.ForeignKey(
        'teams.Team', on_delete=models.CASCADE, related_name='standings_entries'
    )
    position = models.IntegerField(validators=[MinValueValidator(1)])
    played = models.IntegerField(default=0)
    wins = models.IntegerField(default=0)
    draws = models.IntegerField(default=0)
    losses = models.IntegerField(default=0)
    goals_for = models.IntegerField(default=0)
    goals_against = models.IntegerField(default=0)
    goal_difference = models.IntegerField(default=0)
    points = models.IntegerField(default=0)
    
    # Home/Away specific
    home_played = models.IntegerField(default=0)
    home_wins = models.IntegerField(default=0)
    home_draws = models.IntegerField(default=0)
    home_losses = models.IntegerField(default=0)
    home_goals_for = models.IntegerField(default=0)
    home_goals_against = models.IntegerField(default=0)
    
    away_played = models.IntegerField(default=0)
    away_wins = models.IntegerField(default=0)
    away_draws = models.IntegerField(default=0)
    away_losses = models.IntegerField(default=0)
    away_goals_for = models.IntegerField(default=0)
    away_goals_against = models.IntegerField(default=0)
    
    # Form (last 5 matches)
    form = models.CharField(max_length=5, blank=True, help_text='e.g., WWDLW')
    
    # Additional metrics
    clean_sheets = models.IntegerField(default=0)
    failed_to_score = models.IntegerField(default=0)
    points_deduction = models.IntegerField(default=0)
    metadata = models.JSONField(default=dict, blank=True)
    created_at = models.DateTimeField(auto_now_add=True)
    updated_at = models.DateTimeField(auto_now=True)
    
    class Meta:
        db_table = 'team_standings'
        verbose_name = _('team standing')
        verbose_name_plural = _('team standings')
        unique_together = [['standing', 'team']]
        ordering = ['standing', 'position']
        indexes = [
            models.Index(fields=['standing', 'position']),
            models.Index(fields=['team']),
        ]
    
    def __str__(self):
        return f"{self.team.name} - {self.position}th ({self.points} pts)"


class StandingRule(models.Model):
    """Defines ranking/tie-breaker logic."""
    
    class RuleType(models.TextChoices):
        POINTS = 'points', _('Points')
        GOAL_DIFFERENCE = 'goal_difference', _('Goal Difference')
        GOALS_FOR = 'goals_for', _('Goals For')
        HEAD_TO_HEAD = 'head_to_head', _('Head to Head')
        AWAY_GOALS = 'away_goals', _('Away Goals')
        FAIR_PLAY = 'fair_play', _('Fair Play')
        DRAWING_LOTS = 'drawing_lots', _('Drawing of Lots')
    
    id = models.UUIDField(primary_key=True, default=uuid.uuid4, editable=False)
    competition = models.ForeignKey(
        'competitions.Competition', on_delete=models.CASCADE, related_name='standing_rules'
    )
    rule_type = models.CharField(
        max_length=20, choices=RuleType.choices
    )
    priority = models.IntegerField(validators=[MinValueValidator(1)])
    description = models.TextField(blank=True)
    is_active = models.BooleanField(default=True)
    created_at = models.DateTimeField(auto_now_add=True)
    
    class Meta:
        db_table = 'standing_rules'
        verbose_name = _('standing rule')
        verbose_name_plural = _('standing rules')
        ordering = ['competition', 'priority']
        unique_together = [['competition', 'priority']]
    
    def __str__(self):
        return f"{self.competition.name}: {self.get_rule_type_display()} (Priority {self.priority})"

"""
Serializers for standings app.
