/**
 * Utility functions for formatting data across the application.
 */

/**
 * Format a date string into a human-readable format.
 * @param {string|Date} date - Date to format
 * @param {Object} options - Intl.DateTimeFormat options
 * @returns {string}
 */
export function formatDate(date, options = {}) {
    if (!date) return ''

    const defaultOptions = {
        year: 'numeric',
        month: 'short',
        day: 'numeric',
        ...options,
    }

    try {
        const dateObj = typeof date === 'string' ? new Date(date) : date
        return new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-US', defaultOptions).format(dateObj)
    } catch (err) {
        console.warn('Invalid date:', date)
        return ''
    }
}

/**
 * Format a date string as relative time (e.g., "2 hours ago").
 * @param {string|Date} date
 * @returns {string}
 */
export function formatRelativeTime(date) {
    if (!date) return ''

    const now = new Date()
    const then = typeof date === 'string' ? new Date(date) : date
    const diffMs = now - then
    const diffSeconds = Math.floor(diffMs / 1000)
    const diffMinutes = Math.floor(diffSeconds / 60)
    const diffHours = Math.floor(diffMinutes / 60)
    const diffDays = Math.floor(diffHours / 24)

    if (diffSeconds < 60) return 'Just now'
    if (diffMinutes < 60) return `${diffMinutes}m ago`
    if (diffHours < 24) return `${diffHours}h ago`
    if (diffDays < 7) return `${diffDays}d ago`
    return formatDate(date)
}

/**
 * Format a time string (HH:MM).
 * @param {string|Date} date
 * @returns {string}
 */
export function formatTime(date) {
    if (!date) return ''

    try {
        const dateObj = typeof date === 'string' ? new Date(date) : date
        return dateObj.toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' })
    } catch {
        return ''
    }
}

/**
 * Format a kickoff time with relative labeling.
 * @param {string} dateString
 * @returns {string}
 */
export function formatKickoffTime(dateString) {
    if (!dateString) return 'TBD'

    const now = new Date()
    const kickoff = new Date(dateString)
    const diffHours = (kickoff - now) / (1000 * 60 * 60)

    if (diffHours < 0) {
        // Past
        if (diffHours > -2) return 'Just finished'
        return formatDate(dateString)
    }

    if (diffHours < 1) return `In ${Math.round(diffHours * 60)} min`
    if (diffHours < 24) return `Today ${formatTime(dateString)}`
    if (diffHours < 48) return `Tomorrow ${formatTime(dateString)}`
    return formatDate(dateString) + ' ' + formatTime(dateString)
}

/**
 * Format a number with separators (e.g., 1,500,000).
 * @param {number} num
 * @returns {string}
 */
export function formatNumber(num) {
    if (num === null || num === undefined) return '0'
    return Number(num).toLocaleString()
}

/**
 * Format a large number with abbreviations (e.g., 1.5M).
 * @param {number} num
 * @returns {string}
 */
export function formatCompactNumber(num) {
    if (num === null || num === undefined) return '0'
    if (num >= 1_000_000) return (num / 1_000_000).toFixed(1) + 'M'
    if (num >= 1_000) return (num / 1_000).toFixed(1) + 'K'
    return num.toString()
}

/**
 * Format a score string.
 * @param {number} home
 * @param {number} away
 * @returns {string}
 */
export function formatScore(home, away) {
    if (home === null || home === undefined) return 'vs'
    return `${home} - ${away}`
}

/**
 * Get a human-readable match status label.
 * @param {string} status
 * @returns {string}
 */
export function getMatchStatusLabel(status) {
    const labels = {
        scheduled: 'Scheduled',
        live: 'Live',
        half_time: 'Half Time',
        finished: 'Full Time',
        postponed: 'Postponed',
        cancelled: 'Cancelled',
        suspended: 'Suspended',
    }
    return labels[status] || status || 'Unknown'
}

/**
 * Get CSS class for match status badge.
 * @param {string} status
 * @returns {string}
 */
export function getMatchStatusClass(status) {
    const classes = {
        scheduled: 'bg-blue-100 text-blue-800',
        live: 'bg-red-100 text-red-800',
        half_time: 'bg-orange-100 text-orange-800',
        finished: 'bg-gray-100 text-gray-800',
        postponed: 'bg-yellow-100 text-yellow-800',
        cancelled: 'bg-red-100 text-red-800',
    }
    return classes[status] || 'bg-gray-100 text-gray-800'
}

/**
 * Get event icon emoji.
 * @param {string} eventType
 * @returns {string}
 */
export function getEventIcon(eventType) {
    const icons = {
        goal: '⚽',
        penalty_goal: '🥅',
        own_goal: '🔴',
        penalty_miss: '❌',
        yellow_card: '🟨',
        second_yellow: '🟨🟥',
        red_card: '🟥',
        substitution_in: '🟢',
        substitution_out: '🔴',
        assist: '🅰️',
        half_time: '⏸️',
        full_time: '⏹️',
    }
    return icons[eventType] || '📌'
}

/**
 * Format possession percentage string.
 * @param {Object} possession - { home: number, away: number }
 * @returns {string}
 */
export function formatPossession(possession) {
    if (!possession) return '50% - 50%'
    return `${possession.home || 50}% - ${possession.away || 50}%`
}

/**
 * Truncate text with ellipsis.
 * @param {string} text
 * @param {number} maxLength
 * @returns {string}
 */
export function truncateText(text, maxLength = 100) {
    if (!text || text.length <= maxLength) return text || ''
    return text.substring(0, maxLength).trim() + '...'
}

/**
 * Get country flag emoji from country name.
 * This is a simple mapping; production would use a proper library.
 * @param {string} country
 * @returns {string}
 */
export function getCountryFlag(country) {
    if (!country) return '🏳️'
    const flags = {
        England: '🏴󠁧󠁢󠁥󠁮󠁧󠁿',
        Spain: '🇪🇸',
        France: '🇫🇷',
        Germany: '🇩🇪',
        Italy: '🇮🇹',
        Portugal: '🇵🇹',
        Netherlands: '🇳🇱',
        Belgium: '🇧🇪',
        Brazil: '🇧🇷',
        Argentina: '🇦🇷',
        Norway: '🇳🇴',
        Egypt: '🇪🇬',
        USA: '🇺🇸',
        International: '🌍',
    }
    return flags[country] || '🏳️'
}

/**
 * Format a currency value.
 * @param {number} value
 * @param {string} currency
 * @returns {string}
 */
export function formatCurrency(value, currency = 'EUR') {
    if (!value) return '-'
    const symbols = { EUR: '€', GBP: '£', USD: '$' }
    const symbol = symbols[currency] || currency + ' '
    return `${symbol}${formatCompactNumber(value)}`
}

--- FILE: frontend/src/utils/websocket.js ---
/**
 * WebSocket connection manager for real-time features.
 * Handles connection lifecycle, reconnection, and message routing.
 */

class WebSocketManager {
    constructor() {
        this.connections = new Map()
        this.listeners = new Map()
        this.reconnectTimers = new Map()
        this.defaultReconnectDelay = 3000
        this.maxReconnectAttempts = 10
    }

    /**
     * Get the WebSocket base URL based on current protocol.
     */
    getBaseUrl() {
        const protocol = window.location.protocol === 'https:' ? 'wss:' : 'ws:'
        const host = import.meta.env.VITE_WS_HOST || 'localhost:8001'
        return `${protocol}//${host}`
    }

    /**
     * Connect to a WebSocket endpoint.
     * @param {string} key - Unique identifier for this connection
     * @param {string} endpoint - WebSocket endpoint path (e.g., '/ws/match/123')
     * @param {Object} options - Connection options
     * @returns {WebSocket}
     */
    connect(key, endpoint, options = {}) {
        // Close existing connection for this key
        if (this.connections.has(key)) {
            this.disconnect(key)
        }

        const url = `${this.getBaseUrl()}${endpoint}`
        const ws = new WebSocket(url)
        const reconnectAttempts = { count: 0 }

        ws.onopen = () => {
            console.log(`[WS] Connected: ${key}`)
            reconnectAttempts.count = 0

            // Start ping interval
            if (options.pingInterval !== false) {
                const interval = options.pingInterval || 30000
                ws._pingTimer = setInterval(() => {
                    if (ws.readyState === WebSocket.OPEN) {
                        ws.send(JSON.stringify({ type: 'ping' }))
                    }
                }, interval)
            }

            if (options.onOpen) options.onOpen()
        }

        ws.onmessage = (event) => {
            try {
                const data = JSON.parse(event.data)

                // Handle pong
                if (data.type === 'pong') return

                // Notify specific listeners
                if (this.listeners.has(key)) {
                    this.listeners.get(key).forEach(callback => callback(data))
                }

                if (options.onMessage) options.onMessage(data)
            } catch (err) {
                console.error(`[WS] Failed to parse message for ${key}:`, err)
            }
        }

        ws.onerror = (error) => {
            console.error(`[WS] Error on ${key}:`, error)
            if (options.onError) options.onError(error)
        }

        ws.onclose = (event) => {
            console.log(`[WS] Disconnected: ${key} (code: ${event.code})`)
            clearInterval(ws._pingTimer)

            // Auto-reconnect
            if (options.autoReconnect !== false && reconnectAttempts.count < this.maxReconnectAttempts) {
                const delay = options.reconnectDelay || this.defaultReconnectDelay
                reconnectAttempts.count++

                console.log(`[WS] Reconnecting ${key} in ${delay}ms (attempt ${reconnectAttempts.count})`)

                this.reconnectTimers.set(key, setTimeout(() => {
                    this.connect(key, endpoint, options)
                }, delay))
            }

            if (options.onClose) options.onClose(event)
            this.connections.delete(key)
        }

        this.connections.set(key, ws)
        return ws
    }

    /**
     * Disconnect a WebSocket connection.
     */
    disconnect(key) {
        const timer = this.reconnectTimers.get(key)
        if (timer) {
            clearTimeout(timer)
            this.reconnectTimers.delete(key)
        }

        const ws = this.connections.get(key)
        if (ws) {
            clearInterval(ws._pingTimer)
            ws.close()
            this.connections.delete(key)
        }
    }

    /**
     * Disconnect all WebSocket connections.
     */
    disconnectAll() {
        this.reconnectTimers.forEach(timer => clearTimeout(timer))
        this.reconnectTimers.clear()

        this.connections.forEach((ws, key) => {
            clearInterval(ws._pingTimer)
            ws.close()
        })
        this.connections.clear()
    }

    /**
     * Send a message through a connection.
     */
    send(key, data) {
        const ws = this.connections.get(key)
        if (ws && ws.readyState === WebSocket.OPEN) {
            ws.send(JSON.stringify(data))
            return true
        }
        return false
    }

    /**
     * Add a message listener for a connection.
     */
    addListener(key, callback) {
        if (!this.listeners.has(key)) {
            this.listeners.set(key, new Set())
        }
        this.listeners.get(key).add(callback)

        // Return unsubscribe function
        return () => {
            const listeners = this.listeners.get(key)
            if (listeners) {
                listeners.delete(callback)
                if (listeners.size === 0) {
                    this.listeners.delete(key)
                }
            }
        }
    }

    /**
     * Check if a connection is active.
     */
    isConnected(key) {
        const ws = this.connections.get(key)
        return ws && ws.readyState === WebSocket.OPEN
    }

    /**
     * Get the ready state of a connection.
     */
    getState(key) {
        const ws = this.connections.get(key)
        if (!ws) return 'CLOSED'
        const states = ['CONNECTING', 'OPEN', 'CLOSING', 'CLOSED']
        return states[ws.readyState] || 'UNKNOWN'
    }

    // --- Convenience methods for common connections ---

    /**
     * Connect to a live match stream.
     */
    connectMatch(matchId, onUpdate, onEvent) {
        return this.connect(`match-${matchId}`, `/ws/match/${matchId}`, {
            autoReconnect: true,
            onMessage: (data) => {
                if ((data.type === 'match_state' || data.type === 'match_update') && onUpdate) {
                    onUpdate(data.data)
                }
                if (data.type === 'match_event' && onEvent) {
                    onEvent(data.data)
                }
                if (data.type === 'live_state_update' && onUpdate) {
                    onUpdate(data.data)
                }
            }
        })
    }

    /**
     * Connect to live matches summary.
     */
    connectLiveMatches(onUpdate) {
        return this.connect('live-matches', '/ws/matches/live', {
            autoReconnect: true,
            reconnectDelay: 5000,
            onMessage: (data) => {
                if ((data.type === 'initial_live_matches' || data.type === 'live_matches_update') && onUpdate) {
                    onUpdate(data.data)
                }
            }
        })
    }

    /**
     * Connect to a poll stream.
     */
    connectPoll(pollId, onUpdate) {
        return this.connect(`poll-${pollId}`, `/ws/poll/${pollId}`, {
            autoReconnect: true,
            onMessage: (data) => {
                if (data.type === 'poll_update' && onUpdate) {
                    onUpdate(data.data)
                }
            }
        })
    }

    /**
     * Connect to competition updates.
     */
    connectCompetition(competitionId, onUpdate) {
        return this.connect(`competition-${competitionId}`, `/ws/competition/${competitionId}`, {
            autoReconnect: true,
            onMessage: (data) => {
                if (onUpdate) onUpdate(data)
            }
        })
    }
}

// Singleton instance
export const wsManager = new WebSocketManager()

export default wsManager

--- FILE: frontend/src/stores/auth.js ---
import { defineStore } from 'pinia'
import { ref, computed } from 'vue'
import axios from '@/axios'

export const useAuthStore = defineStore('auth', () => {
    const user = ref(null)
    const accessToken = ref(localStorage.getItem('access_token'))
    const refreshToken = ref(localStorage.getItem('refresh_token'))

    const isAuthenticated = computed(() => !!accessToken.value && !!user.value)

    function setTokens(access, refresh) {
        accessToken.value = access
        refreshToken.value = refresh
        localStorage.setItem('access_token', access)
        localStorage.setItem('refresh_token', refresh)

        axios.defaults.headers.common['Authorization'] = `Bearer ${access}`
    }

    function clearAuth() {
        user.value = null
        accessToken.value = null
        refreshToken.value = null
        localStorage.removeItem('access_token')
        localStorage.removeItem('refresh_token')
        delete axios.defaults.headers.common['Authorization']
    }

    async function login(email, password) {
        try {
            const response = await axios.post('/api/v1/auth/login/', { email, password })
            const { access, refresh } = response.data
            setTokens(access, refresh)
            await fetchUser()
            return true
        } catch (error) {
            console.error('Login failed:', error)
            return false
        }
    }

    async function register(email, password, firstName, lastName) {
        try {
            await axios.post('/api/v1/auth/register/', {
                email,
                password,
                password_confirm: password,
                first_name: firstName,
                last_name: lastName,
            })
            return await login(email, password)
        } catch (error) {
            console.error('Registration failed:', error)
            return false
        }
    }

    async function fetchUser() {
        try {
            const response = await axios.get('/api/v1/auth/users/me/')
            user.value = response.data
            return response.data
        } catch (error) {
            console.error('Failed to fetch user:', error)
            return null
        }
    }

    async function checkAuth() {
        if (accessToken.value) {
            axios.defaults.headers.common['Authorization'] = `Bearer ${accessToken.value}`
            await fetchUser()
        }
    }

    function logout() {
        clearAuth()
        window.location.href = '/'
    }

    return {
        user,
        accessToken,
        refreshToken,
        isAuthenticated,
        login,
        register,
        logout,
        fetchUser,
        checkAuth,
    }
})

import { defineStore } from 'pinia'
import { ref, computed } from 'vue'
import axios from '@/axios'

export const useCompetitionStore = defineStore('competitions', () => {
    const competitions = ref([])
    const currentCompetition = ref(null)
    const standings = ref([])
    const loading = ref(false)
    const error = ref(null)

    // Computed
    const activeCompetitions = computed(() =>
        competitions.value.filter(c => c.is_active)
    )

    const competitionsByType = computed(() => {
        const grouped = {}
        competitions.value.forEach(c => {
            const type = c.competition_type || 'other'
            if (!grouped[type]) grouped[type] = []
            grouped[type].push(c)
        })
        return grouped
    })

    const competitionsByCountry = computed(() => {
        const grouped = {}
        competitions.value.forEach(c => {
            const country = c.country || 'Unknown'
            if (!grouped[country]) grouped[country] = []
            grouped[country].push(c)
        })
        return grouped
    })

    const liveCompetitions = computed(() =>
        competitions.value.filter(c =>
            c.current_season?.status === 'live'
        )
    )

    // Actions
    async function fetchCompetitions(params = {}) {
        loading.value = true
        error.value = null
        try {
            const response = await axios.get('/api/v1/competitions/competitions/', { params })
            const data = response.data
            competitions.value = data.results || data
            return competitions.value
        } catch (err) {
            error.value = err.message
            console.error('Failed to fetch competitions:', err)
            return []
        } finally {
            loading.value = false
        }
    }

    async function fetchCompetition(id) {
        loading.value = true
        error.value = null
        try {
            const response = await axios.get(`/api/v1/competitions/competitions/${id}/`)
            currentCompetition.value = response.data
            return response.data
        } catch (err) {
            error.value = err.message
            console.error('Failed to fetch competition:', err)
            return null
        } finally {
            loading.value = false
        }
    }

    async function fetchStandings(competitionId) {
        try {
            const response = await axios.get(
                `/api/v1/competitions/competitions/${competitionId}/standings/`
            )
            standings.value = response.data || []
            return standings.value
        } catch (err) {
            console.error('Failed to fetch standings:', err)
            return []
        }
    }

    async function fetchSeasons(competitionId) {
        try {
            const response = await axios.get(
                `/api/v1/competitions/competitions/${competitionId}/seasons/`
            )
            return response.data.results || response.data || []
        } catch (err) {
            console.error('Failed to fetch seasons:', err)
            return []
        }
    }

    function clearCurrentCompetition() {
        currentCompetition.value = null
        standings.value = []
    }

    return {
        competitions,
        currentCompetition,
        standings,
        loading,
        error,
        activeCompetitions,
        competitionsByType,
        competitionsByCountry,
        liveCompetitions,
        fetchCompetitions,
        fetchCompetition,
        fetchStandings,
        fetchSeasons,
        clearCurrentCompetition,
    }
})

import { defineStore } from 'pinia'
import { ref, computed } from 'vue'
import axios from '@/axios'

export const useMatchStore = defineStore('matches', () => {
    const matches = ref([])
    const liveMatches = ref([])
    const currentMatch = ref(null)
    const loading = ref(false)
    const wsConnection = ref(null)

    // WebSocket connection for live matches
    function connectToLiveMatches() {
        const protocol = window.location.protocol === 'https:' ? 'wss:' : 'ws:'
        const wsUrl = `${protocol}//localhost:8001/ws/matches/live`

        wsConnection.value = new WebSocket(wsUrl)

        wsConnection.value.onopen = () => {
            console.log('Connected to live matches WebSocket')
        }

        wsConnection.value.onmessage = (event) => {
            const data = JSON.parse(event.data)

            if (data.type === 'initial_live_matches' || data.type === 'live_matches_update') {
                liveMatches.value = data.data
            }
        }

        wsConnection.value.onclose = () => {
            console.log('WebSocket disconnected, reconnecting in 5s...')
            setTimeout(() => connectToLiveMatches(), 5000)
        }

        wsConnection.value.onerror = (error) => {
            console.error('WebSocket error:', error)
        }
    }

    function connectToMatch(matchId, onUpdate, onEvent) {
        const protocol = window.location.protocol === 'https:' ? 'wss:' : 'ws:'
        const wsUrl = `${protocol}//localhost:8001/ws/match/${matchId}`

        const ws = new WebSocket(wsUrl)

        ws.onopen = () => {
            console.log(`Connected to match ${matchId} WebSocket`)
        }

        ws.onmessage = (event) => {
            const data = JSON.parse(event.data)

            if (data.type === 'match_state' || data.type === 'match_update') {
                currentMatch.value = data.data
                if (onUpdate) onUpdate(data.data)
            }

            if (data.type === 'match_event') {
                if (onEvent) onEvent(data.data)
            }

            if (data.type === 'live_state_update') {
                currentMatch.value = {
                    ...currentMatch.value,
                    live_state: data.data,
                }
                if (onUpdate) onUpdate(currentMatch.value)
            }
        }

        ws.onclose = () => {
            console.log(`Match ${matchId} WebSocket disconnected`)
        }

        return ws
    }

    async function fetchMatches(params = {}) {
        loading.value = true
        try {
            const response = await axios.get('/api/v1/matches/matches/', { params })
            matches.value = response.data.results || response.data
            return matches.value
        } catch (error) {
            console.error('Failed to fetch matches:', error)
            return []
        } finally {
            loading.value = false
        }
    }

    async function fetchLiveMatches() {
        try {
            const response = await axios.get('/api/v1/matches/matches/live/')
            liveMatches.value = response.data.matches || response.data
            return liveMatches.value
        } catch (error) {
            console.error('Failed to fetch live matches:', error)
            return []
        }
    }

    async function fetchMatchDetail(matchId) {
        loading.value = true
        try {
            const response = await axios.get(`/api/v1/matches/matches/${matchId}/`)
            currentMatch.value = response.data
            return response.data
        } catch (error) {
            console.error('Failed to fetch match detail:', error)
            return null
        } finally {
            loading.value = false
        }
    }

    async function fetchTodayMatches() {
        try {
            const response = await axios.get('/api/v1/matches/matches/today/')
            return response.data
        } catch (error) {
            console.error('Failed to fetch today matches:', error)
            return []
        }
    }

    return {
        matches,
        liveMatches,
        currentMatch,
        loading,
        connectToLiveMatches,
        connectToMatch,
        fetchMatches,
        fetchLiveMatches,
        fetchMatchDetail,
        fetchTodayMatches,
    }
})

--- FILE: frontend/src/stores/notifications.js ---
import { defineStore } from 'pinia'
import { ref, computed } from 'vue'
import axios from '@/axios'
import { useAuthStore } from './auth'

export const useNotificationStore = defineStore('notifications', () => {
    const authStore = useAuthStore()
    const notifications = ref([])
    const unreadCount = ref(0)
    const loading = ref(false)
    let wsConnection = null

    const isAuthenticated = computed(() => authStore.isAuthenticated)

    async function fetchNotifications(params = {}) {
        if (!authStore.isAuthenticated) return []

        loading.value = true
        try {
            const response = await axios.get('/api/v1/notifications/notifications/', { params })
            const data = response.data
            notifications.value = data.results || data || []
            return notifications.value
        } catch (error) {
            console.error('Failed to fetch notifications:', error)
            return []
        } finally {
            loading.value = false
        }
    }

    async function fetchUnreadCount() {
        if (!authStore.isAuthenticated) return 0

        try {
            const response = await axios.get('/api/v1/notifications/notifications/unread_count/')
            unreadCount.value = response.data.unread_count || 0
            return unreadCount.value
        } catch (error) {
            console.error('Failed to fetch unread count:', error)
            return 0
        }
    }

    async function markRead(notificationId) {
        try {
            await axios.post(`/api/v1/notifications/notifications/${notificationId}/mark_read/`)
            const notif = notifications.value.find(n => n.id === notificationId)
            if (notif) {
                notif.delivery_status = 'read'
                notif.read_at = new Date().toISOString()
            }
            await fetchUnreadCount()
            return true
        } catch (error) {
            console.error('Failed to mark notification as read:', error)
            return false
        }
    }

    async function markAllRead() {
        try {
            await axios.post('/api/v1/notifications/notifications/mark_all_read/')
            notifications.value.forEach(n => {
                if (n.delivery_status !== 'read') {
                    n.delivery_status = 'read'
                    n.read_at = new Date().toISOString()
                }
            })
            unreadCount.value = 0
            return true
        } catch (error) {
            console.error('Failed to mark all as read:', error)
            return false
        }
    }

    function connectWebSocket() {
        if (!authStore.isAuthenticated) return

        const protocol = window.location.protocol === 'https:' ? 'wss:' : 'ws:'
        const wsUrl = `${protocol}//localhost:8001/ws/notifications/${authStore.user?.id}`

        wsConnection = new WebSocket(wsUrl)

        wsConnection.onopen = () => {
            console.log('Connected to notifications WebSocket')
        }

        wsConnection.onmessage = (event) => {
            const data = JSON.parse(event.data)
            if (data.type === 'notification') {
                notifications.value.unshift(data.data)
                unreadCount.value++
            }
        }

        wsConnection.onclose = () => {
            setTimeout(() => connectWebSocket(), 5000)
        }
    }

    function disconnectWebSocket() {
        if (wsConnection) {
            wsConnection.close()
            wsConnection = null
        }
    }

    return {
        notifications,
        unreadCount,
        loading,
        isAuthenticated,
        fetchNotifications,
        fetchUnreadCount,
        markRead,
        markAllRead,
        connectWebSocket,
        disconnectWebSocket,
    }
})

--- FILE: frontend/src/stores/ui.js ---
import { defineStore } from 'pinia'
import { ref } from 'vue'

export const useUIStore = defineStore('ui', () => {
    const isSidebarOpen = ref(false)
    const isSearchOpen = ref(false)
    const theme = ref(localStorage.getItem('theme') || 'light')
    const toasts = ref([])
    let nextToastId = 0

    function toggleSidebar() {
        isSidebarOpen.value = !isSidebarOpen.value
    }

    function openSearch() {
        isSearchOpen.value = true
        document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden'
    }

    function closeSearch() {
        isSearchOpen.value = false
        document.body.style.overflow = ''
    }

    function setTheme(newTheme) {
        theme.value = newTheme
        localStorage.setItem('theme', newTheme)
        if (newTheme === 'dark') {
            document.documentElement.classList.add('dark')
        } else {
            document.documentElement.classList.remove('dark')
        }
    }

    function addToast(message, type = 'info', title = '', duration = 3000) {
        const id = nextToastId++
        const toast = { id, title, message, type }
        toasts.value.push(toast)

        if (duration > 0) {
            setTimeout(() => removeToast(id), duration)
        }

        return id
    }

    function removeToast(id) {
        const index = toasts.value.findIndex(t => t.id === id)
        if (index !== -1) {
            toasts.value.splice(index, 1)
        }
    }

    function showSuccess(message, title = 'Success') {
        return addToast(message, 'success', title)
    }

    function showError(message, title = 'Error') {
        return addToast(message, 'error', title)
    }

    function showWarning(message, title = 'Warning') {
        return addToast(message, 'warning', title)
    }

    function showInfo(message, title = 'Info') {
        return addToast(message, 'info', title)
    }

    return {
        isSidebarOpen,
        isSearchOpen,
        theme,
        toasts,
        toggleSidebar,
        openSearch,
        closeSearch,
        setTheme,
        addToast,
        removeToast,
        showSuccess,
        showError,
        showWarning,
        showInfo,
    }
})

import axios from '@/axios'

class ApiService {
    constructor() {
        this.baseURL = '/api/v1'
    }

    // Competitions
    async getCompetitions(params = {}) {
        try {
            const response = await axios.get(`${this.baseURL}/competitions/competitions/`, { params })
            return response.data
        } catch (error) {
            console.error('API Error - getCompetitions:', error)
            return { results: [], count: 0 }
        }
    }

    async getCompetition(id) {
        try {
            const response = await axios.get(`${this.baseURL}/competitions/competitions/${id}/`)
            return response.data
        } catch (error) {
            console.error('API Error - getCompetition:', error)
            return null
        }
    }

    async getCompetitionStandings(competitionId) {
        try {
            // Try both possible endpoints
            let response
            try {
                response = await axios.get(`${this.baseURL}/competitions/competitions/${competitionId}/standings/`)
            } catch (firstError) {
                // Try alternative endpoint
                response = await axios.get(`${this.baseURL}/standings/standings/`, {
                    params: { competition_season__competition: competitionId }
                })
            }
            return response.data
        } catch (error) {
            console.warn(`Standings not available for competition ${competitionId}:`, error.message)
            // Return empty array instead of throwing
            return []
        }
    }

    async getCompetitionSeasons(competitionId) {
        try {
            const response = await axios.get(`${this.baseURL}/competitions/competitions/${competitionId}/seasons/`)
            return response.data
        } catch (error) {
            console.error('API Error - getCompetitionSeasons:', error)
            return { results: [] }
        }
    }

    // Matches
    async getMatches(params = {}) {
        try {
            const response = await axios.get(`${this.baseURL}/matches/matches/`, { params })
            return response.data
        } catch (error) {
            console.error('API Error - getMatches:', error)
            return { results: [] }
        }
    }

    // Search
    async search(query, types = ['teams', 'players', 'competitions']) {
        const results = {}

        if (types.includes('teams')) {
            try {
                const teams = await this.getTeams({ search: query, limit: 10 })
                results.teams = teams.results || teams
            } catch { results.teams = [] }
        }

        if (types.includes('players')) {
            try {
                const players = await this.getPlayers({ search: query, limit: 10 })
                results.players = players.results || players
            } catch { results.players = [] }
        }

        if (types.includes('competitions')) {
            try {
                const comps = await this.getCompetitions({ search: query, limit: 10 })
                results.competitions = comps.results || comps
            } catch { results.competitions = [] }
        }

        return results
    }

--- FILE: frontend/src/services/auth.js ---
import axios from '@/axios'

class AuthService {
    constructor() {
        this.baseURL = '/api/v1/auth'
    }

    async login(email, password) {
        const response = await axios.post(`${this.baseURL}/login/`, { email, password })
        const { access, refresh, user } = response.data

        localStorage.setItem('access_token', access)
        localStorage.setItem('refresh_token', refresh)
        axios.defaults.headers.common['Authorization'] = `Bearer ${access}`

        return { user, access, refresh }
    }

    async register(email, password, firstName, lastName) {
        const response = await axios.post(`${this.baseURL}/register/`, {
            email,
            password,
            password_confirm: password,
            first_name: firstName,
            last_name: lastName,
        })
        return response.data
    }

    async logout() {
        const refreshToken = localStorage.getItem('refresh_token')
        if (refreshToken) {
            try {
                await axios.post(`${this.baseURL}/logout/`, { refresh: refreshToken })
            } catch (error) {
                console.error('Logout error:', error)
            }
        }

        localStorage.removeItem('access_token')
        localStorage.removeItem('refresh_token')
        delete axios.defaults.headers.common['Authorization']
    }

    async refreshToken() {
        const refreshToken = localStorage.getItem('refresh_token')
        if (!refreshToken) throw new Error('No refresh token')

        const response = await axios.post(`${this.baseURL}/token/refresh/`, { refresh: refreshToken })
        const { access } = response.data

        localStorage.setItem('access_token', access)
        axios.defaults.headers.common['Authorization'] = `Bearer ${access}`

        return access
    }

    async getCurrentUser() {
        const response = await axios.get(`${this.baseURL}/users/me/`)
        return response.data
    }

    async updateProfile(data) {
        const response = await axios.patch(`${this.baseURL}/users/me/`, data)
        return response.data
    }

    async changePassword(oldPassword, newPassword) {
        const response = await axios.post(`${this.baseURL}/users/change_password/`, {
            old_password: oldPassword,
            new_password: newPassword,
        })
        return response.data
    }

    isAuthenticated() {
        return !!localStorage.getItem('access_token')
    }

    setupAxiosInterceptor() {
        axios.interceptors.response.use(
            response => response,
            async error => {
                const originalRequest = error.config

                if (error.response?.status === 401 && !originalRequest._retry) {
                    originalRequest._retry = true

                    try {
                        const newToken = await this.refreshToken()
                        originalRequest.headers.Authorization = `Bearer ${newToken}`
                        return axios(originalRequest)
                    } catch (refreshError) {
                        localStorage.removeItem('access_token')
                        localStorage.removeItem('refresh_token')
                        window.location.href = '/login'
                        return Promise.reject(refreshError)
                    }
                }

                return Promise.reject(error)
            }
        )
    }
}

export const authService = new AuthService()
export default authService

--- FILE: frontend/src/composables/useInfiniteScroll.js ---
import { ref, onMounted, onUnmounted } from 'vue'

export function useInfiniteScroll(loadMore, options = {}) {
    const {
        threshold = 100,
        enabled = true,
        initialLoading = false,
    } = options

    const loading = ref(initialLoading)
    const hasMore = ref(true)
    const error = ref(null)
    let observer = null
    let sentinelRef = null

    const setSentinel = (el) => {
        if (!el || !enabled) return

        sentinelRef = el

        if (observer) {
            observer.disconnect()
        }

        observer = new IntersectionObserver(
            async (entries) => {
                const entry = entries[0]
                if (entry.isIntersecting && !loading.value && hasMore.value) {
                    loading.value = true
                    error.value = null

                    try {
                        const result = await loadMore()
                        if (result === false) {
                            hasMore.value = false
                        }
                    } catch (err) {
                        error.value = err
                        console.error('Failed to load more:', err)
                    } finally {
                        loading.value = false
                    }
                }
            },
            { rootMargin: `${threshold}px` }
        )

        observer.observe(el)
    }

    const reset = () => {
        hasMore.value = true
        loading.value = false
        error.value = null
    }

    onMounted(() => {
        if (!sentinelRef && enabled) {
            // Create a sentinel element if not provided
            const div = document.createElement('div')
            div.style.height = '1px'
            document.querySelector('main')?.appendChild(div)
            setSentinel(div)
        }
    })

    onUnmounted(() => {
        if (observer) {
            observer.disconnect()
            observer = null
        }
    })

    return {
        loading,
        hasMore,
        error,
        setSentinel,
        reset,
    }
}

--- FILE: frontend/src/composables/useLocalStorage.js ---
import { ref, watch } from 'vue'

export function useLocalStorage(key, defaultValue = null) {
    const storedValue = localStorage.getItem(key)
    const initial = storedValue !== null ? JSON.parse(storedValue) : defaultValue

    const data = ref(initial)

    watch(data, (newValue) => {
        if (newValue === null || newValue === undefined) {
            localStorage.removeItem(key)
        } else {
            localStorage.setItem(key, JSON.stringify(newValue))
        }
    }, { deep: true })

    const remove = () => {
        localStorage.removeItem(key)
        data.value = defaultValue
    }

    return { data, remove }
}

export function useLocalStorageObject(key, defaultObject = {}) {
    const stored = localStorage.getItem(key)
    const initial = stored ? JSON.parse(stored) : defaultObject

    const data = ref(initial)

    const update = (updates) => {
        data.value = { ...data.value, ...updates }
    }

    const set = (value) => {
        data.value = value
    }

    const reset = () => {
        data.value = defaultObject
    }

    watch(data, (newValue) => {
        if (newValue === null || Object.keys(newValue).length === 0) {
            localStorage.removeItem(key)
        } else {
            localStorage.setItem(key, JSON.stringify(newValue))
        }
    }, { deep: true })

    return { data, update, set, reset }
}

--- FILE: frontend/src/composables/useWebSocket.js ---
import { ref, onUnmounted } from 'vue'
import wsManager from '@/utils/websocket'

export function useWebSocket(endpoint, options = {}) {
    const isConnected = ref(false)
    const lastMessage = ref(null)
    const error = ref(null)

    const key = options.key || endpoint

    const connect = () => {
        wsManager.connect(key, endpoint, {
            autoReconnect: options.autoReconnect !== false,
            reconnectDelay: options.reconnectDelay || 3000,
            onOpen: () => {
                isConnected.value = true
                error.value = null
                options.onOpen?.()
            },
            onMessage: (data) => {
                lastMessage.value = data
                options.onMessage?.(data)
            },
            onError: (err) => {
                error.value = err
                options.onError?.(err)
            },
            onClose: () => {
                isConnected.value = false
                options.onClose?.()
            },
        })
    }

    const disconnect = () => {
        wsManager.disconnect(key)
        isConnected.value = false
    }

    const send = (data) => {
        return wsManager.send(key, data)
    }

    const addListener = (callback) => {
        return wsManager.addListener(key, callback)
    }

    if (options.autoConnect !== false) {
        connect()
    }

    onUnmounted(() => {
        if (options.autoDisconnect !== false) {
            disconnect()
        }
    })

    return {
        isConnected,
        lastMessage,
        error,
        connect,
        disconnect,
        send,
        addListener,
    }
}

export function useMatchWebSocket(matchId, onUpdate, onEvent) {
    return useWebSocket(`/ws/match/${matchId}`, {
        key: `match-${matchId}`,
        onMessage: (data) => {
            if (data.type === 'match_state' || data.type === 'match_update') {
                onUpdate?.(data.data)
            }
            if (data.type === 'match_event') {
                onEvent?.(data.data)
            }
            if (data.type === 'live_state_update') {
                onUpdate?.(data.data)
            }
        },
    })
}

export function useLiveMatchesWebSocket(onUpdate) {
    return useWebSocket('/ws/matches/live', {
        key: 'live-matches',
        reconnectDelay: 5000,
        onMessage: (data) => {
            if (data.type === 'initial_live_matches' || data.type === 'live_matches_update') {
                onUpdate?.(data.data)
            }
        },
    })
}

export function usePollWebSocket(pollId, onUpdate) {
    // Only connect if pollId is provided
    if (!pollId) {
        return { isConnected: ref(false), lastMessage: ref(null), error: ref(null), connect: () => { }, disconnect: () => { }, send: () => { }, addListener: () => { } }
    }

    return useWebSocket(`/ws/poll/${pollId}`, {
        key: `poll-${pollId}`,
        onMessage: (data) => {
            if (data.type === 'poll_update' || data.type === 'initial_poll_results') {
                onUpdate?.(data.data)
            }
        },
    })
}

defineEmits(['click'])

function getTypeClasses(type) {
  const classes = {
    league: 'bg-blue-50 text-blue-700',
    cup: 'bg-yellow-50 text-yellow-700',
    international: 'bg-purple-50 text-purple-700',
    friendly: 'bg-gray-50 text-gray-700',
  }
  return classes[type] || 'bg-gray-50 text-gray-700'
}

function formatType(type) {
  const formats = {
    league: 'League',
    cup: 'Cup',
    international: 'International',
    friendly: 'Friendly',
  }
  return formats[type] || type
}

<template>
  <div class="card p-6">
    <!-- Match Info Header -->
    <div class="flex items-center gap-3 mb-4 pb-3 border-b border-gray-100">
      <div class="flex-1 flex items-center justify-between">
        <div class="flex items-center gap-2">
          <img v-if="matchInfo?.home_team_logo" :src="matchInfo.home_team_logo" class="w-8 h-8 object-contain" />

        </div>

            <span class="text-xs text-gray-400">{{ formatCompactNumber(option.vote_count || 0) }} votes</span>
          </div>
        </div>
        
        <!-- Animated Progress Bar -->
        <div class="mt-2 stat-bar">
          <div class="stat-bar-fill transition-all duration-500 ease-out"

      </div>

      </div>
      <div v-if="!userVote && poll.status === 'active' && !isAuthenticated" class="text-primary-600">
        Sign in to vote
      </div>

<script setup>
import { ref, computed, onMounted, onUnmounted } from 'vue'
import { useAuthStore } from '@/stores/auth'
import { useUIStore } from '@/stores/ui'
import { liveApi } from '@/services/liveApi'
import Badge from '@/components/ui/Badge.vue'
import { formatCompactNumber } from '@/utils/formatters'

const props = defineProps({
  pollId: {
    type: String,
    required: true
  }
})

const authStore = useAuthStore()
const uiStore = useUIStore()

const poll = ref({})
const pollOptions = ref([])
const totalVotes = ref(0)
const userVote = ref(null)
const matchInfo = ref(null)
const voteRate = ref(0)
let wsConnection = null
let refreshInterval = null

const isAuthenticated = computed(() => authStore.isAuthenticated)
const isLiveMatch = computed(() => matchInfo.value?.status === 'live' || matchInfo.value?.status === 'half_time')

function getOptionColor(optionType) {
  const colors = {
    home: '#3b82f6',
    draw: '#eab308',
    away: '#ef4444',
  }
  return colors[optionType] || '#8b5cf6'
}

async function loadPollData() {
  try {
    const data = await liveApi.getPollWithLiveStats(props.pollId)
    if (data) {
      poll.value = data
      pollOptions.value = data.options || []
      totalVotes.value = data.total_votes || 0
      matchInfo.value = data.match_info
      
      if (isAuthenticated.value && data.user_vote) {
        userVote.value = data.user_vote.option_id
      }
    }
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Failed to load poll:', error)
  }
}

async function loadPollTrends() {
  try {
    const trends = await liveApi.getPollTrends(props.pollId, 1)
    if (trends.length > 0) {
      const lastHourVotes = trends.length
      voteRate.value = parseFloat((lastHourVotes / 60).toFixed(1))
    }
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Failed to load trends:', error)
  }
}

async function handleVote(optionId) {
  if (!isAuthenticated.value) {
    uiStore.showWarning('Please sign in to vote', 'Authentication Required')
    return
  }
  
  if (userVote.value) {
    uiStore.showInfo('You have already voted', 'Only one vote per poll')
    return
  }
  
  try {
    await liveApi.vote(props.pollId, optionId)
    uiStore.showSuccess('Vote recorded!', 'Thank you for voting')
    await loadPollData()
    await loadPollTrends()
  } catch (error) {
    uiStore.showError('Failed to record vote', 'Please try again')
  }
}

// Connect to WebSocket for real-time updates
function connectWebSocket() {
  wsConnection = liveApi.connectToLivePoll(props.pollId, (data) => {
    if (data.results) {
      pollOptions.value = data.results
      totalVotes.value = data.total_votes
      poll.value.total_votes = data.total_votes
    }
  })
}

onMounted(() => {
  loadPollData()
  loadPollTrends()
  connectWebSocket()
  
  // Refresh data every 10 seconds
  refreshInterval = setInterval(() => {
    loadPollData()
    loadPollTrends()
  }, 10000)
})

onUnmounted(() => {
  if (wsConnection) wsConnection.close()
  if (refreshInterval) clearInterval(refreshInterval)
})
</script>

.live-indicator-small {
  display: inline-block;
  width: 8px;
  height: 8px;
  background-color: #ef4444;
  border-radius: 50%;
  animation: pulse 1.5s ease-in-out infinite;
}

@keyframes pulse {
  0%, 100% { opacity: 1; }
  50% { opacity: 0.5; }
}
</style>

                  <span class="text-xs font-bold text-gray-600">{{ match.away_team_name?.charAt(0) }}</span>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
            
            <!-- Team Name -->
            <span class="text-sm font-semibold text-gray-900 truncate group-hover/row:text-primary-600 transition-colors">
              {{ match.away_team_name }}
            </span>
          </div>
          
          <!-- Score -->
          <span class="text-2xl font-black ml-4 flex-shrink-0"
                :class="isLive ? 'text-red-600' : 'text-gray-900'">
            {{ match.away_score ?? 0 }}
          </span>
        </div>
      </div>

      <!-- Possession Bar (Live matches only) -->
      <div v-if="isLive && match.live_state?.possession" class="mt-4 pt-4 border-t border-gray-100">
        <div class="flex items-center justify-between mb-1.5">
          <span class="text-xs text-gray-500">Possession</span>
          <span class="text-xs font-medium text-gray-600">
            {{ match.live_state.possession?.home || 50 }}% - {{ match.live_state.possession?.away || 50 }}%
          </span>
        </div>
        <div class="relative h-2 bg-gray-100 rounded-full overflow-hidden">
          <!-- Home Possession -->
          <div class="absolute inset-y-0 left-0 bg-gradient-to-r from-primary-500 to-primary-600 transition-all duration-700"
               :style="{ width: `${match.live_state.possession?.home || 50}%` }">
          </div>
          <!-- Center Line -->
          <div class="absolute inset-y-0 left-1/2 w-0.5 bg-white transform -translate-x-1/2"></div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <!-- Match Events (Goals, Cards) -->
      <div v-if="isLive && match.events?.length" class="mt-4 pt-4 border-t border-gray-100">
        <div class="flex items-center gap-2 overflow-x-auto pb-1 custom-scrollbar">
          <div v-for="event in match.events.slice(0, 5)" :key="event.id"
               class="flex-shrink-0 w-8 h-8 rounded-lg flex items-center justify-center text-sm"
               :class="getEventStyle(event.type)"
               :title="`${event.player_name} - ${event.type} (${event.minute}')`">
            {{ getEventIcon(event.type) }}
          </div>
          <span v-if="match.events.length > 5" 
                class="text-xs text-gray-400 ml-1">
            +{{ match.events.length - 5 }}
          </span>
        </div>
      </div>

      <!-- Footer: View Details -->
      <div v-if="isLive" class="mt-4 pt-4 border-t border-gray-100 flex items-center justify-between">
        <span class="text-xs text-gray-400">{{ getMatchStatusText }}</span>
        <span class="text-xs font-medium text-primary-600 opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity flex items-center gap-1">
          View Details
          <svg class="w-3 h-3" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
            <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M9 5l7 7-7 7" />
          </svg>
        </span>
      </div>
    </div>

    <!-- Hover Overlay -->
    <div class="absolute inset-0 bg-gradient-to-t from-primary-500/5 to-transparent opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity pointer-events-none rounded-2xl"></div>
  </div>
</template>

<script setup>
import { computed } from 'vue'
import { useRouter } from 'vue-router'

const props = defineProps({
  match: {
    type: Object,
    required: true,
  },
})

const router = useRouter()

const isLive = computed(() => props.match.status === 'live' || props.match.status === 'half_time')
const isFinished = computed(() => props.match.status === 'finished')
const competitionName = computed(() => props.match.competition_name || props.match.competition || 'Friendly')

const getMatchStatusText = computed(() => {
  if (props.match.status === 'half_time') return 'Half Time'
  if (props.match.status === 'live') return 'Second Half'
  return ''
})

function formatTime(dateString) {
  if (!dateString) return 'TBD'
  const date = new Date(dateString)
  return date.toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' })
}

function getEventStyle(eventType) {
  const styles = {
    'goal': 'bg-green-100 text-green-700',
    'own_goal': 'bg-red-100 text-red-700',
    'penalty': 'bg-orange-100 text-orange-700',
    'yellow_card': 'bg-yellow-100 text-yellow-700',
    'red_card': 'bg-red-100 text-red-700',
    'substitution': 'bg-blue-100 text-blue-700',
    'assist': 'bg-purple-100 text-purple-700',
  }
  return styles[eventType] || 'bg-gray-100 text-gray-600'
}

function getEventIcon(eventType) {
  const icons = {
    'goal': '⚽',
    'own_goal': '😱',
    'penalty': '🎯',
    'yellow_card': '🟨',
    'red_card': '🟥',
    'substitution': '🔄',
    'assist': '👟',
  }
  return icons[eventType] || '•'
}

function goToMatch() {
  router.push(`/match/${props.match.id}`)
}
</script>

<script setup>
import { ref, computed, onMounted, onUnmounted, nextTick } from 'vue'
import { useRoute } from 'vue-router'
import { useAuthStore } from '@/stores/auth'
import { useMatchStore } from '@/stores/matches'
import { useUIStore } from '@/stores/ui'
import { storeToRefs } from 'pinia'
import NotificationBell from '@/components/NotificationBell.vue'
import SearchModal from '@/components/SearchModal.vue'

// ── Icons as render functions (inline SVG components) ─────
const HomeIcon = { template: `<svg fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M3 9l9-7 9 7v11a2 2 0 01-2 2H5a2 2 0 01-2-2z"/><polyline points="9 22 9 12 15 12 15 22"/></svg>` }
const LiveIcon = { template: `<svg fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"/><polygon points="10 8 16 12 10 16 10 8" fill="currentColor"/></svg>` }
const TrophyIcon = { template: `<svg fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M6 9H4.5a2.5 2.5 0 010-5H6"/><path d="M18 9h1.5a2.5 2.5 0 000-5H18"/><path d="M4 22h16"/><path d="M10 14.66V17c0 .55-.47.98-.97 1.21C7.85 18.75 7 20.24 7 22"/><path d="M14 14.66V17c0 .55.47.98.97 1.21C16.15 18.75 17 20.24 17 22"/><path d="M18 2H6v7a6 6 0 0012 0V2z"/></svg>` }
const PollIcon = { template: `<svg fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><line x1="18" y1="20" x2="18" y2="10"/><line x1="12" y1="20" x2="12" y2="4"/><line x1="6" y1="20" x2="6" y2="14"/></svg>` }
const NewsIcon = { template: `<svg fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M19 20H5a2 2 0 01-2-2V6a2 2 0 012-2h10a2 2 0 012 2v1m2 13a2 2 0 01-2-2V7m2 13a2 2 0 002-2V9a2 2 0 00-2-2h-2m-4-3H9M7 16h6M7 8h6v4H7V8z"/></svg>` }

const route = useRoute()
const authStore = useAuthStore()
const matchStore = useMatchStore()
const uiStore = useUIStore()
const { liveMatches } = storeToRefs(matchStore)

const showUserMenu  = ref(false)
const showMobileMenu = ref(false)
const userMenuRef   = ref(null)
const navRef        = ref(null)
const navLinkRefs   = ref([])
const scrolled      = ref(false)
const navHidden     = ref(false)

// Active pill position
const pillStyle = ref({ left: '0px', width: '0px' })

const isDark = computed(() =>
  typeof window !== 'undefined' && window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)').matches
)

const liveMatchCount = computed(() => liveMatches.value?.length || 0)

const userInitial = computed(() => {
  const u = authStore.user
  if (u?.first_name) return u.first_name.charAt(0).toUpperCase()
  if (u?.email)      return u.email.charAt(0).toUpperCase()
  return 'U'
})

const displayName = computed(() => {
  const u = authStore.user
  if (u?.first_name) return u.first_name
  if (u?.email)      return u.email.split('@')[0]
  return 'User'
})

const memberSince = computed(() => {
  const d = authStore.user?.date_joined
  return d ? new Date(d).toLocaleDateString('en-US', { month: 'short', year: 'numeric' }) : ''
})

const navItems = [
  { path: '/',             label: 'Home',         icon: HomeIcon  },
  { path: '/live',         label: 'Live',         icon: LiveIcon, badge: true },
  { path: '/competitions', label: 'Competitions', icon: TrophyIcon },
  { path: '/polls',        label: 'Polls',        icon: PollIcon  },
  { path: '/news',         label: 'News',         icon: NewsIcon  },
]

function isActive(path) {
  return route.path === path
}

// ── Active pill logic ────────────────────────────────────
async function updatePill(idx) {
  await nextTick()
  const el = navLinkRefs.value[idx]?.$el || navLinkRefs.value[idx]
  if (!el) return
  const track = el.parentElement
  const trackRect = track.getBoundingClientRect()
  const elRect = el.getBoundingClientRect()
  pillStyle.value = {
    left:  (elRect.left - trackRect.left) + 'px',
    width: elRect.width + 'px',
  }
}

onMounted(async () => {
  await nextTick()
  const activeIdx = navItems.findIndex(i => isActive(i.path))
  if (activeIdx >= 0) updatePill(activeIdx)
})

// ── Smart scroll hide/show ───────────────────────────────
let lastScroll = 0
function handleScroll() {
  const current = window.scrollY
  scrolled.value = current > 10

  if (current > lastScroll && current > 80) {
    navHidden.value = true   // scrolling down
  } else {
    navHidden.value = false  // scrolling up
  }
  lastScroll = current
}

// ── Keyboard ─────────────────────────────────────────────
function handleKeyboard(e) {
  if ((e.metaKey || e.ctrlKey) && e.key === 'k') {
    e.preventDefault()
    uiStore.openSearch()
  }
  if (e.key === 'Escape') {
    showUserMenu.value = false
    showMobileMenu.value = false
  }
}

// ── Click outside ─────────────────────────────────────────
function handleClickOutside(e) {
  if (userMenuRef.value && !userMenuRef.value.contains(e.target)) {
    showUserMenu.value = false
  }
}

function handleLogout() {
  showUserMenu.value   = false
  showMobileMenu.value = false
  authStore.logout()
}

onMounted(() => {
  document.addEventListener('click', handleClickOutside)
  document.addEventListener('keydown', handleKeyboard)
  window.addEventListener('scroll', handleScroll, { passive: true })
})

onUnmounted(() => {
  document.removeEventListener('click', handleClickOutside)
  document.removeEventListener('keydown', handleKeyboard)
  window.removeEventListener('scroll', handleScroll)
})
</script>

<script setup>
import { computed } from 'vue'

const props = defineProps({
  article: { 
    type: Object, 
    required: true,
    validator: (obj) => {
      return obj.title
    }
  },
  featured: { 
    type: Boolean, 
    default: false 
  },
})

function formatDate(dateString) {
  if (!dateString) return ''
  return new Date(dateString).toLocaleDateString('en-US', {
    year: 'numeric',
    month: 'short',
    day: 'numeric'
  })
}

function formatTimeAgo(dateString) {
  if (!dateString) return ''
  
  const now = new Date()
  const date = new Date(dateString)
  const seconds = Math.floor((now - date) / 1000)
  
  if (seconds < 60) return 'Just now'
  if (seconds < 3600) return `${Math.floor(seconds / 60)}m ago`
  if (seconds < 86400) return `${Math.floor(seconds / 3600)}h ago`
  if (seconds < 604800) return `${Math.floor(seconds / 86400)}d ago`
  
  return formatDate(dateString)
}
</script>

--- FILE: frontend/src/components/PollWidget.vue ---
<template>
  <div class="card p-4">
    <div class="mb-3">
      <div class="flex items-center justify-between mb-1">
        <h3 class="font-bold text-lg">{{ poll.question || 'Who will win?' }}</h3>
        <Badge :variant="poll.status === 'active' ? 'live' : 'default'">
          {{ poll.status === 'active' ? 'LIVE' : 'Closed' }}
        </Badge>
      </div>
      <p class="text-sm text-gray-500">
        {{ matchName }} • {{ formatDate(poll.kickoff_time) }}
      </p>
    </div>
    
    <div class="space-y-3">
      <div v-for="option in pollOptions" :key="option.id"
           @click="canVote && handleVote(option.id)"
           class="relative rounded-lg border-2 p-3 transition-all"
           :class="[
             canVote ? 'hover:border-primary-300 cursor-pointer' : 'cursor-default',
             userVote === option.id ? 'border-green-500 bg-green-50' : 'border-gray-200'
           ]">
        
        <div class="flex items-center justify-between relative z-10">
          <div class="flex items-center gap-3">
            <img v-if="option.team_logo" :src="option.team_logo" class="w-5 h-5 object-contain" />
            <span class="font-medium">{{ option.label }}</span>
            <span v-if="userVote === option.id" class="text-xs text-green-600 font-medium">
              ✓ Your vote
            </span>
          </div>
          <span class="text-sm font-bold">{{ option.percentage || 0 }}%</span>
        </div>
        
        <!-- Progress Bar -->
        <div class="mt-2 stat-bar">
          <div class="stat-bar-fill" 
               :style="{ width: `${option.percentage || 0}%`, backgroundColor: getOptionColor(option.option_type) }"></div>
        </div>
        
        <div class="flex justify-between text-xs text-gray-500 mt-1">
          <span>{{ option.vote_count || 0 }} votes</span>
          <span>{{ option.percentage || 0 }}%</span>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
    
    <div class="mt-3 pt-2 border-t border-gray-100 flex justify-between text-xs text-gray-400">
      <span>Total: {{ totalVotes }} votes</span>
      <span v-if="!canVote && !userVote && poll.status === 'active'">
        Sign in to vote
      </span>
      <span v-else-if="userVote" class="text-green-600">
        ✓ Voted
      </span>
    </div>
  </div>
</template>

<script setup>
import { ref, computed, onMounted, onUnmounted } from 'vue'
import { useAuthStore } from '@/stores/auth'
import { useUIStore } from '@/stores/ui'
import { api } from '@/services/api'
import { useWebSocket } from '@/composables/useWebSocket'
import Badge from '@/components/ui/Badge.vue'
import { formatDate } from '@/utils/formatters'
import { useMatchStore } from '@/stores/matches'

const props = defineProps({
  pollId: String,
  matchId: String,
  initialData: Object,
})

const authStore = useAuthStore()
const uiStore = useUIStore()
const matchStore = useMatchStore()

const poll = ref(props.initialData || {})
const pollOptions = ref([])
const totalVotes = ref(0)
const userVote = ref(null)
const loading = ref(false)

const matchName = computed(() => {
  if (poll.value.match_info) {
    return `${poll.value.match_info.home_team} vs ${poll.value.match_info.away_team}`
  }
  return 'Match Poll'
})

const canVote = computed(() => {
  return authStore.isAuthenticated && 
         poll.value.status === 'active' && 
         !userVote.value &&
         !loading.value
})

function getOptionColor(optionType) {
  const colors = {
    home: '#3b82f6',
    draw: '#eab308',
    away: '#ef4444',
  }
  return colors[optionType] || '#8b5cf6'
}

async function handleVote(optionId) {
  if (!authStore.isAuthenticated) {
    uiStore.showWarning('Please sign in to vote', 'Authentication Required')
    return
  }
  
  if (userVote.value) {
    uiStore.showInfo('You have already voted', 'Only one vote per poll')
    return
  }
  
  loading.value = true
  
  try {
    const result = await api.vote(props.pollId, optionId)
    if (result) {
      uiStore.showSuccess('Vote recorded!', 'Thank you for voting')
      await loadPollData()
    }
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Vote failed:', error)
    uiStore.showError('Failed to record vote', 'Please try again')
  } finally {
    loading.value = false
  }
}

async function loadPollData() {
  try {
    let pollData = props.initialData
    
    if (!pollData && props.pollId) {
      pollData = await api.getPoll(props.pollId)
    }
    
    if (pollData) {
      poll.value = pollData
      pollOptions.value = pollData.options || []
      totalVotes.value = pollData.total_votes || 0
      
      // Check if user has voted
      if (authStore.isAuthenticated && pollData.user_vote) {
        userVote.value = pollData.user_vote.option_id
      }
    }
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Failed to load poll:', error)
  }
}

// WebSocket for real-time updates
let unsubscribe = null

onMounted(() => {
  loadPollData()
  
  // Connect to WebSocket for real-time updates if we have a poll ID
  if (props.pollId) {
    const { addListener } = useWebSocket(`/ws/poll/${props.pollId}`, {
      autoConnect: true,
      onMessage: (data) => {
        if (data.type === 'poll_update' || data.type === 'initial_poll_results') {
          const updateData = data.data
          if (updateData.results) {
            pollOptions.value = updateData.results
            totalVotes.value = updateData.total_votes
            poll.value.total_votes = updateData.total_votes
          }
        }
      },
    })
  }
})

onUnmounted(() => {
  if (unsubscribe) unsubscribe()
})
</script>

<script setup>
import { ref, watch } from 'vue'
import { useRouter } from 'vue-router'
import axios from '@/axios'
import Modal from '@/components/ui/Modal.vue'
import Loader from '@/components/ui/Loader.vue'

const emit = defineEmits(['close'])
const router = useRouter()

const query = ref('')
const loading = ref(false)
const results = ref({ teams: [], players: [], competitions: [] })

let searchTimeout = null

watch(query, () => {
  if (searchTimeout) clearTimeout(searchTimeout)
  searchTimeout = setTimeout(() => {
    if (query.value.length >= 2) {
      performSearch()
    } else if (query.value.length === 0) {
      results.value = { teams: [], players: [], competitions: [] }
    }
  }, 400)
})

async function performSearch() {
  if (!query.value.trim()) return
  
  loading.value = true
  try {
    const [teamsRes, playersRes, compsRes] = await Promise.all([
      axios.get('/api/v1/teams/teams/', { params: { search: query.value, limit: 10 } }),
      axios.get('/api/v1/players/players/', { params: { search: query.value, limit: 10 } }),
      axios.get('/api/v1/competitions/competitions/', { params: { search: query.value, limit: 10 } }),
    ])
    
    results.value = {
      teams: teamsRes.data.results || teamsRes.data || [],
      players: playersRes.data.results || playersRes.data || [],
      competitions: compsRes.data.results || compsRes.data || [],
    }
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Search failed:', error)
  } finally {
    loading.value = false
  }
}

function navigateTo(path) {
  router.push(path)
  emit('close')
}
</script>

--- FILE: frontend/src/components/StandingsTable.vue ---
<template>
  <div class="overflow-x-auto">
    <table class="table w-full">
      <thead>
        <tr v-if="!compact">
          <th class="w-10">#</th>
          <th>Team</th>
          <th class="text-center w-10">P</th>
          <th class="text-center w-10">W</th>
          <th class="text-center w-10">D</th>
          <th class="text-center w-10">L</th>
          <th class="text-center w-12">GF</th>
          <th class="text-center w-12">GA</th>
          <th class="text-center w-12">GD</th>
          <th class="text-center w-12 font-bold">Pts</th>
          <th class="text-center w-24">Form</th>
        </tr>
        <tr v-else>
          <th class="w-8">#</th>
          <th>Team</th>
          <th class="text-center w-8">P</th>
          <th class="text-center w-10 font-bold">Pts</th>
        </tr>
      </thead>
      <tbody>
        <tr v-for="entry in standings" :key="entry.id"
            class="cursor-pointer hover:bg-gray-50 transition-colors"
            :class="{
              'bg-green-50': entry.position <= promotionZone,
              'bg-red-50': entry.position > relegationZone && relegationZone > 0,
            }"
            @click="$emit('teamClick', entry.team)">
          
          <td class="text-center font-bold" :class="getPositionClass(entry.position)">
            {{ entry.position }}
          </td>
          
          <td>
            <div class="flex items-center gap-2">
              <img v-if="entry.team_logo" :src="entry.team_logo" class="w-5 h-5 object-contain" />
              <span class="font-medium text-sm">{{ entry.team_name }}</span>
            </div>
          </td>
          
          <td class="text-center">{{ entry.played }}</td>
          
          <template v-if="!compact">
            <td class="text-center">{{ entry.wins }}</td>
            <td class="text-center">{{ entry.draws }}</td>
            <td class="text-center">{{ entry.losses }}</td>
            <td class="text-center">{{ entry.goals_for }}</td>
            <td class="text-center">{{ entry.goals_against }}</td>
            <td class="text-center" :class="getGoalDiffClass(entry.goal_difference)">
              {{ entry.goal_difference }}
            </td>
          </template>
          
          <td class="text-center font-bold">{{ entry.points }}</td>
          
          <td v-if="!compact" class="text-center">
            <div class="flex items-center justify-center gap-0.5">
              <span v-for="(result, idx) in (entry.form || '').split('')" :key="idx"
                    class="w-5 h-5 rounded-full text-[10px] font-bold flex items-center justify-center text-white"
                    :class="getFormClass(result)">
                {{ result }}
              </span>
            </div>
          </td>
        </tr>
      </tbody>
    </table>
  </div>
</template>

<script setup>
defineProps({
  standings: { type: Array, required: true },
  title: { type: String, default: '' },
  compact: { type: Boolean, default: false },
  promotionZone: { type: Number, default: 0 },
  relegationZone: { type: Number, default: 0 },
})
defineEmits(['teamClick'])

function getPositionClass(position) {
  if (position <= 4) return 'text-green-600'
  if (position >= 17 && position <= 20) return 'text-red-600'
  return 'text-gray-700'
}

function getGoalDiffClass(gd) {
  if (gd > 0) return 'text-green-600'
  if (gd < 0) return 'text-red-600'
  return 'text-gray-500'
}

function getFormClass(result) {
  const classes = {
    'W': 'bg-green-500',
    'D': 'bg-yellow-500',
    'L': 'bg-red-500',
  }
  return classes[result] || 'bg-gray-400'
}
</script>

        :class="badgeClasses">

<script setup>
import { computed } from 'vue'

const props = defineProps({
  variant: {
    type: String,
    default: 'default',
    validator: (v) => ['default', 'success', 'warning', 'error', 'info', 'live'].includes(v),
  },
})

const badgeClasses = computed(() => {
  const variants = {
    default: 'bg-gray-100 text-gray-800',
    success: 'bg-green-100 text-green-800',
    warning: 'bg-yellow-100 text-yellow-800',
    error: 'bg-red-100 text-red-800',
    info: 'bg-blue-100 text-blue-800',
    live: 'bg-red-600 text-white animate-pulse',
  }
  return variants[props.variant] || variants.default
})

<template>
  <button
    :type="type"
    :disabled="disabled || loading"
    @click="$emit('click')"
    class="inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 font-semibold transition-all duration-300 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-offset-2 disabled:opacity-50 disabled:cursor-not-allowed select-none"
    :class="[buttonClasses, animationClass]"
  >
    <!-- Loading Spinner -->
    <svg v-if="loading" class="animate-spin" :class="iconSizeClass" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
      <circle class="opacity-25" cx="12" cy="12" r="10" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="4" fill="none" />
      <path class="opacity-75" fill="currentColor" d="M4 12a8 8 0 018-8V0C5.373 0 0 5.373 0 12h4zm2 5.291A7.962 7.962 0 014 12H0c0 3.042 1.135 5.824 3 7.938l3-2.647z" />
    </svg>

    <!-- Left Icon -->
    <span v-if="$slots.iconLeft && !loading" class="flex-shrink-0">
      <slot name="iconLeft" />
    </span>

    <!-- Content -->
    <span :class="{ 'opacity-0': loading }">
      <slot />
    </span>

    <!-- Right Icon -->
    <span v-if="$slots.iconRight && !loading" class="flex-shrink-0">
      <slot name="iconRight" />
    </span>

    <!-- Hover Arrow (for primary variant) -->
    <svg v-if="variant === 'primary' && !loading && showArrow" 
         class="transition-transform duration-300 group-hover:translate-x-1"
         :class="iconSizeClass"
         fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
      <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M13 7l5 5m0 0l-5 5m5-5H6" />
    </svg>
  </button>
</template>

<script setup>
import { computed } from 'vue'

const props = defineProps({
  variant: {
    type: String,
    default: 'primary',
    validator: (v) => [
      'primary', 'secondary', 'outline', 'ghost', 'danger',
      'success', 'warning', 'info', 'light', 'dark', 'gradient'
    ].includes(v),
  },
  size: {
    type: String,
    default: 'md',
    validator: (v) => ['xs', 'sm', 'md', 'lg', 'xl'].includes(v),
  },
  type: {
    type: String,
    default: 'button',
  },
  disabled: Boolean,
  loading: Boolean,
  fullWidth: Boolean,
  rounded: {
    type: String,
    default: 'lg',
    validator: (v) => ['md', 'lg', 'xl', 'full'].includes(v),
  },
  showArrow: {
    type: Boolean,
    default: false,
  },
  animation: {
    type: String,
    default: 'scale',
    validator: (v) => ['none', 'scale', 'slide', 'pulse'].includes(v),
  },
})

defineEmits(['click'])

const sizeClasses = {
  xs: 'px-2.5 py-1 text-xs rounded-lg gap-1.5',
  sm: 'px-3.5 py-2 text-sm rounded-lg gap-2',
  md: 'px-5 py-2.5 text-sm rounded-xl gap-2',
  lg: 'px-6 py-3 text-base rounded-xl gap-2.5',
  xl: 'px-8 py-4 text-lg rounded-2xl gap-3',
}

const roundedClasses = {
  md: 'rounded-md',
  lg: 'rounded-lg',
  xl: 'rounded-xl',
  full: 'rounded-full',
}

const iconSizeClass = computed(() => {
  const sizes = {
    xs: 'w-3 h-3',
    sm: 'w-3.5 h-3.5',
    md: 'w-4 h-4',
    lg: 'w-5 h-5',
    xl: 'w-6 h-6',
  }
  return sizes[props.size]
})

const variantClasses = {
  primary: 'bg-primary-600 text-white hover:bg-primary-700 focus:ring-primary-500 shadow-sm hover:shadow-md active:shadow-sm border border-primary-600',
  secondary: 'bg-gray-600 text-white hover:bg-gray-700 focus:ring-gray-500 shadow-sm hover:shadow-md active:shadow-sm border border-gray-600',
  outline: 'border-2 border-gray-300 text-gray-700 hover:border-gray-400 hover:bg-gray-50 focus:ring-gray-500 bg-white hover:shadow-sm active:bg-gray-100',
  ghost: 'text-gray-600 hover:text-gray-900 hover:bg-gray-100 focus:ring-gray-500 active:bg-gray-200',
  danger: 'bg-red-600 text-white hover:bg-red-700 focus:ring-red-500 shadow-sm hover:shadow-md active:shadow-sm border border-red-600',
  success: 'bg-green-600 text-white hover:bg-green-700 focus:ring-green-500 shadow-sm hover:shadow-md active:shadow-sm border border-green-600',
  warning: 'bg-yellow-500 text-white hover:bg-yellow-600 focus:ring-yellow-500 shadow-sm hover:shadow-md active:shadow-sm border border-yellow-500',
  info: 'bg-blue-500 text-white hover:bg-blue-600 focus:ring-blue-500 shadow-sm hover:shadow-md active:shadow-sm border border-blue-500',
  light: 'bg-white text-gray-700 hover:bg-gray-50 focus:ring-gray-300 shadow-sm border border-gray-200 hover:border-gray-300',
  dark: 'bg-gray-900 text-white hover:bg-gray-800 focus:ring-gray-700 shadow-sm hover:shadow-md active:shadow-sm border border-gray-900',
  gradient: 'bg-gradient-to-r from-primary-600 to-purple-600 text-white hover:from-primary-700 hover:to-purple-700 focus:ring-primary-500 shadow-md hover:shadow-lg active:shadow-sm border border-transparent',
}

const animationClasses = {
  none: '',
  scale: 'hover:scale-105 active:scale-95',
  slide: 'hover:-translate-y-0.5 active:translate-y-0',
  pulse: 'hover:animate-pulse',
}

const buttonClasses = computed(() => [
  sizeClasses[props.size],
  variantClasses[props.variant],
  animationClasses[props.animation],
  props.fullWidth ? 'w-full' : '',
  props.rounded ? roundedClasses[props.rounded] : '',
  'group', // For hover effects on child elements
])
</script>
