--- FILE: frontend/src/components/ui/Dropdown.vue ---
<template>
  <div class="relative" ref="dropdownRef">
    <button @click="isOpen = !isOpen" class="flex items-center gap-2">
      <slot name="trigger" />
    </button>
    
    <Transition name="dropdown">
      <div v-if="isOpen" class="absolute right-0 mt-2 w-48 bg-white rounded-lg shadow-lg border border-gray-200 py-1 z-50">
        <slot />
      </div>
    </Transition>
  </div>
</template>

<script setup>
import { ref, onMounted, onUnmounted } from 'vue'

const isOpen = ref(false)
const dropdownRef = ref(null)

function handleClickOutside(event) {
  if (dropdownRef.value && !dropdownRef.value.contains(event.target)) {
    isOpen.value = false
  }
}

onMounted(() => {
  document.addEventListener('click', handleClickOutside)
})

onUnmounted(() => {
  document.removeEventListener('click', handleClickOutside)
})
</script>

<style scoped>
.dropdown-enter-active,
.dropdown-leave-active {
  transition: opacity 0.2s ease, transform 0.2s ease;
}
.dropdown-enter-from {
  opacity: 0;
  transform: translateY(-8px);
}
.dropdown-leave-to {
  opacity: 0;
  transform: translateY(-8px);
}
</style>

<template>
  <!-- Teleport to body so stacking context doesn't clip the modal -->
  <Teleport to="body">
    <Transition name="backdrop-fade">
      <div
        v-if="modelValue"
        class="modal-backdrop"
        :class="{ 'dark-theme': isDark }"
        @click.self="closeIfAllowed"
        aria-modal="true"
        role="dialog"
        :aria-label="title || 'Dialog'"
      >
        <Transition :name="isMobile ? 'sheet-slide' : 'modal-spring'">
          <div
            v-if="modelValue"
            ref="modalRef"
            class="modal-content"
            :class="[
              sizeClasses[size],
              typeClass,
              { 'is-loading': loading },
            ]"
            tabindex="-1"
            @keydown.esc="closeIfAllowed"
          >
            <!-- ── Header ──────────────────────────────────── -->
            <div v-if="$slots.header || title" class="modal-header">
              <slot name="header">
                <h2 class="modal-title">{{ title }}</h2>
              </slot>
              <button
                v-if="showClose"
                class="modal-close-btn"
                aria-label="Close"
                @click="emit('close')"
                @keydown.enter="emit('close')"
              >
                <svg width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">
                  <path d="M18 6L6 18M6 6l12 12"/>
                </svg>
              </button>
            </div>

            <!-- ── Body ───────────────────────────────────── -->
            <div class="modal-body" :class="{ 'modal-body--noPad': noPadding }">
              <!-- Loading overlay -->
              <div v-if="loading" class="modal-loading">
                <svg class="modal-spinner" viewBox="0 0 50 50">
                  <circle cx="25" cy="25" r="20" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round" />
                </svg>
              </div>
              <slot v-else />
            </div>

            <!-- ── Footer ─────────────────────────────────── -->
            <div v-if="$slots.footer" class="modal-footer">
              <slot name="footer" />
            </div>

            <!-- Mobile drag handle for bottom-sheet -->
            <div v-if="isMobile" class="drag-handle" aria-hidden="true"></div>
          </div>
        </Transition>
      </div>
    </Transition>
  </Teleport>
</template>

<script setup>
import { ref, computed, watch, onMounted, onUnmounted, nextTick } from 'vue'

// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Props & Emits
// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
const props = defineProps({
  modelValue: { type: Boolean, default: false },
  title:      { type: String,  default: '' },
  size:       { type: String,  default: 'md', validator: v => ['sm','md','lg','xl','full'].includes(v) },
  /** dialog | drawer | fullscreen */
  type:       { type: String,  default: 'dialog' },
  showClose:  { type: Boolean, default: true },
  /** Prevent closing by clicking backdrop or ESC */
  persistent: { type: Boolean, default: false },
  loading:    { type: Boolean, default: false },
  noPadding:  { type: Boolean, default: false },
  dark:       { type: Boolean, default: false },
})

const emit = defineEmits(['update:modelValue', 'close'])

// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Refs & state
// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
const modalRef = ref(null)
const isMobile = ref(false)

const isDark = computed(() => {
  if (props.dark) return true
  return typeof window !== 'undefined' && window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)').matches
})

const sizeClasses = {
  sm:   'max-w-sm',
  md:   'max-w-lg',
  lg:   'max-w-2xl',
  xl:   'max-w-4xl',
  full: 'max-w-6xl',
}

const typeClass = computed(() => ({
  'modal--dialog':     props.type === 'dialog',
  'modal--drawer':     props.type === 'drawer',
  'modal--fullscreen': props.type === 'fullscreen',
}))

// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Close logic
// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function closeIfAllowed() {
  if (!props.persistent) emit('close')
}

// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Scroll lock
// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
watch(() => props.modelValue, async (open) => {
  document.body.style.overflow = open ? 'hidden' : ''

  if (open) {
    await nextTick()
    // Focus trap – focus the modal container so ESC works immediately
    modalRef.value?.focus()
  }
})

// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Focus trap (keyboard users stay inside modal)
// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function trapFocus(e) {
  if (!props.modelValue || !modalRef.value) return
  const focusable = modalRef.value.querySelectorAll(
    'button, [href], input, select, textarea, [tabindex]:not([tabindex="-1"])'
  )
  const first = focusable[0]
  const last  = focusable[focusable.length - 1]

  if (e.key === 'Tab') {
    if (e.shiftKey) {
      if (document.activeElement === first) { e.preventDefault(); last?.focus() }
    } else {
      if (document.activeElement === last)  { e.preventDefault(); first?.focus() }
    }
  }
  if (e.key === 'Escape') closeIfAllowed()
}

// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Responsive
// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function checkMobile() {
  isMobile.value = window.innerWidth < 640
}

onMounted(() => {
  document.addEventListener('keydown', trapFocus)
  checkMobile()
  window.addEventListener('resize', checkMobile)
})

onUnmounted(() => {
  document.removeEventListener('keydown', trapFocus)
  window.removeEventListener('resize', checkMobile)
  document.body.style.overflow = ''
})
</script>

<template>
  <div
    class="skeleton-wrapper"
    :class="[
      heightClasses[height],
      variantClasses[variant],
      directionClass,
      { 'dark-mode': dark }
    ]"
    :style="{
      width,
      animationDelay: delay + 'ms',
      animationDuration: duration + 'ms',
      willChange: 'background-position, opacity',
    }"
    :aria-label="label || 'Loading...'"
    role="status"
    aria-busy="true"
  >
    <!-- Optional label beneath -->
    <span v-if="label" class="skeleton-label">{{ label }}</span>
  </div>

<script setup>
import { computed } from 'vue'

const props = defineProps({
  /** Visual height preset */
  height: {
    type: String,
    default: 'md',
    validator: (v) => ['xs', 'sm', 'md', 'lg', 'xl', '2xl'].includes(v),
  },
  /** Explicit width override */
  width: {
    type: String,
    default: '100%',
  },
  /** Shape variant */
  variant: {
    type: String,
    default: 'text',
    validator: (v) => ['text', 'avatar', 'card', 'button', 'default', 'circle', 'rounded'].includes(v),
  },
  /** Shimmer direction */
  direction: {
    type: String,
    default: 'horizontal',
    validator: (v) => ['horizontal', 'vertical'].includes(v),
  },
  /** Animation delay in ms – use for stagger effects */
  delay: {
    type: Number,
    default: 0,
  },
  /** Animation duration in ms */
  duration: {
    type: Number,
    default: 1400,
  },
  /** Optional descriptive label rendered below the skeleton */
  label: {
    type: String,
    default: '',
  },
  /** Force dark-mode colours regardless of OS preference */
  dark: {
    type: Boolean,
    default: false,
  },
})

const heightClasses = {
  xs:  'h-2',
  sm:  'h-4',
  md:  'h-8',
  lg:  'h-12',
  xl:  'h-16',
  '2xl': 'h-24',
}

const variantClasses = {
  text:    'rounded',
  avatar:  'rounded-full',
  card:    'rounded-2xl',
  button:  'rounded-lg',
  // legacy aliases kept for backward-compat
  default: 'rounded',
  circle:  'rounded-full',
  rounded: 'rounded-xl',
}

const directionClass = computed(() =>
  props.direction === 'vertical' ? 'shimmer-vertical' : 'shimmer-horizontal'
)

--- FILE: frontend/src/components/ui/Tabs.vue ---
<template>
  <div class="tabs-container">
    <!-- Tab Navigation -->
    <div :class="[variantClasses[variant].wrapper, fullWidth ? '' : '']">
      <nav :class="[variantClasses[variant].nav, fullWidth ? 'grid grid-cols-' + tabs.length : 'flex']">
        <button
          v-for="tab in tabs"
          :key="tab.id"
          @click="selectTab(tab)"
          :disabled="tab.disabled"
          :class="getTabClasses(tab)"
          class="group relative"
        >
          <!-- Tab Icon -->
          <span v-if="tab.icon" class="text-lg" :class="{ 'mr-1.5': $slots.default }">
            {{ tab.icon }}
          </span>

          <!-- Tab Label -->
          <span class="relative z-10">{{ tab.label }}</span>

          <!-- Tab Count Badge -->
          <span v-if="tab.count !== undefined" 
                class="ml-1.5 px-1.5 py-0.5 text-xs rounded-full transition-all duration-300"
                :class="modelValue === tab.id 
                  ? 'bg-primary-100 text-primary-700' 
                  : 'bg-gray-100 text-gray-500 group-hover:bg-gray-200'">
            {{ tab.count }}
          </span>

          <!-- Active Tab Indicator (Pill Style) -->
          <span v-if="variant === 'pills' && modelValue === tab.id" 
                class="absolute inset-0 bg-white shadow-sm rounded-lg"></span>

          <!-- Active Tab Indicator (Underline Style - Animated) -->
          <span v-if="variant === 'underline' && modelValue === tab.id" 
                class="absolute bottom-0 left-0 right-0 h-0.5 bg-primary-600 rounded-full"></span>

          <!-- Notification Dot -->
          <span v-if="tab.notification" 
                class="absolute -top-1 -right-1 w-2 h-2 bg-red-500 rounded-full animate-pulse"></span>
        </button>
      </nav>
    </div>

    <!-- Tab Content with Transition -->
    <div class="mt-4 relative">
      <transition name="tab-fade" mode="out-in">
        <div :key="modelValue">
          <slot :activeTab="modelValue" />
        </div>
      </transition>
    </div>
  </div>
</template>

<script setup>
import { computed } from 'vue'

const props = defineProps({
  tabs: { 
    type: Array, 
    required: true,
    validator: (tabs) => tabs.every(tab => tab.id && tab.label)
  },
  modelValue: { 
    type: String, 
    required: true 
  },
  variant: {
    type: String,
    default: 'underline',
    validator: (v) => ['underline', 'pills', 'boxed', 'minimal'].includes(v)
  },
  fullWidth: {
    type: Boolean,
    default: false
  },
  size: {
    type: String,
    default: 'md',
    validator: (v) => ['sm', 'md', 'lg'].includes(v)
  },
  align: {
    type: String,
    default: 'left',
    validator: (v) => ['left', 'center'].includes(v)
  }
})

const emit = defineEmits(['update:modelValue', 'change'])

function selectTab(tab) {
  if (!tab.disabled && tab.id !== props.modelValue) {
    emit('update:modelValue', tab.id)
    emit('change', tab)
  }
}

const variantClasses = {
  underline: {
    wrapper: 'border-b border-gray-200',
    nav: 'space-x-6 -mb-px'
  },
  pills: {
    wrapper: '',
    nav: 'space-x-1 bg-gray-100 p-1 rounded-xl'
  },
  boxed: {
    wrapper: 'border-b-2 border-gray-200',
    nav: 'space-x-1'
  },
  minimal: {
    wrapper: '',
    nav: 'space-x-4'
  }
}

const sizeClasses = {
  sm: 'pb-2 px-1 text-xs',
  md: 'pb-3 px-1.5 text-sm',
  lg: 'pb-4 px-2 text-base'
}

const alignClasses = {
  left: 'justify-start',
  center: 'justify-center'
}

function getTabClasses(tab) {
  const isActive = props.modelValue === tab.id
  const isDisabled = tab.disabled
  const variant = props.variant

  const baseClasses = [
    'font-medium transition-all duration-300 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary-500 focus:ring-offset-2 rounded-md',
    sizeClasses[props.size],
    !props.fullWidth && alignClasses[props.align],
    isDisabled ? 'opacity-50 cursor-not-allowed' : 'cursor-pointer',
  ]

  switch (variant) {
    case 'underline':
      return [
        ...baseClasses,
        'border-b-2 rounded-none',
        isActive 
          ? 'border-primary-600 text-primary-600' 
          : 'border-transparent text-gray-500 hover:text-gray-700 hover:border-gray-300'
      ]
    
    case 'pills':
      return [
        ...baseClasses,
        'relative px-4 py-2',
        isActive 
          ? 'text-primary-700' 
          : 'text-gray-500 hover:text-gray-700'
      ]
    
    case 'boxed':
      return [
        ...baseClasses,
        'border-2 border-b-0 rounded-t-lg px-4',
        isActive 
          ? 'border-gray-200 bg-white text-primary-600' 
          : 'border-transparent text-gray-500 hover:text-gray-700 hover:bg-gray-50'
      ]
    
    case 'minimal':
      return [
        ...baseClasses,
        'rounded-none border-b-0',
        isActive 
          ? 'text-primary-600 font-bold' 
          : 'text-gray-400 hover:text-gray-600'
      ]
    
    default:
      return baseClasses
  }
}
</script>

<style scoped>
/* Tab Content Transitions */
.tab-fade-enter-active,
.tab-fade-leave-active {
  transition: all 0.2s ease;
}

.tab-fade-enter-from {
  opacity: 0;
  transform: translateY(8px);
}

.tab-fade-leave-to {
  opacity: 0;
  transform: translateY(-8px);
}

/* Grid columns for full width tabs */
.grid-cols-2 { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); }
.grid-cols-3 { grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); }
.grid-cols-4 { grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr); }
.grid-cols-5 { grid-template-columns: repeat(5, 1fr); }
.grid-cols-6 { grid-template-columns: repeat(6, 1fr); }
.grid-cols-7 { grid-template-columns: repeat(7, 1fr); }
.grid-cols-8 { grid-template-columns: repeat(8, 1fr); }

@keyframes pulse {
  0%, 100% { opacity: 1; }
  50% { opacity: 0.5; }
}

.animate-pulse {
  animation: pulse 2s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.6, 1) infinite;
}
</style>

        <path v-else-if="toast.type === 'warning'" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M12 9v2m0 4h.01m-6.938 4h13.856c1.54 0 2.502-1.667 1.732-3L13.732 4c-.77-1.333-2.694-1.333-3.464 0L3.34 16c-.77 1.333.192 3 1.732 3z" />
        <path v-else stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M13 16h-1v-4h-1m1-4h.01M21 12a9 9 0 11-18 0 9 9 0 0118 0z" />

      <p class="font-medium text-gray-900">{{ toast.title }}</p>
      <p class="text-sm text-gray-500">{{ toast.message }}</p>
    </div>
    <button @click="$emit('close')" class="p-1 rounded-lg hover:bg-gray-100 transition-colors flex-shrink-0">
      <svg class="w-4 h-4 text-gray-400" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">

<script setup>
import { computed } from 'vue'

const props = defineProps({
  toast: {
    type: Object,
    required: true,
    validator: (v) => ['success', 'error', 'warning', 'info'].includes(v.type),
  },
})
defineEmits(['close'])

const borderColor = computed(() => {
  const colors = {
    success: 'border-green-200',
    error: 'border-red-200',
    warning: 'border-yellow-200',
    info: 'border-blue-200',
  }
  return colors[props.toast.type]
})

const iconBgColor = computed(() => {
  const colors = {
    success: 'bg-green-100',
    error: 'bg-red-100',
    warning: 'bg-yellow-100',
    info: 'bg-blue-100',
  }
  return colors[props.toast.type]
})

const iconColor = computed(() => {
  const colors = {
    success: 'text-green-600',
    error: 'text-red-600',
    warning: 'text-yellow-600',
    info: 'text-blue-600',
  }
  return colors[props.toast.type]
})
</script>

<script setup>
import { ref, computed, onMounted, onUnmounted } from 'vue'
import { useRoute } from 'vue-router'
import axios from '@/axios'
import { formatDate } from '@/utils/formatters'

const route = useRoute()
const articleId = route.params.id

const loading         = ref(true)
const article         = ref(null)
const copied          = ref(false)
const readingProgress = ref(0)
const heroImgRef      = ref(null)

const isDark = computed(() =>
  typeof window !== 'undefined' && window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)').matches
)

const hasRelatedEntities = computed(() => {
  if (!article.value?.related_entities) return false
  const e = article.value.related_entities
  return (e.teams?.length || e.players?.length || e.matches?.length || e.competitions?.length) > 0
})

// ── Share ────────────────────────────────────────────────
function shareArticle(platform) {
  const url   = window.location.href
  const title = article.value?.title || ''
  const urls  = {
    twitter:  `https://twitter.com/intent/tweet?url=${encodeURIComponent(url)}&text=${encodeURIComponent(title)}`,
    facebook: `https://www.facebook.com/sharer/sharer.php?u=${encodeURIComponent(url)}`,
  }
  if (urls[platform]) window.open(urls[platform], '_blank', 'width=600,height=400')
}

async function copyLink() {
  try {
    await navigator.clipboard.writeText(window.location.href)
    copied.value = true
    setTimeout(() => { copied.value = false }, 2200)
  } catch (e) { /* ignore */ }
}

// ── Scroll: reading progress + parallax ─────────────────
function handleScroll() {
  const scrollTop    = window.pageYOffset || document.documentElement.scrollTop
  const scrollHeight = document.documentElement.scrollHeight - window.innerHeight
  readingProgress.value = scrollHeight > 0 ? (scrollTop / scrollHeight) * 100 : 0

  // Cinematic parallax
  if (heroImgRef.value) {
    const scale = 1.06 + scrollTop * 0.00025
    heroImgRef.value.style.transform = `scale(${Math.min(scale, 1.15)}) translateY(${scrollTop * 0.12}px)`
  }
}

onMounted(async () => {
  window.addEventListener('scroll', handleScroll, { passive: true })

  try {
    const res = await axios.get(`/api/v1/news/articles/${articleId}/`)
    article.value = res.data
  } catch (e) {
    console.error('Failed to load article:', e)
  } finally {
    loading.value = false
  }
})

onUnmounted(() => {
  window.removeEventListener('scroll', handleScroll)
})
</script>

              <div class="w-20 h-20 bg-gray-100 rounded-2xl flex items-center justify-center mx-auto mb-4">
                <svg class="w-10 h-10 text-gray-400" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
                  <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M19 20H5a2 2 0 01-2-2V6a2 2 0 012-2h10a2 2 0 012 2v1m2 13a2 2 0 01-2-2V7m2 13a2 2 0 002-2V9a2 2 0 00-2-2h-2m-4-3H9M7 16h6M7 8h6v4H7V8z" />
                </svg>
              </div>
              <h3 class="text-lg font-semibold text-gray-700 mb-1">No News Available</h3>
              <p class="text-gray-500 text-sm">Latest news hasn't been published for this competition yet</p>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <!-- Not Found State -->
    <div v-else class="text-center py-16">
      <div class="w-32 h-32 bg-gradient-to-br from-gray-100 to-gray-200 rounded-3xl flex items-center justify-center mx-auto mb-6 shadow-lg">
        <span class="text-6xl">🏆</span>
      </div>
      <h2 class="text-2xl font-bold text-gray-900 mb-2">Competition Not Found</h2>

      <router-link to="/competitions" 
                   class="inline-flex items-center gap-2 px-6 py-2.5 bg-primary-600 text-white font-medium rounded-xl hover:bg-primary-700 transition-all duration-300 hover:shadow-lg hover:-translate-y-0.5">
        Browse All Competitions
        <svg class="w-4 h-4" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
          <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M13 7l5 5m0 0l-5 5m5-5H6" />

<script setup>
import { ref, computed, onMounted } from 'vue'
import { useRoute, useRouter } from 'vue-router'
import { useUIStore } from '@/stores/ui'
import { api } from '@/services/api'
import Badge from '@/components/ui/Badge.vue'
import MatchWidget from '@/components/MatchWidget.vue'
import StandingsTable from '@/components/StandingsTable.vue'
import NewsCard from '@/components/NewsCard.vue'

const route = useRoute()
const router = useRouter()
const uiStore = useUIStore()
const competitionId = route.params.id

const loading = ref(true)
const competition = ref(null)
const seasons = ref([])
const selectedSeasonId = ref(null)
const standings = ref([])
const matches = ref([])
const teams = ref([])
const news = ref([])
const topScorers = ref([])
const topAssisters = ref([])
const isFavorited = ref(false)
const activeTab = ref('standings')
const selectedRound = ref(1)

const tabs = [
  { id: 'standings', label: 'Standings', icon: '📊' },
  { id: 'matches', label: 'Matches', icon: '⚽' },
  { id: 'stats', label: 'Stats', icon: '📈' },
  { id: 'teams', label: 'Teams', icon: '👥' },
  { id: 'news', label: 'News', icon: '📰' },
]

const activeSeason = computed(() => {
  return seasons.value.find(s => s.id === selectedSeasonId.value)
})

const matchRounds = computed(() => {
  const rounds = new Set()
  matches.value.forEach(m => {
    if (m.round_number) rounds.add(m.round_number)
  })
  return Array.from(rounds).sort((a, b) => a - b)
})

const filteredMatches = computed(() => {
  if (selectedRound.value === -1) return matches.value
  return matches.value.filter(m => m.round_number === selectedRound.value)
})

function getTabCount(tabId) {
  switch(tabId) {
    case 'standings': return standings.value.length || null
    case 'matches': return matches.value.length || null
    case 'teams': return teams.value.length || null
    case 'news': return news.value.length || null
    default: return null
  }
}

function getRankColorClass(index) {
  if (index === 0) return 'bg-yellow-100 text-yellow-700 border-2 border-yellow-400'
  if (index === 1) return 'bg-gray-100 text-gray-600 border-2 border-gray-300'
  if (index === 2) return 'bg-orange-100 text-orange-700 border-2 border-orange-300'
  return 'bg-gray-50 text-gray-500 border border-gray-200'
}

async function loadCompetition() {
  try {
    competition.value = await api.getCompetition(competitionId)
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Failed to load competition:', error)
    competition.value = null
  }
}

async function loadSeasons() {
  try {
    const response = await api.getCompetitionSeasons(competitionId)
    seasons.value = response.results || response || []
    const currentSeason = seasons.value.find(s => s.is_current)
    selectedSeasonId.value = currentSeason?.id || seasons.value[0]?.id
    if (selectedSeasonId.value) {
      await loadSeasonData()
    } else {
      loading.value = false
    }
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Failed to load seasons:', error)
    seasons.value = []
    loading.value = false
  }
}

async function loadSeasonData() {
  if (!selectedSeasonId.value) return
  
  loading.value = true
  try {
    const [standingsRes, matchesRes, teamsRes, newsRes] = await Promise.all([
      api.getStandings({ competition_season: selectedSeasonId.value }),
      api.getMatches({ competition_season: selectedSeasonId.value, limit: 100 }),
      api.getTeams({ competition_season: selectedSeasonId.value }),
      api.getArticles({ by_entity: 'competition', id: competitionId, limit: 20 }),
    ])
    
    standings.value = standingsRes.results || standingsRes || []
    matches.value = matchesRes.results || matchesRes || []
    teams.value = teamsRes.results || teamsRes || []
    news.value = newsRes.results || newsRes || []
    
    // Auto-select first available round
    if (matchRounds.value.length > 0) {
      selectedRound.value = matchRounds.value[0]
    }
    
    // Load stats
    await Promise.all([
      loadTopScorers(),
      loadTopAssisters()
    ])
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Failed to load season data:', error)
    standings.value = []
    matches.value = []
    teams.value = []
    news.value = []
  } finally {
    loading.value = false
  }
}

async function loadTopScorers() {
  try {
    const response = await api.getPlayers({ 
      competition_season: selectedSeasonId.value,
      ordering: '-goals',
      limit: 20 
    })
    const players = response.results || response || []
    topScorers.value = players.map(p => ({
      player_id: p.id,
      player_name: p.full_name,
      player_image: p.image_url,
      team_name: p.current_team_name,
      goals: p.season_stats?.[0]?.goals || 0,
    })).sort((a, b) => b.goals - a.goals).filter(p => p.goals > 0)
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Failed to load top scorers:', error)
    topScorers.value = []
  }
}

async function loadTopAssisters() {
  try {
    const response = await api.getPlayers({ 
      competition_season: selectedSeasonId.value,
      ordering: '-assists',
      limit: 20 
    })
    const players = response.results || response || []
    topAssisters.value = players.map(p => ({
      player_id: p.id,
      player_name: p.full_name,
      player_image: p.image_url,
      team_name: p.current_team_name,
      assists: p.season_stats?.[0]?.assists || 0,
    })).sort((a, b) => b.assists - a.assists).filter(p => p.assists > 0)
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Failed to load top assisters:', error)
    topAssisters.value = []
  }
}

function toggleFavorite() {
  isFavorited.value = !isFavorited.value
  uiStore.showSuccess(
    isFavorited.value ? 'Added to favorites!' : 'Removed from favorites',
    isFavorited.value ? '⭐' : ''
  )
  // API call to toggle favorite would go here
}

onMounted(() => {
  loadCompetition()
  loadSeasons()
})
</script>

<script setup>
import { ref, computed, onMounted } from 'vue'
import axios from '@/axios'

const loading = ref(true)
const loadingMore = ref(false)
const competitions = ref([])
const searchQuery = ref('')
const typeFilter = ref('')
const countryFilter = ref('')
const page = ref(1)
const hasMore = ref(false)

const countries = computed(() => {
  const all = competitions.value.map(c => c.country).filter(Boolean)
  return [...new Set(all)].sort()
})

const liveCount = computed(() => {
  return competitions.value.filter(c => 
    c.current_season?.status === 'live' || c.is_active
  ).length
})

const filteredCompetitions = computed(() => {
  let result = competitions.value

  if (searchQuery.value) {
    const q = searchQuery.value.toLowerCase()
    result = result.filter(c =>
      c.name?.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
      c.short_name?.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
      c.country?.toLowerCase().includes(q)
    )
  }

  if (typeFilter.value) {
    result = result.filter(c => c.competition_type === typeFilter.value)
  }

  if (countryFilter.value) {
    result = result.filter(c => c.country === countryFilter.value)
  }

  return result
})

function getTypeClasses(type) {
  const classes = {
    league: 'bg-blue-50 text-blue-700',
    cup: 'bg-orange-50 text-orange-700',
    international: 'bg-purple-50 text-purple-700',
  }
  return classes[type] || 'bg-gray-50 text-gray-700'
}

function formatType(type) {
  const formats = {
    league: 'League',
    cup: 'Cup',
    international: 'Intl',
  }
  return formats[type] || type
}

function clearFilters() {
  searchQuery.value = ''
  typeFilter.value = ''
  countryFilter.value = ''
}

async function fetchCompetitions(pageNum = 1) {
  try {
    const res = await axios.get('/api/v1/competitions/competitions/', {
      params: { is_active: true, page: pageNum, page_size: 20 }
    })
    const data = res.data

    if (pageNum === 1) {
      competitions.value = data.results || data
    } else {
      competitions.value = [...competitions.value, ...(data.results || data)]
    }

    hasMore.value = data.next !== null
    page.value = pageNum
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Failed to fetch competitions:', error)
  }
}

async function loadMore() {
  loadingMore.value = true
  await fetchCompetitions(page.value + 1)
  loadingMore.value = false
}

onMounted(async () => {
  await fetchCompetitions()
  loading.value = false
})
</script>

<script setup>
import { ref } from 'vue'
import { useUIStore } from '@/stores/ui'

const uiStore = useUIStore()
const submitting = ref(false)
const showSuccessToast = ref(false)

const form = ref({
  firstName: '',
  lastName: '',
  email: '',
  subject: '',
  message: '',
})

const faqs = [
  { question: 'How do I create an account?', answer: 'Click the Sign In button and select Create Account. Fill in your details and verify your email.' },
  { question: 'How accurate are the live scores?', answer: 'Our scores update in real-time from official data providers with minimal delay.' },
  { question: 'Can I customize notifications?', answer: 'Yes! Go to Settings to choose which notifications you want to receive.' },
  { question: 'Is LiveScore free to use?', answer: 'Yes, LiveScore is completely free with optional premium features available.' },
  { question: 'How do I report an issue?', answer: 'Use this contact form or email support@livescore.com directly.' },
  { question: 'Do you have a mobile app?', answer: 'Our mobile app is available on iOS and Android app stores.' },
]

async function submitForm() {
  submitting.value = true
  try {
    // Simulate API call
    await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 1500))
    
    // Show success
    showSuccessToast.value = true
    uiStore.showSuccess('Message sent successfully!', 'We\'ll get back to you soon')
    
    // Reset form
    form.value = { firstName: '', lastName: '', email: '', subject: '', message: '' }
    
    // Auto-hide toast
    setTimeout(() => { showSuccessToast.value = false }, 5000)
  } catch (error) {
    uiStore.showError('Failed to send message', 'Please try again')
  } finally {
    submitting.value = false
  }
}
</script>

  to { transform: rotate(360deg); }

  transition: all 0.2s ease-in;
}

  opacity: 0;
  transform: translateY(20px) scale(0.95);
}
.toast-slide-leave-to {
  opacity: 0;
  transform: translateY(20px) scale(0.95);
}

<script setup>
import { ref, computed, onMounted } from 'vue'
import { useRouter } from 'vue-router'
import { useAuthStore } from '@/stores/auth'
import { useUIStore } from '@/stores/ui'
import { api } from '@/services/api'
import MatchWidget from '@/components/MatchWidget.vue'
import { formatDate } from '@/utils/formatters'

const router = useRouter()
const authStore = useAuthStore()
const uiStore = useUIStore()

const loading = ref(true)
const refreshing = ref(false)
const favoriteTeams = ref([])
const favoriteMatches = ref([])
const showAllTeams = ref(false)
const showAllMatches = ref(false)

const displayedTeams = computed(() => {
  if (showAllTeams.value) return favoriteTeams.value
  return favoriteTeams.value.slice(0, 6)
})

const displayedMatches = computed(() => {
  if (showAllMatches.value) return favoriteMatches.value
  return favoriteMatches.value.slice(0, 6)
})

async function loadFavorites() {
  if (!authStore.isAuthenticated) {
    loading.value = false
    return
  }
  
  loading.value = true
  try {
    const [teamsRes, matchesRes] = await Promise.all([
      api.getFavoriteTeams(),
      api.getFavoriteMatches(),
    ])
    
    favoriteTeams.value = teamsRes.results || teamsRes || []
    favoriteMatches.value = matchesRes.results || matchesRes || []
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Failed to load favorites:', error)
    uiStore.showError('Failed to load favorites', 'Please try again')
  } finally {
    loading.value = false
  }
}

async function refreshAll() {
  refreshing.value = true
  try {
    await loadFavorites()
    uiStore.showSuccess('Favorites updated!', '')
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Failed to refresh favorites:', error)
  } finally {
    refreshing.value = false
  }
}

function goToTeam(teamId) {
  router.push(`/team/${teamId}`)
}

onMounted(() => {
  loadFavorites()
})
</script>

  -webkit-box-orient: vertical;
  line-clamp: 1;

}

@keyframes spin {
  from { transform: rotate(0deg); }
  to { transform: rotate(360deg); }
}

.animate-spin {
  animation: spin 1s linear infinite;
}
</style>

<script setup>
import { ref, computed, onMounted } from 'vue'
import { useRouter } from 'vue-router'
import { useMatchStore } from '@/stores/matches'
import { useAuthStore } from '@/stores/auth'
import { storeToRefs } from 'pinia'
import { api } from '@/services/api'
import Skeleton from '@/components/ui/Skeleton.vue'
import MatchWidget from '@/components/MatchWidget.vue'
import NewsCard from '@/components/NewsCard.vue'
import PollWidget from '@/components/PollWidget.vue'
import StandingsTable from '@/components/StandingsTable.vue'

const router = useRouter()
const matchStore = useMatchStore()
const authStore = useAuthStore()
const { liveMatches } = storeToRefs(matchStore)

const loadingToday = ref(true)
const todayMatches = ref([])
const featuredNews = ref([])
const topCompetitions = ref([])
const competitionStandings = ref({})
const featuredPolls = ref([])
const topScorers = ref([])
const todayFilter = ref('all')

const displayName = computed(() => {
  const user = authStore.user
  return user?.first_name || 'Football Fan'
})

const greeting = computed(() => {
  const hour = new Date().getHours()
  if (hour < 12) return 'Good Morning'
  if (hour < 18) return 'Good Afternoon'
  return 'Good Evening'
})

const formattedDate = computed(() => {
  return new Date().toLocaleDateString('en-US', { 
    weekday: 'long', 
    year: 'numeric', 
    month: 'long', 
    day: 'numeric' 
  })
})

const matchFilters = [
  { label: 'All Matches', value: 'all', icon: '📋' },
  { label: 'Live', value: 'live', icon: '🔴' },
  { label: 'Upcoming', value: 'scheduled', icon: '⏰' },
]

const filteredTodayMatches = computed(() => {
  if (todayFilter.value === 'all') return todayMatches.value
  if (todayFilter.value === 'live') return todayMatches.value.filter(m => m.status === 'live' || m.status === 'half_time')
  return todayMatches.value.filter(m => m.status === 'scheduled')
})

function getCompetitionStandings(compId) {
  return competitionStandings.value[compId] || []
}

function goToMatch(matchId) {
  router.push(`/match/${matchId}`)
}

function goToPlayer(playerId) {
  router.push(`/player/${playerId}`)
}

async function loadTodayMatches() {
  loadingToday.value = true
  try {
    todayMatches.value = await matchStore.fetchTodayMatches()
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Failed to load today matches:', error)
    todayMatches.value = []
  } finally {
    loadingToday.value = false
  }
}

async function loadFeaturedNews() {
  try {
    const response = await api.getFeaturedNews()
    featuredNews.value = response.results || response || []
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Failed to load news:', error)
    featuredNews.value = []
  }
}

async function loadTopCompetitions() {
  try {
    const response = await api.getCompetitions({ is_active: true, limit: 4 })
    topCompetitions.value = response.results || response || []
    
    for (const comp of topCompetitions.value) {
      try {
        const standings = await api.getCompetitionStandings(comp.id)
        if (standings && standings.length > 0) {
          competitionStandings.value[comp.id] = standings
        }
      } catch (e) {
        competitionStandings.value[comp.id] = []
      }
    }
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Failed to load competitions:', error)
    topCompetitions.value = []
  }
}

async function loadFeaturedPolls() {
  try {
    const response = await api.getPolls({ is_featured: true, status: 'active', limit: 4 })
    featuredPolls.value = response.results || response || []
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Failed to load polls:', error)
    featuredPolls.value = []
  }
}

async function loadTopScorers() {
  try {
    const response = await api.getPlayers({ ordering: '-goals', limit: 20 })
    const players = response.results || response || []
    topScorers.value = players.map(p => ({
      player_id: p.id,
      player_name: p.full_name,
      player_image: p.image_url,
      team_name: p.current_team_name,
      goals: p.season_stats?.[0]?.goals || 0,
      assists: p.season_stats?.[0]?.assists || 0,
      appearances: p.season_stats?.[0]?.appearances || 0,
    })).sort((a, b) => b.goals - a.goals).filter(p => p.goals > 0)
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Failed to load top scorers:', error)
    topScorers.value = []
  }
}

onMounted(() => {
  loadTodayMatches()
  loadFeaturedNews()
  loadTopCompetitions()
  loadFeaturedPolls()
  loadTopScorers()
})
</script>

<script setup>
import { ref, computed, watch, onMounted, onUnmounted } from 'vue'
import { useRouter } from 'vue-router'
import { useUIStore } from '@/stores/ui'
import { liveApi } from '@/services/liveApi'

const router = useRouter()
const uiStore = useUIStore()

const loading = ref(true)
const refreshing = ref(false)
const liveMatches = ref([])
const selectedSource = ref('flashscore')
const soundEnabled = ref(false)
const lastUpdated = ref('')
let refreshInterval = null
let previousScores = new Map()

const sources = [
  { value: 'flashscore', label: 'FlashScore', icon: '⚡' },
  { value: 'espn', label: 'ESPN', icon: '🏈' }
]

const totalGoalsScored = computed(() => {
  return liveMatches.value.reduce((total, match) => {
    const homeScore = parseInt(match.home_score) || 0
    const awayScore = parseInt(match.away_score) || 0
    return total + homeScore + awayScore
  }, 0)
})

const competitionsCount = computed(() => {
  const competitions = new Set(liveMatches.value.map(m => m.competition).filter(Boolean))
  return competitions.size
})

function getEventStyle(eventType) {
  const styles = {
    'goal': 'bg-green-100 text-green-700',
    'yellow_card': 'bg-yellow-100 text-yellow-700',
    'red_card': 'bg-red-100 text-red-700',
    'substitution': 'bg-blue-100 text-blue-700',
    'penalty': 'bg-orange-100 text-orange-700',
    'own_goal': 'bg-purple-100 text-purple-700',
  }
  return styles[eventType] || 'bg-gray-100 text-gray-600'
}

function getEventIcon(eventType) {
  const icons = {
    'goal': '⚽',
    'yellow_card': '🟨',
    'red_card': '🟥',
    'substitution': '🔄',
    'penalty': '🎯',
    'own_goal': '😱',
  }
  return icons[eventType] || '•'
}

function checkForGoals(currentMatches) {
  if (!soundEnabled.value) return
  
  currentMatches.forEach(match => {
    const prevScore = previousScores.get(match.id)
    const currentTotal = (parseInt(match.home_score) || 0) + (parseInt(match.away_score) || 0)
    
    if (prevScore !== undefined && currentTotal > prevScore) {
      playGoalSound()
      uiStore.showNotification(`⚽ Goal! ${match.home_team} ${match.home_score} - ${match.away_score} ${match.away_team}`, 'Goal Alert!')
    }
    
    previousScores.set(match.id, currentTotal)
  })
}

function playGoalSound() {
  try {
    const audio = new Audio('/sounds/goal.mp3')
    audio.volume = 0.5
    audio.play()
  } catch (error) {
    console.log('Sound not available')
  }
}

function toggleSound() {
  soundEnabled.value = !soundEnabled.value
  uiStore.showSuccess(
    soundEnabled.value ? 'Goal alerts enabled! 🔊' : 'Goal alerts muted 🔇',
    ''
  )
}

async function loadLiveMatches() {
  if (liveMatches.value.length === 0) loading.value = true
  
  try {
    let matches = []
    
    if (selectedSource.value === 'flashscore') {
      matches = await liveApi.getFlashScoreLiveMatches()
    } else {
      matches = await liveApi.getESPNLiveMatches('soccer')
    }
    
    // Check for new goals
    checkForGoals(matches)
    
    liveMatches.value = matches
    lastUpdated.value = new Date().toLocaleTimeString('en-US', { 
      hour: '2-digit', 
      minute: '2-digit',
      second: '2-digit'
    })
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Failed to load live matches:', error)
    if (liveMatches.value.length === 0) {
      uiStore.showError('Failed to load live matches', 'Please try again')
    }
  } finally {
    loading.value = false
  }
}

async function refreshMatches() {
  refreshing.value = true
  try {
    await loadLiveMatches()
    uiStore.showSuccess('Live matches updated!', '')
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Failed to refresh:', error)
    uiStore.showError('Failed to refresh', 'Please try again')
  } finally {
    refreshing.value = false
  }
}

// Watch for source changes
watch(selectedSource, () => {
  previousScores.clear()
  loadLiveMatches()
})

onMounted(() => {
  loadLiveMatches()
  refreshInterval = setInterval(loadLiveMatches, 30000)
})

onUnmounted(() => {
  if (refreshInterval) clearInterval(refreshInterval)
})
</script>

  50% { opacity: 0.5; }

}

  <div>
    <div class="text-center mb-6">
      <h1 class="text-2xl font-bold text-gray-900">Welcome Back</h1>
      <p class="text-sm text-gray-500 mt-1">Sign in to your account</p>

    <form @submit.prevent="handleLogin" class="space-y-4">
      <Input
        v-model="email"
        type="email"
        label="Email Address"
        placeholder="you@example.com"
        required
        :error="errors.email"
      />

      <Input
        v-model="password"
        type="password"
        label="Password"
        placeholder="••••••••"
        required
        :error="errors.password"
      />

      <div class="flex items-center justify-between">
        <label class="flex items-center">
          <input type="checkbox" v-model="remember" class="w-4 h-4 text-primary-600 rounded border-gray-300" />
          <span class="ml-2 text-sm text-gray-600">Remember me</span>
        </label>
        <router-link to="/forgot-password" class="text-sm text-primary-600 hover:underline">
          Forgot password?
        </router-link>
      </div>

      <div v-if="generalError" class="text-red-600 text-sm bg-red-50 p-3 rounded-lg">
        {{ generalError }}
      </div>

      <Button type="submit" :loading="loading" full-width>
        Sign In
      </Button>
    </form>

    <p class="text-center text-sm text-gray-500 mt-6">
      Don't have an account?
      <router-link to="/signup" class="text-primary-600 hover:underline font-medium">Sign up</router-link>
    </p>
  </div>

<script setup>
import { ref } from 'vue'
import { useRouter, useRoute } from 'vue-router'
import { useAuthStore } from '@/stores/auth'
import { useUIStore } from '@/stores/ui'
import Input from '@/components/ui/Input.vue'
import Button from '@/components/ui/Button.vue'

const router = useRouter()
const route = useRoute()
const authStore = useAuthStore()
const uiStore = useUIStore()

const email = ref('')
const password = ref('')
const remember = ref(false)
const loading = ref(false)
const generalError = ref('')
const errors = ref({})

async function handleLogin() {
  errors.value = {}
  generalError.value = ''
  
  if (!email.value) {
    errors.value.email = 'Email is required'
    return
  }
  if (!password.value) {
    errors.value.password = 'Password is required'
    return
  }
  
  loading.value = true
  
  const success = await authStore.login(email.value, password.value)
  
  if (success) {
    uiStore.showSuccess('Welcome back!', 'Login Successful')
    const redirect = route.query.redirect || '/'
    router.push(redirect)
  } else {
    generalError.value = 'Invalid email or password. Please try again.'
  }
  
  loading.value = false
}
</script>

<script setup>
import { ref, computed, onMounted, onUnmounted } from 'vue'
import { useRoute } from 'vue-router'
import { useMatchStore } from '@/stores/matches'
import { useMatchWebSocket } from '@/composables/useWebSocket'
import { getMatchStatusLabel, getEventIcon, formatKickoffTime } from '@/utils/formatters'
import Loader from '@/components/ui/Loader.vue'
import Badge from '@/components/ui/Badge.vue'
import PollWidget from '@/components/PollWidget.vue'

const route = useRoute()
const matchStore = useMatchStore()

const loading = ref(true)
const match = ref(null)

const isLive = computed(() => match.value?.status === 'live' || match.value?.status === 'half_time')

function getStatusVariant(status) {
  const variants = {
    scheduled: 'default',
    live: 'error',
    half_time: 'warning',
    finished: 'success',
    postponed: 'warning',
  }
  return variants[status] || 'default'
}

function getMomentumVariant(momentum) {
  const variants = { home: 'error', away: 'info', balanced: 'default' }
  return variants[momentum] || 'default'
}

function getMomentumLabel(momentum) {
  const labels = { home: 'Home Dominant', away: 'Away Dominant', balanced: 'Balanced' }
  return labels[momentum] || 'Balanced'
}

function getLineups(teamSide) {
  if (!match.value?.lineups) return []
  const teamId = teamSide === 'home' ? match.value.home_team?.id : match.value.away_team?.id
  return match.value.lineups.filter(l => l.team === teamId && l.role === 'starter').sort((a, b) => a.sort_order - b.sort_order)
}

// WebSocket for real-time updates
const { isConnected, lastMessage } = useMatchWebSocket(
  route.params.id,
  (data) => {
    match.value = { ...match.value, ...data }
  },
  (event) => {
    match.value.events = [...(match.value.events || []), event]
  }
)

onMounted(async () => {
  try {
    match.value = await matchStore.fetchMatchDetail(route.params.id)
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Failed to load match:', error)
  } finally {
    loading.value = false
  }
})
</script>

            {{ searchQuery 
              ? `No articles match your search for "${searchQuery}". Try different keywords or clear your search.`
              : categoryFilter 
                ? `No articles found in this category. Try selecting a different category.`
                : 'No articles have been published yet. Check back soon for the latest news!'
            }}
          </p>

                  class="inline-flex items-center gap-2 px-6 py-2.5 bg-primary-600 text-white font-medium rounded-xl hover:bg-primary-700 transition-all duration-300 hover:shadow-lg hover:-translate-y-0.5">
            Clear Filters

<script setup>
import { ref, computed, onMounted } from 'vue'
import { useRouter } from 'vue-router'
import axios from '@/axios'

const router = useRouter()

const loading = ref(true)
const loadingMore = ref(false)
const articles = ref([])
const breakingNews = ref([])
const featuredNews = ref([])
const categories = ref([])
const searchQuery = ref('')
const categoryFilter = ref('')
const page = ref(1)
const hasMore = ref(false)
let searchTimeout = null

const totalArticles = computed(() => articles.value.length)

function getCategoryIcon(slug) {
  const icons = {
    'premier-league': '🏴󠁧󠁢󠁥󠁮󠁧󠁿',
    'la-liga': '🇪🇸',
    'serie-a': '🇮🇹',
    'bundesliga': '🇩🇪',
    'ligue-1': '🇫🇷',
    'champions-league': '⭐',
    'transfer-news': '💸',
    'injury-news': '🏥',
    'match-preview': '🔮',
    'match-review': '📊',
    'team-news': '👥',
    'player-news': '⚽',
    'tactics': '📋',
    'opinion': '💭',
    'breaking': '🚨',
  }
  return icons[slug] || '📰'
}

function debouncedSearch() {
  clearTimeout(searchTimeout)
  searchTimeout = setTimeout(() => {
    page.value = 1
    fetchArticles()
  }, 400)
}

function handleFilterChange() {
  page.value = 1
  fetchArticles()
}

function clearAllFilters() {
  searchQuery.value = ''
  categoryFilter.value = ''
  page.value = 1
  fetchArticles()
}

function stripHtml(html) {
  if (!html) return ''
  const tmp = document.createElement('div')
  tmp.innerHTML = html
  return tmp.textContent || tmp.innerText || ''
}

function formatDate(dateString) {
  if (!dateString) return ''
  return new Date(dateString).toLocaleDateString('en-US', {
    year: 'numeric',
    month: 'long',
    day: 'numeric'
  })
}

function formatTimeAgo(dateString) {
  if (!dateString) return ''
  
  const now = new Date()
  const date = new Date(dateString)
  const seconds = Math.floor((now - date) / 1000)
  
  if (seconds < 60) return 'Just now'
  if (seconds < 3600) return `${Math.floor(seconds / 60)}m ago`
  if (seconds < 86400) return `${Math.floor(seconds / 3600)}h ago`
  if (seconds < 604800) return `${Math.floor(seconds / 86400)}d ago`
  
  return formatDate(dateString)
}

function scrollToTop() {
  window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: 'smooth' })
}

async function fetchArticles(pageNum = 1) {
  if (pageNum === 1) loading.value = true
  else loadingMore.value = true

  try {
    const params = {
      status: 'published',
      page: pageNum,
      limit: 12,
    }
    if (categoryFilter.value) params.category = categoryFilter.value
    if (searchQuery.value) {
      params.search = searchQuery.value
      delete params.category
    }

    const res = await axios.get('/api/v1/news/articles/', { params })
    const data = res.data

    if (pageNum === 1) {
      articles.value = data.results || data
    } else {
      articles.value = [...articles.value, ...(data.results || [])]
    }

    hasMore.value = data.next !== null
    page.value = pageNum
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Failed to fetch articles:', error)
  } finally {
    loading.value = false
    loadingMore.value = false
  }
}

async function loadMore() {
  await fetchArticles(page.value + 1)
}

onMounted(async () => {
  try {
    const [articlesRes, breakingRes, featuredRes, catRes] = await Promise.all([
      axios.get('/api/v1/news/articles/', { params: { status: 'published', limit: 12 } }),
      axios.get('/api/v1/news/articles/breaking/'),
      axios.get('/api/v1/news/articles/featured/'),
      axios.get('/api/v1/news/categories/'),
    ])

    articles.value = articlesRes.data.results || articlesRes.data || []
    breakingNews.value = breakingRes.data || []
    featuredNews.value = featuredRes.data || []
    categories.value = catRes.data.results || catRes.data || []

    hasMore.value = articlesRes.data.next !== null
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Failed to load news:', error)
  } finally {
    loading.value = false
  }
})
</script>

  background-size: 20px 20px;
}

<script setup>
import { ref, onMounted } from 'vue'
import { useRoute } from 'vue-router'
import axios from '@/axios'
import { formatDate, formatNumber } from '@/utils/formatters'

const route = useRoute()
const playerId = route.params.id

const loading = ref(true)
const player = ref(null)
const stats = ref(null)

const nationalityFlag = ref('🏳️')

onMounted(async () => {
  try {
    const [playerRes, statsRes] = await Promise.all([
      axios.get(`/api/v1/players/players/${playerId}/`),
      axios.get(`/api/v1/players/players/${playerId}/stats/`),
    ])

    player.value = playerRes.data
    stats.value = statsRes.data

    // Simple country to flag mapping (production would use a proper library)
    const country = player.value?.nationality
    if (country) {
      const flags = {
        England: '🏴󠁧󠁢󠁥󠁮󠁧󠁿', Spain: '🇪🇸', France: '🇫🇷', Germany: '🇩🇪',
        Italy: '🇮🇹', Portugal: '🇵🇹', Netherlands: '🇳🇱', Belgium: '🇧🇪',
        Brazil: '🇧🇷', Argentina: '🇦🇷', Norway: '🇳🇴', Egypt: '🇪🇬',
      }
      nationalityFlag.value = flags[country] || '🏳️'
    }
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Failed to load player:', error)
  } finally {
    loading.value = false
  }
})
</script>

              <div class="w-10 h-10 bg-primary-100 rounded-lg flex items-center justify-center">
                <svg class="w-5 h-5 text-primary-600" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
                  <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M9 12h6m-6 4h6m2 5H7a2 2 0 01-2-2V5a2 2 0 012-2h5.586a1 1 0 01.707.293l5.414 5.414a1 1 0 01.293.707V19a2 2 0 01-2 2z" />
                </svg>
              </div>
              <div class="flex-1">
                <p class="font-medium text-gray-900 group-hover:text-primary-600 transition-colors line-clamp-2">{{ relatedPoll.question }}</p>
              </div>
            </div>
            <div class="flex items-center gap-4 text-xs text-gray-500">
              <span>{{ relatedPoll.total_votes }} votes</span>
              <span class="flex items-center gap-1">
                <span :class="relatedPoll.status === 'active' ? 'text-green-600' : 'text-gray-400'">●</span>
                {{ relatedPoll.status === 'active' ? 'Active' : 'Closed' }}
              </span>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <!-- Not Found State -->
    <div v-else class="text-center py-16">
      <div class="w-24 h-24 bg-gray-100 rounded-3xl flex items-center justify-center mx-auto mb-6">
        <span class="text-6xl">📊</span>
      </div>
      <h2 class="text-2xl font-bold text-gray-900 mb-2">Poll Not Found</h2>
      <p class="text-gray-500 mb-6">This poll might have been removed or doesn't exist</p>
      <router-link to="/polls" 
                   class="inline-flex items-center gap-2 px-6 py-2.5 bg-primary-600 text-white font-medium rounded-xl hover:bg-primary-700 transition-all duration-300">
        Browse All Polls
        <svg class="w-4 h-4" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
          <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M13 7l5 5m0 0l-5 5m5-5H6" />
        </svg>
      </router-link>
    </div>
  </div>

<script setup>
import { ref, computed, onMounted } from 'vue'
import { useRoute, useRouter } from 'vue-router'
import { useAuthStore } from '@/stores/auth'
import { useUIStore } from '@/stores/ui'
import { api } from '@/services/api'
import { useWebSocket } from '@/composables/useWebSocket'
import { formatDate, getMatchStatusLabel } from '@/utils/formatters'

const route = useRoute()
const router = useRouter()
const authStore = useAuthStore()
const uiStore = useUIStore()

const loading = ref(true)
const poll = ref(null)
const pollOptions = ref([])
const totalVotes = ref(0)
const userVote = ref(null)
const copied = ref(false)
const relatedPolls = ref([])

const canVote = computed(() => {
  return authStore.isAuthenticated && 
         poll.value?.status === 'active' && 
         !userVote.value &&
         !loading.value
})

function getOptionColor(optionType) {
  const colors = {
    home: '#3b82f6',
    draw: '#eab308',
    away: '#ef4444',
  }
  return colors[optionType] || '#8b5cf6'
}

function isLeadingOption(optionId) {
  if (!pollOptions.value.length) return false
  const maxVotes = Math.max(...pollOptions.value.map(o => o.vote_count || 0))
  const option = pollOptions.value.find(o => o.id === optionId)
  return option && (option.vote_count || 0) === maxVotes && maxVotes > 0
}

function getRankNumber(optionId) {
  const sorted = [...pollOptions.value].sort((a, b) => (b.vote_count || 0) - (a.vote_count || 0))
  const index = sorted.findIndex(o => o.id === optionId)
  return index !== -1 ? index + 1 : null
}

function getRankStyle(index) {
  if (index === 0) return 'bg-yellow-100 text-yellow-700 border-2 border-yellow-400'
  if (index === 1) return 'bg-gray-100 text-gray-600 border-2 border-gray-300'
  if (index === 2) return 'bg-orange-100 text-orange-700 border-2 border-orange-300'
  return 'bg-gray-50 text-gray-500 border-2 border-gray-200'
}

async function handleVote(optionId) {
  if (!authStore.isAuthenticated) {
    uiStore.showWarning('Please sign in to vote', 'Authentication Required')
    return
  }
  
  loading.value = true
  
  try {
    const result = await api.vote(route.params.id, optionId)
    if (result) {
      uiStore.showSuccess('Vote recorded! 🎉', 'Thanks for participating')
      await loadPoll()
    }
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Vote failed:', error)
    uiStore.showError('Failed to record vote', 'Please try again')
  } finally {
    loading.value = false
  }
}

async function loadPoll() {
  loading.value = true
  try {
    const data = await api.getPoll(route.params.id)
    if (data) {
      poll.value = data
      pollOptions.value = data.options || []
      totalVotes.value = data.total_votes || 0
      
      if (authStore.isAuthenticated && data.user_vote) {
        userVote.value = data.user_vote.option_id
      }
      
      // Load related polls
      await loadRelatedPolls()
    }
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Failed to load poll:', error)
  } finally {
    loading.value = false
  }
}

async function loadRelatedPolls() {
  try {
    const response = await api.getPolls({ 
      status: 'active', 
      limit: 4,
      exclude: route.params.id 
    })
    relatedPolls.value = (response.results || response || []).filter(p => p.id !== route.params.id).slice(0, 4)
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Failed to load related polls:', error)
    relatedPolls.value = []
  }
}

function sharePoll(platform) {
  const url = window.location.href
  const title = poll.value?.question || 'Vote in this poll'
  const shareUrls = {
    twitter: `https://twitter.com/intent/tweet?url=${encodeURIComponent(url)}&text=${encodeURIComponent(title)}`,
    facebook: `https://www.facebook.com/sharer/sharer.php?u=${encodeURIComponent(url)}`,
  }
  if (shareUrls[platform]) {
    window.open(shareUrls[platform], '_blank', 'width=600,height=400')
  }
}

async function copyLink() {
  try {
    await navigator.clipboard.writeText(window.location.href)
    copied.value = true
    setTimeout(() => { copied.value = false }, 2000)
  } catch (err) {
    console.error('Failed to copy:', err)
  }
}

// WebSocket for real-time updates
const { addListener } = useWebSocket(`/ws/poll/${route.params.id}`, {
  autoConnect: true,
  onMessage: (data) => {
    if (data.type === 'poll_update' || data.type === 'initial_poll_results') {
      const updateData = data.data
      if (updateData.results) {
        pollOptions.value = updateData.results
        totalVotes.value = updateData.total_votes
        if (poll.value) poll.value.total_votes = updateData.total_votes
      }
    }
  },
})

onMounted(() => {
  loadPoll()
})
</script>

               class="relative cursor-pointer rounded-lg border-2 p-3 transition-all"
               :class="[
                 poll.status === 'active' && !hasVoted(poll) 
                   ? 'hover:border-primary-300 cursor-pointer' 
                   : 'cursor-default',
                 getUserVote(poll) === option.id

<script setup>
import { ref, computed, onMounted } from 'vue'
import { api } from '@/services/api'
import { useAuthStore } from '@/stores/auth'
import { useUIStore } from '@/stores/ui'
import Badge from '@/components/ui/Badge.vue'
import { formatDate } from '@/utils/formatters'

const authStore = useAuthStore()
const uiStore = useUIStore()

const loading = ref(true)
const polls = ref([])
const userVotes = ref({})
const statusFilter = ref('active')

const statusFilters = [
  { label: 'Active Polls', value: 'active' },
  { label: 'Closed Polls', value: 'closed' },
  { label: 'All Polls', value: 'all' },
]

const filteredPolls = computed(() => {
  if (statusFilter.value === 'all') return polls.value
  return polls.value.filter(p => p.status === statusFilter.value)
})

function hasVoted(poll) {
  return !!userVotes.value[poll.id]
}

function getUserVote(poll) {
  return userVotes.value[poll.id]
}

function getOptionColor(optionType) {
  const colors = {
    home: '#3b82f6',
    draw: '#eab308',
    away: '#ef4444',
  }
  return colors[optionType] || '#8b5cf6'
}

async function vote(pollId, optionId) {
  if (!authStore.isAuthenticated) {
    uiStore.showWarning('Please sign in to vote', 'Authentication Required')
    return
  }
  
  try {
    const result = await api.vote(pollId, optionId)
    if (result) {
      uiStore.showSuccess('Vote recorded!', 'Thank you for voting')
      await loadPolls()
    }
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Vote failed:', error)
    uiStore.showError('Failed to record vote', 'Please try again')
  }
}

async function loadPolls() {
  loading.value = true
  try {
    const response = await api.getPolls({ limit: 50 })
    polls.value = response.results || response || []
    
    // Load user votes if authenticated
    if (authStore.isAuthenticated) {
      polls.value.forEach(poll => {
        if (poll.user_vote?.option_id) {
          userVotes.value[poll.id] = poll.user_vote.option_id
        }
      })
    }
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Failed to load polls:', error)
    polls.value = []
  } finally {
    loading.value = false
  }
}

onMounted(() => {
  loadPolls()
})
</script>

<script setup>
import { ref, computed, onMounted } from 'vue'
import { useRoute, useRouter } from 'vue-router'
import { api } from '@/services/api'
import Loader from '@/components/ui/Loader.vue'
import TeamCard from '@/components/TeamCard.vue'
import PlayerStatsCard from '@/components/PlayerStatsCard.vue'
import CompetitionCard from '@/components/CompetitionCard.vue'

const route = useRoute()
const router = useRouter()

const query = ref('')
const loading = ref(false)
const hasSearched = ref(false)
const results = ref({ teams: [], players: [], competitions: [] })
const showAllTeams = ref(false)
const showAllPlayers = ref(false)
const showAllComps = ref(false)

const hasResults = computed(() => {
  return results.value.teams?.length > 0 || 
         results.value.players?.length > 0 || 
         results.value.competitions?.length > 0
})

const displayedTeams = computed(() => {
  if (showAllTeams.value) return results.value.teams
  return results.value.teams?.slice(0, 6) || []
})

const displayedPlayers = computed(() => {
  if (showAllPlayers.value) return results.value.players
  return results.value.players?.slice(0, 6) || []
})

const displayedComps = computed(() => {
  if (showAllComps.value) return results.value.competitions
  return results.value.competitions?.slice(0, 6) || []
})

async function performSearch() {
  if (!query.value.trim()) return
  
  loading.value = true
  hasSearched.value = true
  
  try {
    results.value = await api.search(query.value)
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Search failed:', error)
  } finally {
    loading.value = false
  }
}

function clearSearch() {
  query.value = ''
  results.value = { teams: [], players: [], competitions: [] }
  hasSearched.value = false
}

function goToTeam(id) {
  router.push(`/team/${id}`)
}

function goToCompetition(id) {
  router.push(`/competition/${id}`)
}

onMounted(() => {
  const searchQuery = route.query.q
  if (searchQuery) {
    query.value = searchQuery
    performSearch()
  }
})
</script>

<script setup>
import { ref, computed, onMounted } from 'vue'
import { useRouter } from 'vue-router'
import { useAuthStore } from '@/stores/auth'
import { useUIStore } from '@/stores/ui'
import { api } from '@/services/api'

const router = useRouter()
const authStore = useAuthStore()
const uiStore = useUIStore()

const isEditing = ref(false)
const savingProfile = ref(false)
const changingPassword = ref(false)
const savingPreferences = ref(false)
const deactivating = ref(false)
const showDeactivateModal = ref(false)

const showCurrentPassword = ref(false)
const showNewPassword = ref(false)
const showConfirmPassword = ref(false)

const profile = ref({
  first_name: '',
  last_name: '',
  email: '',
})

const passwordForm = ref({
  current: '',
  new: '',
  confirm: '',
})
const passwordErrors = ref({})

const preferences = ref({
  notification_match_start: true,
  notification_goal: true,
  notification_red_card: true,
  notification_half_time: false,
  notification_full_time: true,
  notification_news: false,
  email_notifications: true,
  push_notifications: true,
})

const matchNotifications = [
  { key: 'notification_match_start', label: 'Match Start', description: 'Get notified when matches begin' },
  { key: 'notification_goal', label: 'Goals', description: 'Get notified when goals are scored' },
  { key: 'notification_red_card', label: 'Red Cards', description: 'Get notified for red card incidents' },
  { key: 'notification_half_time', label: 'Half Time', description: 'Get notified at half time' },
  { key: 'notification_full_time', label: 'Full Time', description: 'Get notified at full time' },
]

const otherNotifications = [
  { key: 'notification_news', label: 'News Updates', description: 'Get notified about breaking news' },
  { key: 'email_notifications', label: 'Email Notifications', description: 'Receive notifications via email' },
  { key: 'push_notifications', label: 'Push Notifications', description: 'Receive push notifications in browser' },
]

// Password strength calculation
const passwordStrength = computed(() => {
  const password = passwordForm.value.new
  if (!password) return 0
  
  let strength = 0
  if (password.length >= 8) strength++
  if (password.match(/[A-Z]/)) strength++
  if (password.match(/[0-9]/)) strength++
  if (password.match(/[^A-Za-z0-9]/)) strength++
  return strength
})

const strengthTexts = ['Weak', 'Fair', 'Good', 'Strong']
const strengthColors = ['text-red-600', 'text-orange-600', 'text-yellow-600', 'text-green-600']

const getStrengthText = computed(() => {
  if (passwordStrength.value === 0) return ''
  return strengthTexts[passwordStrength.value - 1]
})

const getStrengthTextClass = computed(() => {
  if (passwordStrength.value === 0) return ''
  return strengthColors[passwordStrength.value - 1]
})

function getStrengthBarClass(index) {
  if (passwordStrength.value === 0) return 'bg-gray-200'
  if (index <= passwordStrength.value) {
    const colors = ['bg-red-500', 'bg-orange-500', 'bg-yellow-500', 'bg-green-500']
    return colors[passwordStrength.value - 1]
  }
  return 'bg-gray-200'
}

onMounted(() => {
  if (authStore.user) {
    profile.value = {
      first_name: authStore.user.first_name || '',
      last_name: authStore.user.last_name || '',
      email: authStore.user.email || '',
    }
  }
})

function cancelEdit() {
  isEditing.value = false
  profile.value = {
    first_name: authStore.user?.first_name || '',
    last_name: authStore.user?.last_name || '',
    email: authStore.user?.email || '',
  }
}

async function saveProfile() {
  savingProfile.value = true
  try {
    await authStore.updateProfile({
      first_name: profile.value.first_name,
      last_name: profile.value.last_name,
    })
    isEditing.value = false
    uiStore.showSuccess('Profile updated successfully', '')
  } catch (error) {
    uiStore.showError('Failed to update profile', 'Please try again')
  } finally {
    savingProfile.value = false
  }
}

async function changePassword() {
  passwordErrors.value = {}
  
  if (!passwordForm.value.current) {
    passwordErrors.value.current = 'Current password is required'
    return
  }
  if (passwordForm.value.new.length < 8) {
    passwordErrors.value.new = 'Password must be at least 8 characters'
    return
  }
  if (passwordForm.value.new !== passwordForm.value.confirm) {
    passwordErrors.value.confirm = 'Passwords do not match'
    return
  }
  
  changingPassword.value = true
  try {
    await authStore.changePassword(passwordForm.value.current, passwordForm.value.new)
    passwordForm.value = { current: '', new: '', confirm: '' }
    uiStore.showSuccess('Password changed successfully', '')
  } catch (error) {
    uiStore.showError(error.response?.data?.detail || 'Failed to change password', 'Please try again')
  } finally {
    changingPassword.value = false
  }
}

async function savePreferences() {
  savingPreferences.value = true
  try {
    // API call to save preferences
    await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 1000)) // Simulate API call
    uiStore.showSuccess('Preferences saved successfully', '')
  } catch (error) {
    uiStore.showError('Failed to save preferences', 'Please try again')
  } finally {
    savingPreferences.value = false
  }
}

async function deactivateAccount() {
  deactivating.value = true
  try {
    // await authStore.deactivate()
    await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 1000)) // Simulate API call
    showDeactivateModal.value = false
    authStore.logout()
    uiStore.showSuccess('Account deactivated', '')
    router.push('/')
  } catch (error) {
    uiStore.showError('Failed to deactivate account', 'Please try again')
  } finally {
    deactivating.value = false
  }
}
</script>

          placeholder="John"
          :error="errors.first_name"
        />
        <Input

          label="Last Name"
          placeholder="Doe"
          :error="errors.last_name"
        />
      </div>

      <Input
        v-model="form.email"
        type="email"
        label="Email Address"
        placeholder="you@example.com"
        required
        :error="errors.email"
      />

      <Input
        v-model="form.password"
        type="password"
        label="Password"
        placeholder="Create a strong password"
        required
        :error="errors.password"
      />

      <Input
        v-model="form.confirmPassword"
        type="password"
        label="Confirm Password"
        placeholder="Confirm your password"
        required
        :error="errors.confirmPassword"
      />

      <div v-if="generalError" class="text-red-600 text-sm bg-red-50 p-3 rounded-lg">
        {{ generalError }}
      </div>

      <div class="text-xs text-gray-500">
        By signing up, you agree to our 
        <a href="#" class="text-primary-600 hover:underline">Terms of Service</a> and 
        <a href="#" class="text-primary-600 hover:underline">Privacy Policy</a>.
      </div>

      <Button type="submit" :loading="loading" full-width>
        Create Account
      </Button>
    </form>

    <p class="text-center text-sm text-gray-500 mt-6">
      Already have an account?
      <router-link to="/login" class="text-primary-600 hover:underline font-medium">Sign in</router-link>
    </p>
  </div>

<script setup>
import { ref } from 'vue'
import { useRouter } from 'vue-router'
import { useAuthStore } from '@/stores/auth'
import { useUIStore } from '@/stores/ui'
import Input from '@/components/ui/Input.vue'
import Button from '@/components/ui/Button.vue'
import { validators } from '@/validators'

const router = useRouter()
const authStore = useAuthStore()
const uiStore = useUIStore()

const form = ref({
  first_name: '',
  last_name: '',
  email: '',
  password: '',
  confirmPassword: '',
})

const loading = ref(false)
const generalError = ref('')
const errors = ref({})

function validateForm() {
  const newErrors = {}
  
  if (!form.value.email) {
    newErrors.email = 'Email is required'
  } else if (!validators.email(form.value.email)) {
    newErrors.email = 'Invalid email address'
  }
  
  if (!form.value.password) {
    newErrors.password = 'Password is required'
  } else if (form.value.password.length < 8) {
    newErrors.password = 'Password must be at least 8 characters'
  }
  
  if (form.value.password !== form.value.confirmPassword) {
    newErrors.confirmPassword = 'Passwords do not match'
  }
  
  errors.value = newErrors
  return Object.keys(newErrors).length === 0
}

async function handleSignup() {
  errors.value = {}
  generalError.value = ''
  
  if (!validateForm()) return
  
  loading.value = true
  
  const success = await authStore.register(
    form.value.email,
    form.value.password,
    form.value.first_name,
    form.value.last_name
  )
  
  if (success) {
    uiStore.showSuccess('Welcome to LiveScore!', 'Account Created')
    router.push('/')
  } else {
    generalError.value = 'Registration failed. Please try a different email.'
  }
  
  loading.value = false
}
</script>

<script setup>
import { ref, computed, onMounted } from 'vue'
import { useRoute } from 'vue-router'
import { api } from '@/services/api'
import { formatDate, formatNumber, formatCompactNumber } from '@/utils/formatters'
import Loader from '@/components/ui/Loader.vue'
import Badge from '@/components/ui/Badge.vue'
import Tabs from '@/components/ui/Tabs.vue'
import MatchWidget from '@/components/MatchWidget.vue'

const route = useRoute()
const teamId = route.params.id

const loading = ref(true)
const team = ref(null)
const players = ref([])
const matches = ref({ upcoming: [], recent: [] })
const transfers = ref([])
const isFavorited = ref(false)
const activeTab = ref('squad')
const topScorers = ref([])
const topAssisters = ref([])

const positions = [
  { key: 'GK', label: 'Goalkeepers' },
  { key: 'CB', label: 'Defenders' },
  { key: 'LB', label: 'Left Backs' },
  { key: 'RB', label: 'Right Backs' },
  { key: 'DM', label: 'Defensive Midfielders' },
  { key: 'CM', label: 'Central Midfielders' },
  { key: 'AM', label: 'Attacking Midfielders' },
  { key: 'LW', label: 'Left Wingers' },
  { key: 'RW', label: 'Right Wingers' },
  { key: 'CF', label: 'Forwards' },
  { key: 'ST', label: 'Strikers' },
]

const tabs = [
  { id: 'squad', label: 'Squad' },
  { id: 'matches', label: 'Matches' },
  { id: 'stats', label: 'Stats' },
  { id: 'transfers', label: 'Transfers' },
]

const seasonStats = computed(() => {
  if (!matches.value.recent?.length) return { matches_played: 0, wins: 0, draws: 0, losses: 0 }
  
  const finished = matches.value.recent.filter(m => m.status === 'finished')
  const wins = finished.filter(m => 
    (m.home_team === teamId && m.home_score > m.away_score) ||
    (m.away_team === teamId && m.away_score > m.home_score)
  ).length
  const draws = finished.filter(m => m.home_score === m.away_score).length
  const losses = finished.length - wins - draws
  
  return {
    matches_played: finished.length,
    wins,
    draws,
    losses,
  }
})

function getPlayersByPosition(position) {
  if (position === 'GK') return players.value.filter(p => p.position === 'GK')
  if (['CB', 'LB', 'RB'].includes(position)) return players.value.filter(p => p.position === position)
  if (['DM', 'CM', 'AM'].includes(position)) return players.value.filter(p => p.position === position)
  if (['LW', 'RW', 'CF', 'ST'].includes(position)) return players.value.filter(p => p.position === position)
  return []
}

function toggleFavorite() {
  isFavorited.value = !isFavorited.value
}

async function loadTeam() {
  try {
    const [teamRes, playersRes, matchesRes, transfersRes] = await Promise.all([
      api.getTeam(teamId),
      api.getTeamPlayers(teamId),
      api.getTeamMatches(teamId),
      api.getTeamTransfers?.(teamId) || Promise.resolve({ results: [] }),
    ])
    
    team.value = teamRes
    players.value = playersRes.results || playersRes || []
    matches.value = matchesRes || { upcoming: [], recent: [] }
    transfers.value = transfersRes.results || transfersRes || []
    
    // Calculate top scorers from players
    topScorers.value = players.value
      .map(p => ({ player_id: p.id, player_name: p.full_name, goals: p.stats?.goals || 0 }))
      .sort((a, b) => b.goals - a.goals)
      .slice(0, 10)
    
    topAssisters.value = players.value
      .map(p => ({ player_id: p.id, player_name: p.full_name, assists: p.stats?.assists || 0 }))
      .sort((a, b) => b.assists - a.assists)
      .slice(0, 10)
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Failed to load team:', error)
  } finally {
    loading.value = false
  }
}

onMounted(() => {
  loadTeam()
})

"""
Redis client utility for caching and pub/sub.
"""
import json
import redis
from django.conf import settings
from functools import wraps
import hashlib
import pickle


class RedisClient:
    """Redis client wrapper for the application."""
    
    _instance = None
    
    def __new__(cls):
        if cls._instance is None:
            cls._instance = super().__new__(cls)
            cls._instance._initialized = False
        return cls._instance
    
    def __init__(self):
        if self._initialized:
            return
        
        redis_url = settings.CACHES['default']['LOCATION']
        self.client = redis.Redis.from_url(redis_url, decode_responses=True)
        self.pubsub = self.client.pubsub()
        self._initialized = True
    
    def get(self, key):
        """Get value from cache."""
        value = self.client.get(key)
        if value:
            return json.loads(value)
        return None
    
    def set(self, key, value, timeout=300):
        """Set value in cache with TTL."""
        serialized = json.dumps(value)
        return self.client.setex(key, timeout, serialized)
    
    def delete(self, key):
        """Delete key from cache."""
        return self.client.delete(key)
    
    def get_or_set(self, key, callback, timeout=300):
        """Get from cache or compute and store."""
        value = self.get(key)
        if value is not None:
            return value
        
        value = callback()
        self.set(key, value, timeout)
        return value
    
    def invalidate_pattern(self, pattern):
        """Invalidate all keys matching pattern."""
        keys = self.client.keys(pattern)
        if keys:
            return self.client.delete(*keys)
        return 0
    
    def publish(self, channel, message):
        """Publish message to a channel."""
        serialized = json.dumps(message)
        return self.client.publish(channel, serialized)
    
    def subscribe(self, channel):
        """Subscribe to a channel."""
        self.pubsub.subscribe(channel)
    
    def listen(self):
        """Listen for messages on subscribed channels."""
        for message in self.pubsub.listen():
            if message['type'] == 'message':
                yield {
                    'channel': message['channel'],
                    'data': json.loads(message['data'])
                }
    
    def cache_key(self, *args, **kwargs):
        """Generate a cache key from arguments."""
        key_parts = [str(arg) for arg in args]
        key_parts.extend(f"{k}:{v}" for k, v in sorted(kwargs.items()))
        key_string = ':'.join(key_parts)
        return f"cache:{hashlib.md5(key_string.encode()).hexdigest()}"
    
    def lock(self, lock_key, timeout=30):
        """Acquire a distributed lock."""
        return self.client.lock(
            f"lock:{lock_key}",
            timeout=timeout,
            blocking_timeout=5
        )


# Singleton instance
redis_client = RedisClient()


def cache_result(timeout=300, prefix=''):
    """
    Decorator to cache function results in Redis.
    """
    def decorator(func):
        @wraps(func)
        def wrapper(*args, **kwargs):
            # Generate cache key
            key_parts = [prefix, func.__module__, func.__name__]
            key_parts.extend([str(arg) for arg in args])
            key_parts.extend(f"{k}:{v}" for k, v in sorted(kwargs.items()))
            cache_key = ':'.join(key_parts)
            
            # Try cache
            cached = redis_client.get(cache_key)
            if cached is not None:
                return cached
            
            # Compute and cache
            result = func(*args, **kwargs)
            redis_client.set(cache_key, result, timeout)
            return result
        
        return wrapper
    return decorator
